answer_mr: माझी कन्या भाग्यश्री योजनेअंतर्गत एका मुलीवर कुटुंब नियोजन शस्त्रक्रिया केल्यास मुलीच्या नावे ₹५०,००० बँकेत जमा केले जातात. महिला व बालविकास कार्यालयात संपर्क साधा.
answer_hi: माझी कन्या भाग्यश्री योजना के तहत एक बेटी के बाद परिवार नियोजन कराने पर बेटी के नाम ₹50,000 की सावधि जमा (FD) की जाती है।
answer_te: కన్యా భాగ్యశ్రీ పథకం కింద ఒకే ఆడపిల్ల ఉన్న కుటుంబాలకు ఆమె భవిష్యత్తు కోసం ప్రభుత్వం ₹50,000 ఫిక్స్‌డ్ డిపాజిట్ చేస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree me 1 daughter ke baad family planning karne par daughter ke name pe ₹50,000 FD deposit ki jaati hai.

name: Chief Minister Fellowship Program (Maharashtra)
benefit: Prestigious 12-month policy fellowship working directly with District Collectors and state departments with a monthly stipend of ₹75,000.
eligibility: Graduates aged 21-26 years with first class marks and 1+ year work experience, proficient in Marathi and English.
documents: Degree Certificate, Work Experience Proof, Aadhaar Card, Resume.
answer_en: Maharashtra CM Fellowship awards young graduates ₹75,000/month stipend to work directly with senior government administrators. Apply online at mahagovfellowship.in.
answer_mr: मुख्यमंत्री फेलोशिप कार्यक्रमांतर्गत पदवीधर तरुणांना प्रशासनात काम करण्याची संधी आणि दरमहा ₹७५,००० विद्यावेतन दिले जाते. mahagovfellowship.in वर अर्ज करा.
answer_hi: महाराष्ट्र मुख्यमंत्री फेलोशिप कार्यक्रम के तहत युवाओं को प्रशासनिक परियोजनाओं पर काम करने के लिए ₹75,000 प्रति माह मानदेय दिया जाता है।
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఫెలోషిప్ ద్వారా యువ పట్టభద్రులకు ప్రభుత్వ పాలనలో పనిచేసే అవకాశంతో పాటు నెలకు ₹75,000 స్టైపెండ్ లభిస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: Maharashtra CM Fellowship me selected graduates ko administrative projects pe work karne ke liye ₹75,000 per month stipend milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana
benefit: 100% free physical and online competitive exam coaching for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, CDS, and NDA with tablets and study material.
eligibility: Students residing in UP preparing for competitive exams who cannot afford private coaching fees.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Educational Marksheets, Domicile Certificate, Passport photo.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana provides free expert coaching, tablets, and mentoring for civil services, NEET, and JEE. Register at abhyuday.up.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री अभ्युदय योजना के तहत यूपीएससी, यूपीपीएससी, नीट और जेईई जैसी प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं के लिए मुफ्त कोचिंग और टैबलेट उपलब्ध कराया जाता है।
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి అభ్యుదయ పథకం ద్వారా సివిల్ సర్వీసెస్, నీట్ మరియు జేఈఈ పరీక్షలకు సిద్ధమయ్యే విద్యార్థులకు ఉచిత కోచింగ్ మరియు టాబ్లెట్లు ప్రభుత్వం అందిస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: UP Abhyudaya Yojana me UPSC, NEET, JEE ke liye government officers dwara free coaching aur tablets provide kiye jaate hain.

name: Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment (Free Tablet/Smartphone)
benefit: Free high-performance tablets and smartphones with digital study materials and career services distributed to graduating students.
eligibility: Students enrolled in Graduation, Post-Graduation, Engineering, Medical, Diploma, or Skill programs in recognized UP colleges.
documents: College Admission ID, Aadhaar Card, Domicile Certificate.
answer_en: Under the Swami Vivekananda scheme, UP government distributes free tablets and smartphones to college students via the DigiShakti portal.
answer_hi: स्वामी विवेकानंद युवा सशक्तिकरण योजना के तहत उच्च शिक्षा ग्रहण कर रहे छात्र-छात्राओं को मुफ्त टैबलेट और स्मार्टफोन वितरित किए जाते हैं।
answer_te: స్వామి వివేకానంద యువ సాధికారత పథకం ద్వారా కాలేజీ విద్యార్థులకు ఉచితంగా టాబ్లెట్లు మరియు స్మార్ట్‌ఫోన్లు అందజేస్తారు.
answer_hinglish: DigiShakti portal ke through UP me college students ko study aur digital skills ke liye free tablets aur smartphones milte hain.

name: Mukhyamantri Shadi Anudan Yojana
benefit: ₹51,000 one-time financial grant for the solemnization of marriage of daughters of poor families (or ₹20,000 for individual marriages).
eligibility: Families in UP belonging to SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and General BPL with annual family income under ₹46,080 (rural) or ₹56,460 (urban).
documents: Bride & Groom Age Proof, Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, Wedding Invitation Card, Aadhaar, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: UP Shadi Anudan provides ₹51,000 financial grant for daughters' marriages in low-income families. Apply online at shadianudan.upsdc.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री शादी अनुदान योजना के तहत गरीब परिवारों की बेटियों की शादी के लिए ₹51,000 की आर्थिक मदद सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి పెళ్లి గ్రాంట్ పథకం ద్వారా పేద కుటుంబాల ఆడపిల్లల వివాహానికి ప్రభుత్వం ₹51,000 ఆర్థిక సాయం అందజేస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: UP Shadi Anudan scheme me beti ki marriage ke liye government ₹51,000 direct bank account me grant deti hai.

name: UP Vridhavastha (Old Age) Pension Scheme
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (₹3,000 quarterly) paid directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account of elderly citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60+ living below the poverty line with rural income under ₹46,080 or urban income under ₹56,460 per year.
documents: Age Certificate/Aadhaar Card, BPL Card or Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: UP Old Age Pension gives ₹1,000 per month to elderly citizens aged 60 and above living below the poverty line. Apply on sspy-up.gov.in.
answer_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के बीपीएल बुजुर्गों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_te: ఉత్తర ప్రదేశ్ వృద్ధాప్య పింఛన్ పథకం ద్వారా 60 ఏళ్లు పైబడిన బీపీఎల్ వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 పింఛన్ అందుతుంది.
answer_hinglish: UP Vridhavastha Pension me 60+ elderly citizens ko ₹1,000 per month (₹3,000 quarterly) direct bank account me milta hai via SSPY portal.

name: UP Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana
benefit: 6 days of free professional skill training with daily stipend, followed by a 100% free modern toolkit worth ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 and subsidized loan support.
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftsmen (barbers, tailors, carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers) residing in UP aged 18+.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Traditional Craft Certificate / Gram Pradhan verification, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Vishwakarma Shram Samman gives free advanced training and complimentary modern toolkits to traditional UP artisans. Register at diupmsme.upsdc.gov.in.
answer_hi: विश्वकर्मा श्रम सम्मान योजना के तहत बढ़ई, दर्जी, कुम्हार और नाई जैसे पारंपरिक कारीगरों को मुफ्त प्रशिक्षण और आधुनिक टूलकिट दी जाती है।
answer_te: విశ్వకర్మ శ్రమ సమ్మాన్ పథకం ద్వారా సాంప్రదాయ చేతివృత్తుల వారికి ఉచిత శిక్షణ మరియు ఉచిత ఆధునిక పనిముట్ల కిట్ ప్రభుత్వం అందజేస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: Vishwakarma Shram Samman me carpenters, tailors, barbers ko free skill training ke sath free branded toolkit aur business loan milta hai.

name: Banking Correspondent (BC) Sakhi Yojana
benefit: Monthly stipend of ₹4,000 for the first 6 months, free micro-ATM and fingerprint machine, plus transaction commission for providing doorstep banking.
eligibility: 10th pass women aged 18-50 years associated with rural Self Help Groups (SHGs) in UP.
documents: Class 10 Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, SHG Membership Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: BC Sakhi trains rural women to provide doorstep banking services in UP villages with ₹4,000 monthly allowance and commission. Apply on the BC Sakhi mobile app.
answer_hi: बीसी सखी योजना के तहत ग्रामीण महिलाओं को बैंकिंग सेवाएं देने के लिए ₹4,000 प्रति माह मानदेय और मुफ्त माइक्रो-एटीएम मशीन दी जाती है।
answer_te: బీసీ సఖి పథకం ద్వారా గ్రామీణ మహిళలకు బ్యాంకింగ్ సేవల నిర్వహణ కోసం నెలకు ₹4,000 వేతనంతో పాటు ఉచిత మైక్రో-ఏటీఎం పరికరం లభిస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: BC Sakhi scheme me rural women ko village me doorstep banking provide karne ke liye ₹4,000/month stipend aur micro-ATM device milta hai.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Gopalak Yojana
benefit: Bank loans up to ₹9,00,000 for setting up dairy farms with 10 to 12 milch cows/buffaloes, plus government interest subvention of ₹40,000 per year for 5 years.
eligibility: Unemployed youth and livestock farmers in UP owning at least 5 milch cattle ready to expand to 10-12 cattle.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Cattle ownership proof, Land documents for cow shed, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: UP Gopalak Yojana provides up to ₹9 Lakh bank loans with ₹2 Lakh interest subsidies to set up dairy farms. Apply at your District Chief Veterinary Office.
answer_hi: गोपालक योजना के तहत 10-12 दुधारू पशुओं की डेयरी खोलने के लिए ₹9 लाख तक का बैंक ऋण और ₹2 लाख तक की ब्याज सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_te: గోపాలక్ పథకం ద్వారా పాడి డెయిరీ పరిశ్రమ ఏర్పాటు కోసం రైతులకు ₹9 లక్షల వరకు బ్యాంక్ రుణం మరియు వడ్డీ సబ్సిడీ ప్రభుత్వం అందిస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: UP Gopalak Yojana me dairy farm kholne ke liye ₹9 Lakh tak bank loan aur 5 saal ke liye ₹40,000 yearly interest subsidy milti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana
benefit: Financial compensation of ₹5,00,000 to the family in case of accidental death or permanent total disability of a farmer/batayidar.
eligibility: Farmers and agricultural labourers (including sharecroppers/batayidars) aged 18 to 70 years residing in Uttar Pradesh.
documents: FIR / Police Panchanama, Post-mortem Report, Land Khatauni or Batayidar affidavit, Aadhaar Card, Nominee Bank Details.
answer_en: Krishak Durghatna Kalyan provides ₹5 Lakh compensation to families of farmers who suffer fatal accidents during farm activities. Apply within 45 days at the Tahsil office.
answer_hi: कृषक दुर्घटना कल्याण योजना के तहत खेती के दौरान दुर्घटना में किसान की मृत्यु या दिव्यांगता पर परिवार को ₹5 लाख की आर्थिक सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_te: కృషక్ దుర్ఘటన కళ్యాణ్ పథకం కింద ప్రమాదవశాత్తూ రైతు మరణిస్తే వారి కుటుంబానికి ప్రభుత్వం ₹5 లక్షల పరిహారం అందజేస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: Krishak Durghatna Kalyan me kisan ya batayidar ki accidental death hone par family ko ₹5 Lakh direct financial compensation milta hai.

name: UP Skill Development Mission (UPSDM)
benefit: 100% free industry-certified vocational training across 30+ sectors (IT, electronics, healthcare, retail, logistics) with guaranteed placement interviews.
eligibility: Youth aged 14 to 35 years residing in Uttar Pradesh who have passed Class 8/10.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Educational Marksheet, Passport size photograph, Bank Account.
answer_en: UPSDM provides free certified vocational skill courses and job placement assistance to UP youth. Register on upsdm.gov.in or visit a nearby training centre.
answer_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश कौशल विकास मिशन (UPSDM) के तहत युवाओं को 30 से अधिक क्षेत्रों में मुफ्त व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण और रोजगार सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_te: ఉత్తర ప్రదేశ్ కౌశల్ వికాస్ మిషన్ ద్వారా యువతకు వివిధ రంగాలలో ఉచిత వృత్తి విద్యా శిక్షణ మరియు ఉద్యోగ అవకాశాలు కల్పించబడతాయి.
answer_hinglish: UPSDM me 14-35 saal ke youth ko completely free technical training aur placement support milta hai. Portal pe enroll karein.

name: UP Divyangjan Pension Yojana
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 directly credited into the bank accounts of persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Persons residing in UP with minimum 40% disability certified by CMO/District Hospital with family income under ₹46,080/year.
documents: Disability Certificate (40%+ UDID), Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: UP Divyangjan Pension gives ₹1,000 per month to persons with 40% or more disability from poor families. Apply on sspy-up.gov.in.
answer_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश दिव्यांगजन पेंशन योजना के तहत 40% या उससे अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले पात्र व्यक्तियों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन दी जाती है।
answer_te: దివ్యాంగుల పింఛన్ పథకం ద్వారా 40% పైగా అంగవైకల్యం ఉన్న వ్యక్తులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 పింఛన్ లభిస్తుంది.
answer_hinglish: UP Divyang Pension me 40%+ disabled citizens ko har mahine ₹1,000 pension milti hai. District CMO certificate ke sath apply karein.

name: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana
benefit: ₹51,000 total package for mass marriage: ₹35,000 deposited in bride's bank account, ₹10,000 gift items (jewellery, utensils, clothes), and ₹6,000 event expenses.
eligibility: BPL families of all communities in UP with annual income below ₹2 Lakh holding a daughter of marriageable age (18+).
documents: Bride & Groom Aadhaar, Age proof, BPL Ration Card, Income Certificate, Bride Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah arranges community marriages with ₹35,000 bank grant and ₹10,000 gift items for daughters of poor families. Apply at the Block Development Office.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सामूहिक विवाह योजना के तहत सामूहिक विवाह में ₹35,000 नकद, ₹10,000 का उपहार सामान और पूरा विवाह समारोह मुफ्त कराया जाता है।
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి సామూహిక వివాహ పథకం ద్వారా పేద జంటలకు ₹35,000 నగదు మరియు ₹10,000 బహుమతులతో ఉచితంగా వివాహం జరిపిస్తారు.
answer_hinglish: UP Samuhik Vivah Yojana me government free mass wedding arrange karti hai aur bride ko ₹35,000 cash aur ₹10,000 gift items deti hai.

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana 2.0
benefit: Total financial assurance of ₹1,43,000 for girl child, plus ₹25,000 lump sum for college admission and free graduation tuition.
eligibility: Girl child born in MP from families who are native residents and not paying income tax.
documents: Birth Certificate, Parents' Samagra ID, Aadhaar Card, Family Planning Certificate (after 2nd child).
answer_en: Ladli Laxmi 2.0 provides ₹1,43,000 cumulative benefits for a girl child's education and ₹25,000 on college admission. Register on ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in.
answer_hi: लाड़ली लक्ष्मी योजना 2.0 के तहत बेटियों को कुल ₹1,43,000 का आश्वासन प्रमाण पत्र और कॉलेज में प्रवेश पर ₹25,000 की प्रोत्साहन राशि मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Ladli Laxmi 2.0 me beti ke birth se graduation tak ₹1.43 Lakh total benefit aur college admission pe ₹25,000 milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 as state assistance on top of PM-Kisan (total ₹12,000/year).
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Madhya Pradesh registered under the PM-Kisan scheme.
documents: PM-Kisan Beneficiary ID, Land Khasra/Khatoni, Samagra ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: MP Kisan Kalyan Yojana provides ₹6,000 annual state assistance to PM-Kisan beneficiaries, making a total of ₹12,000 yearly directly into farmer bank accounts.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री किसान कल्याण योजना के तहत पीएम-किसान के ₹6,000 के अलावा राज्य सरकार ₹6,000 और देती है (कुल ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष)।
answer_hinglish: MP Kisan Kalyan me PM-Kisan ke sath extra ₹6,000 per year state top-up milta hai direct bank transfer ke through.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana
benefit: ₹4,00,000 financial aid on accidental death, ₹2,00,000 on normal death, ₹16,000 maternity assistance, and free electricity subsidy.
eligibility: Unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 60 years residing in MP with family income under ₹1.5 Lakh.
documents: Samagra ID, Aadhaar Card, Unorganized Worker Declaration, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Sambal 2.0 provides social security cover up to ₹4 Lakh on accidental death and ₹16,000 maternity assistance for unorganized workers. Apply on sambal.mp.gov.in.
answer_hi: संबल 2.0 योजना के तहत असंगठित श्रमिकों को दुर्घटना मृत्यु पर ₹4 लाख, प्रसूति सहायता में ₹16,000 और बच्चों की मुफ्त शिक्षा मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Sambal 2.0 scheme me unorganized workers ko ₹4 Lakh accidental insurance aur ₹16,000 maternity aid milta hai Sambal card ke zariye.

name: Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana
benefit: 100% free pilgrimage travel by special train or flight to sacred places across India (Varanasi, Ayodhya, Rameshwaram, Dwarka, Puri) with free lodging and food.
eligibility: Senior citizens of MP aged 60+ (58+ for women) who are not income tax payers.
documents: Age Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Domicile Certificate, Fitness Certificate.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan offers completely free pilgrimage travel with food and stay for elderly citizens aged 60+. Apply at your Tehsil or Municipal office.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री तीर्थ दर्शन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के बुजुर्गों को देश के प्रमुख तीर्थ स्थलों की मुफ्त रेल और हवाई यात्रा कराई जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Teerth Darshan scheme me 60+ senior citizens ko free train/flight pilgrimage, hotel stay aur food government provide karti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
benefit: 100% college tuition fees paid by state government for undergraduate engineering, medical (MBBS), law, and degree courses in prestigious institutions.
eligibility: MP domicile students scoring 70%+ in MP Board or 85%+ in CBSE Class 12, with family annual income under ₹6 Lakh.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet, College Admission Proof/Rank Card, Income Certificate under ₹6L, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: MMVY covers 100% of college tuition fees for meritorious students pursuing MBBS, Engineering, or degrees. Register on scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मेधावी विद्यार्थी योजना के तहत इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल और लॉ की पूरी कॉलेज फीस राज्य सरकार भरती है।
answer_hinglish: Medhavi Vidyarthi scheme me Class 12 meritorious students ki poori engineering aur MBBS college fee state government pay karti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah / Nikah Yojana
benefit: ₹51,000 total assistance: ₹49,000 transferred directly to bride's bank account for household setup, and ₹6,000 for wedding arrangement.
eligibility: Daughters of destitute, widow, or poor families aged 18+ resident of Madhya Pradesh participating in mass weddings.
documents: Age proof of bride and groom, Samagra ID, BPL Card, Bride Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah grants ₹49,000 direct bank transfer to brides in community weddings for poor families. Apply at your local Janpad Panchayat.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या विवाह योजना के तहत सामूहिक विवाह में बेटियों को गृहस्थी के लिए ₹49,000 की नकद सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: MP Kanya Vivah me samuhik vivah me shadi karne par dulhan ke bank account me ₹49,000 cash help milti hai.

name: Gaon Ki Beti Scheme
benefit: Financial scholarship of ₹500 per month (₹5,000 per year) for 10 months for rural girls pursuing higher education.
eligibility: Rural girl students of MP passing Class 12 with 60%+ marks (First Division) enrolling in college.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet, Gaon Ki Beti Certificate from Gram Panchayat, College Bonafide, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Gaon Ki Beti scheme awards ₹5,000 annual scholarship to rural first-division girl students attending college. Apply on State Scholarship Portal.
answer_hi: गांव की बेटी योजना के तहत 12वीं में प्रथम श्रेणी लाने वाली ग्रामीण छात्राओं को कॉलेज की पढ़ाई के लिए ₹500 प्रति माह (₹5,000 वार्षिक) छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Gaon Ki Beti scheme me 12th first division rural girls ko college study ke liye ₹5,000 yearly scholarship milti hai.

name: Ration Aapke Gram Yojana
benefit: Free monthly ration grain delivered directly to the doorstep of tribal villages using specialized tribal-youth-operated delivery vehicles.
eligibility: Tribal families in designated tribal blocks of Madhya Pradesh who previously had to travel kilometers to fair price shops.
documents: Ration Card, Samagra ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Ration Aapke Gram delivers monthly subsidized ration foodgrains directly to remote tribal villages so villagers don't have to walk miles.
answer_hi: राशन आपके ग्राम योजना के तहत जनजातीय क्षेत्रों के दूरदराज गांवों में सरकारी राशन गाड़ी भेजकर घर-घर राशन पहुंचाया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Ration Aapke Gram me tribal villages me doorstep government ration grain deliver kiya jaata hai free of transport charge.

name: Mukhyamantri Solar Pump Yojana
benefit: Up to 90% subsidy for setting up standalone solar agricultural water pumps (2 HP to 5 HP) in remote and un-electrified farmland.
eligibility: Farmers in MP having land with irrigation water sources but no existing commercial electricity connection.
documents: Land Khasra/Khatoni, Water Source certificate, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: MP Solar Pump Yojana grants up to 90% subsidy on installing 2 HP to 5 HP solar irrigation pumps for farmers without electricity connections.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सोलर पंप योजना के तहत बिजली विहीन खेतों में सिंचाई के लिए सोलर पंप लगवाने पर 90% तक की भारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: MP Solar Pump scheme me khet me 2 HP se 5 HP tak solar irrigation pump lagwane par 90% tak government subsidy milti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Seekho-Kamao Yojana (Learn and Earn)
benefit: Paid on-the-job industrial apprenticeship with monthly government stipends of ₹8,000 (12th pass), ₹8,500 (ITI), ₹9,000 (Diploma), and ₹10,000 (Graduates).
eligibility: Youth aged 18 to 29 years permanent residents of MP who have passed 12th, ITI, Diploma, or Degree.
documents: Educational Certificates, Samagra ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Seekho-Kamao offers certified industrial training with up to ₹10,000 monthly stipend. Enroll on mmsky.mp.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सीखो-कमाओ योजना के तहत युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक प्रशिक्षण के साथ ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रति माह स्टाइपेंड दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Seekho Kamao scheme me youth ko industrial training ke dauran ₹8,000 to ₹10,000 monthly stipend direct bank account me milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Charan Paduka Yojana
benefit: Free high-quality shoes/footwear, umbrellas, and thermos water bottles, plus ₹200 saree grant for tendu leaf collectors and forest workers.
eligibility: Registered tendu leaf collection workers and forest produce gatherers in Madhya Pradesh.
documents: Tendu Patta Collector Card, Samagra ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Charan Paduka scheme equips forest tendu leaf collectors with free protective shoes, umbrellas, and water bottles to protect against rough terrain and heat.
answer_hi: चरण पादुका योजना के तहत तेंदूपत्ता संग्राहक आदिवासी भाई-बहनों को जूते, चप्पल, छाता और पानी की बोतल मुफ्त दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Charan Paduka scheme me tendu patta gatherers ko jungle me safety ke liye free shoes, umbrella aur thermos bottle di jaati hai.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (K1 & K2)
benefit: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) for teenage school girls (classes 8-12) plus one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) at age 18 for unmarried girls pursuing education.
eligibility: Girl students studying in recognized schools/colleges in WB aged 13-19 from families with annual income under ₹1.2 Lakh.
documents: Birth Certificate, Unmarried Declaration, School Bonafide, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: UN-award winning Kanyashree Prakalpa gives girls ₹1,000 yearly and a ₹25,000 grant at age 18 to prevent child marriage and support college. Apply through your school.
answer_bn: কন্যাশ্রী প্রকল্পের মাধ্যমে স্কুলপড়ুয়া মেয়েদের বছরে ₹১,০০০ এবং ১৮ বছর বয়সে উচ্চশিক্ষার জন্য এককালীন ₹২৫,০০০ অনুদান দেওয়া হয়। স্কুলে যোগাযোগ করুন।
answer_hi: कन्याश्री प्रकल्प के तहत छात्राओं को ₹1,000 वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति और 18 वर्ष की आयु पर ₹25,000 का एकमुश्त अनुदान उच्च शिक्षा के लिए दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Kanyashree Prakalpa me girls ko school me ₹1,000 annual aur 18 years age par ₹25,000 higher education grant milta hai.

name: Swasthya Sathi Scheme
benefit: 100% cashless basic and tertiary health coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year issued in the name of the eldest female member.
eligibility: All residents of West Bengal across government, private, and informal sectors with no exclusions.
documents: Swasthya Sathi Smart Card, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card.
answer_en: Swasthya Sathi provides up to ₹5 Lakh free cashless healthcare annually per family, issued in the woman's name. Accepted at major private and government hospitals.
answer_bn: স্বাস্থ্য সাথী প্রকল্পে পরিবারের প্রবীণতম মহিলার নামে স্মার্ট কার্ডের মাধ্যমে প্রতি বছর ₹৫ লক্ষ পর্যন্ত বিনামূল্যে ক্যাশলেস চিকিৎসার সুবিধা পাওয়া যায়।
answer_hi: स्वास्थ्य साथी योजना के तहत परिवार की महिला मुखिया के नाम से जारी कार्ड पर प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Swasthya Sathi me family ko ₹5 Lakh yearly cashless hospital treatment milta hai. Smart card female head ke name pe hota hai.

name: Krishak Bandhu (Natun) Scheme
benefit: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per year (₹5,000 in Kharif & ₹5,000 in Rabi) for 1+ acre land, plus ₹2,00,000 death compensation for farmer families.
eligibility: All landowning farmers and recorded bhagchasis (sharecroppers) in West Bengal aged 18 to 60.
documents: RoR (Parcha) Land Record, Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Krishak Bandhu provides up to ₹10,000 yearly crop support and ₹2 Lakh life insurance to farmers and sharecroppers in West Bengal. Apply at your Block ADA office.
answer_bn: কৃষক বন্ধু প্রকল্পে কৃষকদের বছরে সর্বোচ্চ ₹১০,০০০ আর্থিক সহায়তা এবং কোনো কৃষকের মৃত্যু হলে পরিবারকে ₹২ লক্ষ টাকা ক্ষতিপূরণ দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: कृषक बंधु योजना के तहत किसानों को हर साल ₹10,000 तक की फसल सहायता और मृत्यु पर परिवार को ₹2 लाख का बीमा मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Krishak Bandhu me farmers aur bhagchasis ko ₹10,000 per year crop aid aur ₹2 Lakh death insurance coverage milta hai.

name: Rupashree Prakalpa
benefit: One-time financial grant of ₹25,000 transferred directly into the bank account of an adult girl before her marriage.
eligibility: Unmarried girls aged 18+ resident of WB whose family annual income is under ₹1.5 Lakh.
documents: Age proof (Madhyamik Admit/Birth Certificate), Family Income Certificate, Wedding Invitation Card, Bride's Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Rupashree Prakalpa provides a one-time grant of ₹25,000 to daughters of low-income families before marriage. Apply at your local BDO or SDO office.
answer_bn: রূপশ্রী প্রকল্পের আওতায় দরিদ্র পরিবারের প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক মেয়েদের বিয়ের খরচের জন্য এককালীন ₹২৫,০০০ অনুদান সরাসরি অ্যাকাউন্টে দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: रूपश्री प्रकल्प के तहत गरीब परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह के लिए ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता शादी से पहले दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Rupashree Prakalpa me marriage expense ke liye beti ke bank account me ₹25,000 direct one-time grant transfer hota hai.

name: Sabooj Sathi (Free Bi-Cycles)
benefit: Free high-quality branded bi-cycles distributed to all students studying in classes 9 to 12 in government and aided schools.
eligibility: Boys and girls enrolled in classes 9, 10, 11, and 12 in West Bengal government and madrasah schools.
documents: School Registration ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Sabooj Sathi gifts free bicycles to all class 9-12 students in West Bengal to ensure easy transportation to high school. Distributed directly at schools.
answer_bn: সবুজ সাথী প্রকল্পের মাধ্যমে রাজ্যের সরকারি ও সরকার পোষিত স্কুলের নবম থেকে দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির সমস্ত ছাত্রছাত্রীকে বিনামূল্যে সাইকেল দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: सबूज साथी योजना के तहत कक्षा 9 से 12 तक के सभी छात्र-छात्राओं को स्कूल आने-जाने के लिए मुफ्त साइकिल दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Sabooj Sathi scheme me class 9 to 12 students ko travel convenience ke liye free branded bicycle di jaati hai.

name: Yuvashree (Yuva Utsaha Prakalpa)
benefit: Monthly unemployment financial assistance of ₹1,500 to jobseekers registered with the Employment Bank to support skill training.
eligibility: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 45 who have passed Class 8 or above registered in the WB Employment Bank.
documents: Employment Bank Enrollment Slip, Educational Marksheets, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Yuvashree gives ₹1,500/month unemployment assistance to jobseekers enrolled in the Employment Bank. Register online at employmentbankwb.gov.in.
answer_bn: যুবশ্রী প্রকল্পের অধীনে এমপ্লয়মেন্ট ব্যাংকে নাম নথিভুক্ত বেকার যুবক-যুবতীদের প্রতি মাসে ₹১,৫০০ করে ভাতা দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: युवाश्री योजना के तहत रोजगार बैंक में पंजीकृत बेरोजगार युवाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह बेरोजगारी सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Yuvashree scheme me Employment Bank registered youth ko ₹1,500 per month financial assistance milta hai skill preparation ke liye.

name: Taruner Swapno (Free Tablet / Smartphone Grant)
benefit: Direct cash grant of ₹10,000 deposited into bank accounts of Class 11 and 12 students to purchase tablets or smartphones for digital learning.
eligibility: Students studying in Class 11 and 12 in West Bengal government and aided secondary schools.
documents: Student Banglar Shiksha ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Taruner Swapno grants ₹10,000 directly into students' bank accounts in Class 11/12 to purchase a tablet or smartphone for higher secondary education.
answer_bn: তরুণের স্বপ্ন প্রকল্পের আওতায় একাদশ ও দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির ছাত্রছাত্রীদের ট্যাবলেট বা স্মার্টফোন কেনার জন্য এককালীন ₹১০,০০০ ব্যাংক অ্যাকাউন্টে দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: तरुणेर स्वप्नो योजना के तहत 11वीं और 12वीं के छात्रों को डिजिटल पढ़ाई के लिए ₹10,000 सीधे बैंक खाते में दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Taruner Swapno me Class 11-12 students ko smartphone/tablet purchase karne ke liye ₹10,000 direct bank account me milte hain.

name: Jai Bangla Pension Scheme (Taposili Bandhu & Jai Johar)
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for elderly persons belonging to SC (Taposili Bandhu) and ST (Jai Johar) communities aged 60+.
eligibility: SC/ST senior citizens aged 60+ years residing in West Bengal not receiving other government pensions.
documents: SC/ST Caste Certificate, Age Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Bank Passbook, Residential Proof.
answer_en: Jai Bangla Pension pays ₹1,000 per month to elderly SC and ST citizens aged 60+. Apply at your local BDO or Duare Sarkar camps.
answer_bn: জয় বাংলা পেনশন প্রকল্পের মাধ্যমে তপশিলি জাতি (তপশিলি বন্ধু) ও উপজাতি (জয় জোহার) সম্প্রদায়ের ৬০ বছর বা তার বেশি বয়সী প্রবীণদের প্রতি মাসে ₹১,০০০ পেনশন দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: जय बांग्ला पेंशन योजना के तहत एससी और एसटी वर्ग के 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के बुजुर्गों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Jai Bangla Pension me 60+ SC/ST senior citizens ko ₹1,000 per month lifelong pension direct bank account me milti hai.

name: Shikshashree Scholarship
keywords: sc st scholarship class 5 to 8 wb
benefit: Annual scholarship of ₹800 directly credited into bank accounts of SC and ST students in classes 5 to 8 to arrest dropouts.
eligibility: SC and ST students studying in classes 5 to 8 in West Bengal with family annual income under ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: SC/ST Caste Certificate, Family Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Shikshashree provides ₹800 annual assistance to SC/ST students in classes 5 to 8 to cover school materials and uniform needs. Apply through the school headmaster.
answer_bn: শিক্ষাশ্রী প্রকল্পে পঞ্চম থেকে অষ্টম শ্রেণির তফশিলি জাতি ও উপজাতিভুক্ত পড়ুয়াদের পড়াশোনার খরচের জন্য বছরে ₹৮০০ অনুদান সরাসরি দেওয়া হয়।
answer_hi: शिक्षार्थी योजना के तहत कक्षा 5 से 8 तक के एससी/एसटी छात्रों को ₹800 वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Shikshashree scheme me Class 5 to 8 SC/ST students ko school dropout prevent karne ke liye ₹800 annual scholarship milti hai.

name: Gatidhara Commercial Vehicle Scheme
benefit: 30% capital subsidy (up to ₹1,00,000) for purchasing small commercial transport vehicles (taxis, autos, e-rickshaws, mini-trucks) for self-employment.
eligibility: Unemployed youth aged 20 to 45 years registered with Employment Bank with family income under ₹25,000/month holding driving licence.
documents: Commercial Driving Licence, Employment Bank ID, Aadhaar Card, Project Quotation, Bank Loan approval.
answer_en: Gatidhara provides up to ₹1,00,000 capital subsidy to purchase autos, commercial vehicles, or small trucks for self-employment. Apply via District Transport Office.
answer_bn: গতিধারা প্রকল্পের আওতায় বাণিজ্যিক গাড়ি, অটো বা ছোট ট্রাক কিনে স্বনির্ভর হওয়ার জন্য রাজ্য সরকার সর্বোচ্চ ₹১ লক্ষ পর্যন্ত ভর্তুকি দেয়।
answer_hi: गतिधारा योजना के तहत ऑटो, टैक्सी या वाणिज्यिक वाहन खरीदने के लिए ₹1 लाख तक की 30% सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Gatidhara scheme me commercial auto, taxi ya delivery van buy karne ke liye ₹1 Lakh tak capital subsidy milti hai.

name: Khadya Sathi (Digital Ration Scheme)
benefit: Free rice and wheat distributed to nearly 90% of West Bengal's population (under NFSA and RKSY-I), and subsidized rates for tea garden and Aila affected families.
eligibility: Holders of Digital Ration Cards (AAY, PHH, SPHH, RKSY-I, RKSY-II) in West Bengal.
documents: Digital Ration Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Khadya Sathi provides free monthly rice and wheat to over 9 crore citizens in West Bengal through digital ration cards. Collect at any fair price shop.
answer_bn: খাদ্য সাথী প্রকল্পের মাধ্যমে রাজ্যের ৯ কোটিরও বেশি মানুষ ডিজিটাল রেশন কার্ডের সাহায্যে বিনামূল্যে চাল ও গম পান।
answer_hi: खाद्य साथी योजना के तहत पश्चिम बंगाल के 9 करोड़ से अधिक नागरिकों को डिजिटल राशन कार्ड पर हर महीने मुफ्त खाद्यान्न उपलब्ध कराया जाता है।
answer_te: పశ్చిమ బెంగాల్ ఖాద్య సాథి పథకం ద్వారా దాదాపు 9 కోట్ల మంది పౌరులకు ఉచిత బియ్యం మరియు గోధుమలను డిజిటల్ రేషన్ కార్డులపై అందజేస్తారు.
answer_hinglish: Khadya Sathi scheme me 9 crore citizens ko Digital Ration Card ke through monthly free rice aur wheat provide kiya jaata hai.

name: Bihar Student Credit Card (MNSSBY)
benefit: Collateral-free education loans up to ₹4,00,000 at 4% simple interest (1% for girls, disabled, and transgender students) guaranteed by state government.
eligibility: 12th pass students permanent residents of Bihar aged up to 25 enrolling in recognized higher education programs.
documents: Class 10 & 12 Marksheets, College Admission Letter & Fee Structure, Aadhaar Card, Domicile Certificate, Co-applicant details.
answer_en: Bihar Student Credit Card offers up to ₹4 Lakh low-interest loan for higher education guaranteed by the government. Apply at your District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC).
answer_hi: बिहार स्टूडेंट क्रेडिट कार्ड योजना के तहत उच्च शिक्षा के लिए बिना किसी गारंटी के ₹4 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण मात्र 1% से 4% ब्याज पर मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Bihar Student Credit Card me graduation, engineering, MBA ke liye bina collateral ₹4 Lakh tak education loan milta hai DRCC center ke through.

name: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana
benefit: ₹10,00,000 total business support for new micro-enterprises: ₹5,00,000 100% grant/subsidy + ₹5,00,000 interest-free loan (1% for general men) repayable in 84 installments.
eligibility: Youth and women residents of Bihar aged 18 to 50 who have passed 10+2/Intermediate, ITI, or Diploma.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet, Caste Certificate, Domicile Certificate, Current Bank Account, Business Project Report.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana provides ₹10 Lakh (₹5 Lakh free grant + ₹5 Lakh interest-free loan) to set up micro-enterprises. Apply on udyami.bihar.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री उद्यमी योजना के तहत नया उद्योग शुरू करने के लिए ₹10 लाख मिलते हैं, जिसमें ₹5 लाख का मुफ्त अनुदान और ₹5 लाख का ब्याज मुक्त ऋण होता है।
answer_hinglish: Udyami Yojana Bihar me business shuru karne ke liye ₹10 Lakh package milta hai jisme ₹5 Lakh subsidy aur ₹5 Lakh interest-free loan hota hai.

name: Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal (Saat Nischay)
keywords: har ghar nal ka jal bihar
benefit: Free functional household tap connection providing clean, chlorinated drinking water directly to every rural and urban home.
eligibility: All households residing in villages, tolas, and urban wards across Bihar with zero connection charge.
documents: No documents required. Village Ward Implementation Committee executes connections.
answer_en: Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal guarantees safe, piped tap drinking water to every household in Bihar at zero upfront installation cost.
answer_hi: हर घर नल का जल योजना के तहत बिहार के प्रत्येक ग्रामीण और शहरी परिवार को घर में मुफ्त स्वच्छ पेयजल का नल कनेक्शन दिया गया है।
answer_hinglish: Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal scheme ke tehat Bihar ke sabhi households me clean piped drinking water tap free of cost provide kiya gaya hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana (MVPY)
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹400 for senior citizens aged 60 to 79, and ₹500 per month for super seniors aged 80 years and above.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60+ permanent residents of Bihar who do not receive any other government or EPF pension.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, Bank Passbook, Domicile Certificate.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension pays ₹400 to ₹500 monthly to all senior citizens aged 60+ regardless of caste or BPL status. Apply on sspmis.bihar.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री वृद्धजन पेंशन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के सभी बुजुर्गों को ₹400 से ₹500 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: MVPY Bihar me bina kisi caste ya BPL restriction ke sabhi 60+ senior citizens ko monthly ₹400-₹500 pension direct bank account me milti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta (MNSSBY)
benefit: ₹1,000 per month financial allowance for up to 2 years (total ₹24,000) for unemployed youth while searching for employment, plus free Kushal Yuva skill training.
eligibility: 12th pass unemployed youth aged 20 to 25 permanent residents of Bihar who are not pursuing regular higher education.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Domicile Certificate, Bank Account Details.
answer_en: Swayam Sahayata Bhatta provides ₹1,000/month for two years to unemployed 12th-pass youth in Bihar. Register at your District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC).
answer_hi: स्वयं सहायता भत्ता योजना के तहत 12वीं पास बेरोजगार युवाओं को 2 साल तक ₹1,000 प्रति माह (कुल ₹24,000) का बेरोजगारी भत्ता दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Swayam Sahayata Bhatta me 12th pass job-seeking youth ko 2 saal tak ₹1,000 per month financial aid aur free IT computer training milti hai.

name: Kushal Yuva Program (KYP)
benefit: 240 hours of completely free certified training in Basic Computer Skills (MS Office, Internet), English Communication, and Soft Skills.
eligibility: Youth aged 15 to 28 years (relaxable for SC/ST/OBC) who have passed Class 10 or 12 in Bihar.
documents: Class 10/12 Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Domicile Certificate.
answer_en: Kushal Yuva Program (KYP) trains school and college passouts in essential IT, computer literacy, and English communication at zero cost. Enroll at your local block KYP center.
answer_hi: कुशल युवा कार्यक्रम (KYP) के तहत 10वीं और 12वीं पास युवाओं को 240 घंटे का मुफ्त कंप्यूटर, अंग्रेजी और सॉफ्ट स्किल्स का प्रशिक्षण दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: KYP program me 10th/12th pass youth ko block level centers pe free computer diploma aur spoken English training provide ki jaati hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana (MGPY)
benefit: 50% subsidy up to ₹1,00,000 for purchasing 4 to 10-seater commercial passenger vehicles (e-rickshaws, magic, auto) to connect rural villages with block headquarters.
eligibility: SC, ST, and Extremely Backward Class (EBC) youth residing in rural panchayats of Bihar holding a valid commercial driving licence.
documents: Commercial Driving Licence, Caste Certificate, Domicile Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Vehicle Quotation.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana offers 50% subsidy up to ₹1 Lakh to purchase passenger vehicles for village-to-town transport. Apply on transport.bih.nic.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री ग्राम परिवहन योजना के तहत ग्रामीण युवाओं को 4 से 10 सीटर यात्री वाहन खरीदने के लिए 50% या ₹1 लाख तक की सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Gram Parivahan Yojana me passenger vehicle khareedne ke liye SC/ST aur EBC youth ko 50% (up to ₹1 Lakh) government subsidy milti hai.

name: Bihar Krishi Input Subsidy Scheme
benefit: Financial compensation for crop damage due to floods, drought, or hailstorms: ₹6,800/hectare for rainfed crops, ₹13,500/hectare for irrigated crops, and ₹18,000/hectare for perennial horticultural crops.
eligibility: Farmers and sharecroppers in disaster-notified blocks of Bihar who have suffered 33%+ crop damage.
documents: Land Receipt (LPC) or Sharecropper Declaration, Kisan Registration Number, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Bihar Krishi Input Subsidy compensates farmers up to ₹18,000/hectare for flood, drought, or unseasonal rain crop losses. Apply on dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in.
answer_hi: कृषि इनपुट अनुदान योजना के तहत बाढ़, सुखाड़ या ओलावृष्टि से 33% से अधिक फसल नुकसान होने पर किसानों को ₹6,800 से ₹18,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर मुआवजा दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Krishi Input Subsidy me flood ya drought se crop damage hone par farmers ko up to ₹18,000 per hectare direct relief amount milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Sahayata Yojana
benefit: Monthly financial stipend of ₹1,500 to children who lost parents until they turn 18 years, along with free residential education in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas.
eligibility: Orphaned children who lost both parents or single surviving parent, domiciled in Bihar.
documents: Death Certificates of parents, Child Birth Certificate/Aadhaar, Guardian Bank Account Details.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Bal Sahayata provides ₹1,500 monthly financial maintenance and free education to children who have lost their parents. Apply at the District Child Protection Unit.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री बाल सहायता योजना के तहत अनाथ बच्चों को 18 वर्ष की आयु तक ₹1,500 प्रति माह और कस्तूरबा गांधी विद्यालय में मुफ्त शिक्षा दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bal Sahayata Yojana me orphan bachhon ko 18 saal ki age tak ₹1,500 monthly stipend aur free residential school education milti hai.

name: Har Ghar Bijli Lagataar (Saat Nischay)
benefit: 100% free metered domestic electricity connection to all rural households with heavily subsidized power tariffs for agriculture and rural domestic consumers.
eligibility: All un-electrified households in rural and urban areas of Bihar.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Proof of Residence/Voter ID.
answer_en: Har Ghar Bijli ensures free domestic power connections across all rural and urban households in Bihar through North and South Bihar Power Distribution companies.
answer_hi: हर घर बिजली योजना के तहत बिहार के सभी ग्रामीण और शहरी परिवारों को मुफ्त घरेलू बिजली कनेक्शन उपलब्ध कराया गया है।
answer_hinglish: Har Ghar Bijli scheme me Bihar ke sabhi un-electrified homes ko meter ke sath free domestic connection provide kiya gaya hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya / Chiranjeevi Health Scheme
benefit: Massive cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year, plus ₹5,00,000 accidental insurance coverage.
eligibility: All families of Rajasthan holding a Jan Aadhaar Card (Free for NFSA, small farmers, and contractual workers; ₹850 premium for others).
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Chiranjeevi / Ayushman Arogya offers up to ₹25 Lakh free cashless treatment per family annually. Present your Jan Aadhaar Card at any network hospital.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री आयुष्मान आरोग्य (चिरंजीवी) योजना के तहत प्रत्येक परिवार को प्रति वर्ष ₹25 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज और ₹5 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Chiranjeevi scheme me Jan Aadhaar card holders ko hospital me saal ka ₹25 Lakh tak ka complete cashless medical treatment milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Bijli Yojana (100 Units Free)
benefit: Up to 100 units of free electricity every month for all domestic consumers, and 2,000 units free per month for agricultural pump connections.
eligibility: Domestic consumers consuming up to 100 units/month and registered farmers in Rajasthan holding Jan Aadhaar.
documents: Electricity Bill K Number, Jan Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Bijli grants 100 units of free domestic electricity monthly and 2,000 units free for agricultural pumps. Register on the Mehngai Rahat / Jan Soochna portal.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री निःशुल्क बिजली योजना के तहत घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को हर महीने 100 यूनिट और किसानों को 2,000 यूनिट तक मुफ्त बिजली मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Rajasthan Nishulk Bijli me domestic users ko 100 units free per month aur farmers ko 2000 units agricultural power completely free milti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Annapurna Food Packet Scheme
benefit: Free monthly food packet containing 1 kg Chana Dal, 1 kg Sugar, 1 kg Salt, 1 litre Soybean Edible Oil, 100g Chilli powder, 100g Coriander powder, and 50g Turmeric distributed with free NFSA wheat.
eligibility: All National Food Security Act (NFSA) ration card holder families in Rajasthan.
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card, Ration Card.
answer_en: Annapurna Food Packet scheme distributes free monthly edible oil, pulses, and spices packets alongside regular ration wheat to all NFSA families.
answer_hi: अन्नपूर्णा फूड पैकेट योजना के तहत राशन कार्ड धारकों को हर महीने दाल, चीनी, नमक, सोयाबीन तेल और मसाले का पैकेट बिल्कुल मुफ्त दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Annapurna Food Packet me NFSA ration families ko monthly dal, cooking oil, namak aur masale ka packet free ration shop se milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Bima Yojana
benefit: Free insurance coverage of ₹40,000 per milch animal (cow/buffalo), up to 2 milch animals per cattle-rearing family in case of untimely death.
eligibility: Cattle-rearing families in Rajasthan with annual income under ₹8 Lakh (100% free premium paid by government).
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card, Animal Tag Number, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Bima covers up to 2 milch cattle per family with ₹40,000 insurance each at zero premium. Apply at veterinary camps or Mehngai Rahat portal.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कामधेनु बीमा योजना के तहत प्रति परिवार 2 दुधारू पशुओं (गाय/भैंस) का ₹40,000 प्रति पशु का मुफ्त बीमा कराया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Kamdhenu Bima me 2 milch cows/buffaloes ke liye per animal ₹40,000 ka complete free insurance cover milta hai cattle owners ko.

name: Rajasthan Samajik Suraksha Pension Scheme
benefit: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 with statutory 15% automatic annual increment for elderly, widows, single women, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Senior citizens (women 55+, men 58+), destitute widows, and disabled citizens resident in Rajasthan with income under ₹48,000/year.
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card, Age proof, Bank Account details.
answer_en: Rajasthan Samajik Suraksha Pension guarantees a minimum of ₹1,000 per month with an automatic 15% yearly hike to elderly, widows, and disabled citizens. Apply via e-Mitra.
answer_hi: सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन योजना के तहत बुजुर्गों, विधवाओं और दिव्यांगों को न्यूनतम ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन 15% वार्षिक स्वतः वृद्धि के साथ दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Rajasthan Samajik Suraksha Pension me minimum ₹1,000/month pension guaranteed milti hai har saal 15% increment ke sath via Jan Aadhaar.

name: Palanhar Yojana
benefit: Monthly foster care allowance of ₹750/month (ages 0-6) and ₹1,500/month (ages 6-18) for children of widows; ₹1,500 to ₹2,500/month for orphans, plus ₹2,000 annual cloth/shoe grant.
eligibility: Orphan children, children of widows, incarcerated parents, or disabled parents living in foster families in Rajasthan.
documents: Death Certificate of parent / Disability Certificate, School Admission Certificate, Jan Aadhaar Card, Palanhar Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Palanhar Yojana provides up to ₹2,500 monthly grant to caregivers looking after orphan children or children of widows to cover schooling and nutrition. Apply on e-Mitra.
answer_hi: पालनहार योजना के तहत अनाथ और विधवाओं के बच्चों के लालन-पालन और शिक्षा के लिए ₹1,500 से ₹2,500 प्रति माह और ₹2,000 वार्षिक वस्त्र सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Palanhar Yojana me orphan aur widow children ki education aur care ke liye foster parents ko ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 monthly support milta hai.

name: Indira Rasoi / Annapurna Rasoi Yojana
benefit: Wholesome, hot nutritious thali containing 100g Dal, 100g Vegetables, 250g Chapati, and pickles served with dignity in air-conditioned dining halls for only ₹8.
eligibility: Open to all citizens, labourers, students, and attendants with no documents needed.
documents: No documents needed. Direct walk-in.
answer_en: Indira / Annapurna Rasoi serves hot, hygienic thali meals with dal, vegetables, and chapatis for just ₹8 across 1,000+ canteens in Rajasthan.
answer_hi: इंदिरा रसोई योजना के तहत 'कोई भूखा न सोए' संकल्प के साथ मात्र ₹8 में सम्मानपूर्वक बैठाकर पौष्टिक गरम भोजन कराया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Indira Rasoi canteens me koi bhi citizen sirf ₹8 me complete hygienic dal, sabzi aur chapati thali kha sakta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Dawa & Jaanch Yojana
benefit: 100% free essential medicines (over 1,800 medicines) and 100% free diagnostic laboratory tests (blood, CT Scan, MRI, X-Ray) in all government hospitals and clinics.
eligibility: All indoor and outdoor patients visiting government health centres, sub-centres, and medical colleges in Rajasthan.
documents: Hospital OPD / IPD Slip, Jan Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Dawa & Jaanch provides completely free medicines and diagnostic tests (including MRI and CT scan) across all Rajasthan government hospitals.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री निःशुल्क दवा और जांच योजना के तहत सभी सरकारी अस्पतालों में ओपीडी और आईपीडी के सभी मरीजों को दवाएं और सभी जांचें 100% मुफ्त मिलती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Rajasthan Nishulk Dawa & Jaanch me government hospitals me 1,800+ medicines aur CT Scan, MRI jaise costly tests 100% free hote hain.

name: Kalibai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana
benefit: 100% free motorized scooty, helmet, 2 litres petrol, and 5 years third-party insurance awarded to meritorious girl students.
eligibility: Girl students belonging to SC, ST, EBC, Minority, and General EWS scoring 65%+ in Class 12 enrolling in regular higher education.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet, College Bonafide Certificate, Jan Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence / Learner's Licence.
answer_en: Kalibai Scooty Scheme awards free motorized scooties with insurance to meritorious girl students passing Class 12 with 65%+ marks. Apply on hte.rajasthan.gov.in.
answer_hi: कालीबाई भील मेधावी छात्रा स्कूटी योजना के तहत 12वीं में 65% या अधिक अंक लाने वाली मेधावी छात्राओं को कॉलेज जाने के लिए मुफ्त स्कूटी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kalibai Scooty scheme me 12th pass meritorious girls ko higher education attend karne ke liye free scooty aur 5-year insurance milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (Berojgari Bhatta)
benefit: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹4,000 for male graduates and ₹4,500 for women, disabled, and transgender graduates for up to two years.
eligibility: Unemployed graduates domicile of Rajasthan aged 21 to 30 years (35 for reserved categories) with family income under ₹2 Lakh.
documents: Graduation Degree, Jan Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, 3-month Skill Training Certificate, 4 hours/day daily internship.
answer_en: Yuva Sambal gives ₹4,000/month to male and ₹4,500/month to female graduates in Rajasthan during job searches. Apply on the Employment Department portal.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री युवा संबल योजना के तहत बेरोजगार युवाओं को ₹4,000 और युवतियों/दिव्यांगों को ₹4,500 प्रति माह बेरोजगारी भत्ता 2 साल तक दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Yuva Sambal scheme me unemployed graduates ko ₹4,000 (boys) aur ₹4,500 (girls) monthly unemployment allowance milta hai.

name: Indira Gandhi Free Smartphone Yojana
benefit: Free 4G/5G smartphone with 3 years of 100% free internet data (20 GB/month) and unlimited calling for women heads of families and girl students.
eligibility: Female heads of Chiranjeevi families, single women/widow pensioners, and girls in Class 9-12 or college in Rajasthan.
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card, Aadhaar Card, Pension PPO or College ID Card, Active Mobile Number.
answer_en: Indira Gandhi Smartphone scheme provides free branded smartphones with 3 years of complimentary data and calling to women and girl students in Rajasthan.
answer_hi: इंदिरा गांधी स्मार्टफोन योजना के तहत महिलाओं और छात्राओं को 3 साल के मुफ्त इंटरनेट डेटा और कॉलिंग के साथ मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Indira Gandhi Smartphone scheme me women aur girl students ko free smartphone ke sath 3 saal tak free internet data milta hai.

name: Vahli Dikri Yojana
benefit: Total financial assistance of ₹1,10,000 for girl child: ₹4,000 in Class 1, ₹6,000 in Class 9, and ₹1,00,000 at age 18 for higher education or marriage.
eligibility: First and second girl children born in Gujarat families with annual income up to ₹2,00,000.
documents: Birth Certificate, Parents' Aadhaar Cards, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Vahli Dikri Yojana supports a girl child's education and future with ₹1,10,000 in stages from primary school to age 18. Apply at your local Anganwadi or Taluka Mamlatdar office.
answer_gu: વ્હાલી દીકરી યોજના હેઠળ દીકરીના જન્મથી ૧૮ વર્ષની ઉંમર સુધી તબક્કાવાર કુલ ₹૧,૧૦,૦૦૦ ની નાણાકીય સહાય આપવામાં આવે છે.
answer_hi: व्हाली डिकरी योजना के तहत गरीब परिवारों की बेटियों को कक्षा 1 से 18 वर्ष की आयु तक कुल ₹1,10,000 की वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Vahli Dikri scheme me girl child ko Class 1, Class 9 aur 18 years age par total ₹1.10 Lakh support milta hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
benefit: 50% tuition fee assistance (up to ₹2,00,000/year for Medical/Dental, ₹50,000 for Engineering/Pharmacy, ₹10,000 for Diploma) plus ₹12,000/year hostel/food allowance.
eligibility: Students passing Class 10/12 with 80%+ percentile enrolling in higher education with family annual income under ₹6 Lakh.
documents: Class 10/12 Marksheet & Percentile Certificate, College Admission & Fee Receipt, Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: MYSY covers 50% tuition fees up to ₹2 Lakh/year for medical and engineering college students. Apply online on mysy.guj.nic.in.
answer_gu: મુખ્યમંત્રી યુવા સ્વાવલંબન યોજના (MYSY) હેઠળ મેડિકલ, એન્જિનિયરિંગ અને ડિપ્લોમાના વિદ્યાર્થીઓને ૫૦% ટ્યુશન ફી સહાય (વાર્ષિક ₹૨ લાખ સુધી) મળે છે.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री युवा स्वावलंबन योजना (MYSY) के तहत मेडिकल और इंजीनियरिंग छात्रों को 50% तक ट्यूशन फीस (₹2 लाख तक) की सहायता मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: MYSY scholarship me 80+ percentile students ko medical, engineering college fee pe 50% subsidy aur hostel allowance milta hai.

name: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana (Daytime Farm Power)
benefit: Guaranteed 8 hours of daytime 3-phase agricultural electricity (between 5:00 AM and 9:00 PM) replacing nighttime irrigation hardship.
eligibility: All farmers with registered agricultural power connections with GUVNL distribution companies (UGVCL, DGVCL, MGVCL, PGVCL).
documents: Electricity Consumer Number, 7/12 Land Record, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Kisan Suryodaya ensures farmers get 8 hours of dependable 3-phase power during daylight hours so they don't have to irrigate at night. Implemented automatically by power DISCOMs.
answer_gu: કિસાન સૂર્યોદય યોજના હેઠળ ખેડૂતોને રાત્રે પાણી વાળવાની મુશ્કેલીમાંથી મુક્તિ આપીને દિવસે સવારે ૫ થી રાત્રે ૯ વાગ્યા સુધી ૮ કલાક વીજળી અપાય છે.
answer_hi: किसान सूर्योदय योजना के तहत गुजरात के किसानों को रात में नहीं, बल्कि दिन में सुबह 5 बजे से रात 9 बजे के बीच 8 घंटे 3-फेज कृषि बिजली दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kisan Suryodaya scheme me farmers ko nighttime irrigation se chhutkara de kar daytime me 8 hours uninterrupted 3-phase power di jaati hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana (MMUY)
benefit: 100% interest-free loans of ₹1,00,000 to Joint Liability Earning Groups (JLEG) of 10 women to launch micro-businesses, with all interest paid by the state.
eligibility: Groups of 10 women aged 18 to 56 residing in Gujarat willing to start self-employment ventures.
documents: Group Formation Resolution, Aadhaar cards of all 10 members, Bank Passbook, Ration Card.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh provides ₹1,00,000 zero-interest loan to women groups for starting small businesses. Inquire at your local Municipality or Taluka Panchayat.
answer_gu: મુખ્યમંત્રી મહિલા ઉત્કર્ષ યોજના હેઠળ ૧૦ બહેનોના જૂથને નાના વ્યવસાય શરૂ કરવા માટે ₹૧,૦૦,૦૦૦ નું ૦% વ્યાજે લોન આપવામાં આવે છે.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री महिला उत्कर्ष योजना के तहत 10 महिलाओं के समूह को बिना किसी ब्याज के ₹1 लाख का व्यवसाय ऋण दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: MMUY me 10 women ke Self Help Groups ko business setup ke liye ₹1 Lakh ka 100% zero interest loan milta hai.

name: Ganga Swarupa (Widow Pension) Scheme
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,250 deposited directly into the widow's bank account on the first of every month via DBT.
eligibility: Widowed women residing in Gujarat with annual income under ₹1,20,000 (rural) or ₹1,50,000 (urban).
documents: Husband's Death Certificate, Age Proof, Income Certificate from Mamlatdar, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Ganga Swarupa scheme provides ₹1,250 per month pension to widows in Gujarat directly into their bank accounts. Apply on the Digital Gujarat portal.
answer_gu: ગંગા સ્વરૂપા યોજના હેઠળ વિધવા બહેનોને સન્માનપૂર્વક જીવન જીવવા માટે દર મહિને ₹૧,૨૫૦ નું માસિક પેન્શન સીધું બેંક ખાતામાં આપવામાં આવે છે.
answer_hi: गंगा स्वरूपा योजना के तहत विधवा महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹1,250 की सम्मान पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Ganga Swarupa scheme me widow women ko har mahine ₹1,250 direct bank transfer milta hai Digital Gujarat portal ke zariye.

name: Kunwarbai Nu Mameru Scheme
benefit: Financial grant of ₹12,000 directly transferred into the bride's bank account to support marriage expenses.
eligibility: Daughters of SC, ST, and SEBC (OBC) families resident in Gujarat with family annual income under ₹1,20,000 (rural) or ₹1,50,000 (urban).
documents: Bride & Groom Age Proof/Marriage Certificate, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Bride Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Kunwarbai Nu Mameru provides ₹12,000 financial support for daughter's marriage to SC, ST, and OBC families. Apply on the e-Samaj Kalyan portal.
answer_gu: કુંવરબાઈનું મામેરું યોજના હેઠળ અનુસૂચિત જાતિ અને પછાત વર્ગની દીકરીઓના લગ્ન પ્રસંગે ₹૧૨,૦૦૦ ની આર્થિક સહાય બેંક ખાતામાં ચૂકવાય છે.
answer_hi: कुंवरबाई नु मामेरू योजना के तहत गरीब कन्याओं के विवाह के लिए ₹12,000 की वित्तीय सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kunwarbai Nu Mameru me daughter ki marriage ke liye government ₹12,000 direct bank grant deti hai via e-Samaj Kalyan portal.

name: Saat Pagla Khedut Kalyan Scheme
benefit: Comprehensive 7-step package: ₹900/month (₹10,800/yr) for maintaining indigenous Desi Cow for organic farming, ₹30,000 for on-farm godowns, fencing subsidy, and free smart toolkits.
eligibility: Farmers of Gujarat practicing natural/cow-based farming and registered on the i-Khedut portal.
documents: 8-A / 7/12 Land Records, Cow Tag ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Saat Pagla Khedut Kalyan offers ₹900/month for rearing an indigenous cow, ₹30,000 godown subsidies, and farm fencing on the i-Khedut portal.
answer_gu: સાત પગલાં ખેડૂત કલ્યાણ યોજના હેઠળ પ્રાકૃતિક ખેતી માટે દેશી ગાયના નિભાવ ખર્ચ પેટે મહિને ₹૯૦૦ (વાર્ષિક ₹૧૦,૮૦૦) અને ખેત ગોડાઉન સહાય મળે છે.
answer_hi: सात पगला खेड़ूत कल्याण योजना के तहत देसी गाय पालने पर ₹900 प्रति माह (₹10,800 सालाना) और खेत में गोदाम बनाने के लिए ₹30,000 दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Saat Pagla Khedut scheme me organic cow farming ke liye ₹900/month maintenance grant aur godown subsidies milti hain i-Khedut portal pe.

name: Shramik Annapurna Yojana
benefit: Wholesome, hot and nutritious meal thali containing chapatis, subzi, dal, rice, and sweet/pickle for only ₹5 per meal at Kadia Nakas (labour muster points).
eligibility: Construction and unorganized building workers holding an e-Nirman card registered with the Building & Other Construction Workers Board.
documents: e-Nirman Shramik Card or U-WIN Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Shramik Annapurna serves full hot nutritious meals for just ₹5 at Kadia Nakas across Gujarat cities to construction and daily wage workers.
answer_gu: શ્રમિક અન્નપૂર્ણા યોજના હેઠળ કડિયા નાકા પર બાંધકામ શ્રમિકોને માત્ર ₹૫ માં ગરમ, પૌષ્ટિક અને ગુણવત્તાયુક્ત ભોજન પીરસવામાં આવે છે.
answer_hi: श्रमिक अन्नपूर्णा योजना के तहत निर्माण मजदूरों को कडिया नाकों पर मात्र ₹5 में भरपेट गरम और पौष्टिक भोजन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Shramik Annapurna scheme me registered construction workers ko har subah sirf ₹5 me complete nutritious plate lunch milta hai.

name: Namo Saraswati Vigyan Sadhana Scheme
benefit: ₹25,000 total scholarship for students studying Class 11 and 12 in the Science stream (₹1,000/month for 10 months in class 11, ₹1,000/month in class 12, plus ₹5,000 upon passing board exams).
eligibility: Students in Gujarat enrolling in Class 11 Science stream from families with income under ₹6 Lakh.
documents: Class 10 Marksheet, School Admission Proof (Science Stream), Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Namo Saraswati grants ₹25,000 scholarship to Class 11 and 12 Science stream students to promote STEM careers. Apply via your school headmaster.
answer_gu: નમો સરસ્વતી વિજ્ઞાન સાધના યોજના હેઠળ ધોરણ ૧૧ અને ૧૨ વિજ્ઞાન પ્રવાહ (સાયન્સ) માં અભ્યાસ કરતા વિદ્યાર્થીઓને કુલ ₹૨૫,૦૦૦ ની શિષ્યવૃત્તિ આપવામાં આવે છે.
answer_hi: नमो सरस्वती योजना के तहत 11वीं और 12वीं में साइंस स्ट्रीम (विज्ञान) लेने वाले छात्र-छात्राओं को ₹25,000 की कुल छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Namo Saraswati scheme me 11th-12th Science stream students ko STEM studies encourage karne ke liye ₹25,000 total scholarship milti hai.

name: Namo Lakshmi Yojana
benefit: Total financial assistance of ₹50,000 for girl students studying in classes 9 to 12 (₹10,000/year for classes 9 & 10; ₹15,000/year for classes 11 & 12) via DBT.
eligibility: Girl students studying in Classes 9 to 12 in government, granted, and private secondary schools in Gujarat with family income under ₹6 Lakh.
documents: School Admission Record, Aadhaar Card, Parent Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Namo Lakshmi awards ₹50,000 total scholarship across classes 9-12 to girl students in Gujarat to prevent dropout. Distributed directly into bank accounts via schools.
answer_gu: નમો લક્ષ્મી યોજના હેઠળ ધોરણ ૯ થી ૧૨ માં ભણતી દીકરીઓને અભ્યાસ ચાલુ રાખવા માટે વાર્ષિક ધોરણે કુલ ₹૫૦,૦૦૦ ની નાણાકીય સહાય મળે છે.
answer_hi: नमो लक्ष्मी योजना के तहत कक्षा 9 से 12 तक पढ़ने वाली छात्राओं को स्कूल छोड़ने से रोकने के लिए कुल ₹50,000 की छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Namo Lakshmi scheme me Class 9 to 12 girls ko continuous education support ke liye total ₹50,000 cash scholarship milti hai.

name: Manav Garima Yojana
benefit: 100% free professional toolkits worth up to ₹25,000 for 28 traditional trades (tailoring, embroidery, plumbing, carpentry, beauty parlour, masonry) without needing any bank loans.
eligibility: Artisans and labourers in Gujarat aged 18 to 60 with annual family income under ₹1,20,000 (rural) or ₹1,50,000 (urban).
documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, Trade Skill Proof.
answer_en: Manav Garima awards free professional equipment and toolkits up to ₹25,000 for 28 trades to start your own business. Apply on the e-Kutir portal (ekutir.gujarat.gov.in).
answer_gu: માનવ ગરિમા યોજના હેઠળ દરજીકામ, પ્લમ્બિંગ, બ્યુટી પાર્લર જેવા ૨૮ વ્યવસાયો માટે ₹૨૫,૦૦૦ સુધીની સાધન કીટ (ટૂલકીટ) વિનામૂલ્યે આપવામાં આવે છે.
answer_hi: मानव गरिमा योजना के तहत सिलाई, ब्यूटी पार्लर, बढ़ई और प्लंबर जैसे 28 व्यवसायों के लिए ₹25,000 तक की मुफ्त टूलकिट दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Manav Garima scheme me 28 trades (sewing machine, parlour, plumbing) ke liye up to ₹25,000 ki toolkits 100% free milti hain e-Kutir portal pe.

name: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
benefit: Total financial assistance of ₹50,000 provided over 5 years (₹10,000 per year in 2 installments of ₹5,000 on Rakhi Purnima and International Women's Day) directly to women.
eligibility: Women aged 21 to 60 years permanent residents of Odisha covered under NFSA/SFSS ration cards or with family annual income under ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: Aadhaar Card with mobile linkage, Ration Card, Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Subhadra Yojana provides ₹50,000 over 5 years (₹10,000 yearly in two installments) to women in Odisha. Apply via Mo Seva Kendra or subhadra.odisha.gov.in.
answer_or: ସୁଭଦ୍ରା ଯୋଜନା ଅଧୀନରେ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ମହିଳାମାନଙ୍କୁ ୫ ବର୍ଷରେ ମୋଟ ₹୫୦,୦୦୦ (ବର୍ଷକୁ ₹୧୦,୦୦୦ ଦୁଇଟି କିସ୍ତିରେ) ସିଧାସଳଖ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାରେ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରାଯାଏ।
answer_hi: सुभद्रा योजना के तहत ओडिशा की महिलाओं को 5 वर्षों में कुल ₹50,000 (प्रति वर्ष ₹10,000 दो किस्तों में) की सीधी वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Subhadra Yojana me Odisha ki eligible women ko 5 years me total ₹50,000 (₹10,000 yearly) financial aid direct bank account me milti hai.

name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY / Gopabandhu Jan Arogya)
benefit: Cashless hospital treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year, and enhanced coverage up to ₹10,00,000 for female family members across 800+ top private hospitals.
eligibility: Families residing in Odisha holding BSKY Smart Health Cards, NFSA, or SFSS Ration Cards.
documents: BSKY Card, Ration Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: BSKY provides up to ₹5 Lakh healthcare per family and ₹10 Lakh for women members annually across top private hospitals. Present your BSKY card at any empanelled hospital.
answer_or: ବିଜୁ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ କଲ୍ୟାଣ ଯୋଜନାରେ ପରିବାର ପିଛା ବାର୍ଷିକ ₹୫ ଲକ୍ଷ ଏବଂ ମହିଳାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ₹୧୦ ଲକ୍ଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମାଗଣା କ୍ୟାସଲେସ୍ ଚିକିତ୍ସା ସୁବିଧା ମିଳେ।
answer_hi: बीएसकेवाई योजना के तहत प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख और महिला सदस्यों के लिए ₹10 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज निजी अस्पतालों में मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: BSKY health scheme me family ko ₹5 Lakh aur female members ko ₹10 Lakh per year tak free cashless hospital care milta hai.

name: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana (MBPY)
benefit: Enhanced monthly pension: ₹1,000 per month for beneficiaries aged up to 79, and ₹1,200 per month for seniors aged 80 years and above or severe disabilities.
eligibility: Senior citizens (60+), destitute widows, persons with disabilities, leprosy patients, and transgender persons in Odisha with family income under ₹24,000/year.
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Disability Certificate, BPL Card, Bank Account.
answer_en: Madhu Babu Pension provides ₹1,000 to ₹1,200 monthly pension to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities in Odisha. Apply at your Block Development Office or ssepd.gov.in.
answer_or: ମଧୁ ବାବୁ ପେନସନ ଯୋଜନା ଅଧୀନରେ ବୃଦ୍ଧ, ବିଧବା ଓ ଭିନ୍ନକ୍ଷମମାନଙ୍କୁ ମାସିକ ₹୧,୦୦୦ ରୁ ₹୧,୨୦୦ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସାମାଜିକ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପେନସନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରାଯାଏ।
answer_hi: मधु बाबू पेंशन योजना के तहत बुजुर्गों, विधवाओं और दिव्यांगों को ₹1,000 से ₹1,200 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Madhu Babu Pension me 60+ seniors, widows aur disabled persons ko ₹1,000 to ₹1,200 per month pension milti hai.

name: Mo Ghara (Rural Housing Credit Subsidy)
benefit: Bank housing loans up to ₹3,00,000 with upfront government capital subsidy up to ₹60,000 (₹70,000 for SC/ST and PwD) to construct or upgrade pucca houses.
eligibility: Rural families in Odisha living in kutcha houses or having incomplete pucca houses with monthly family income under ₹25,000.
documents: RoR Land Record, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Bank Account.
answer_en: Mo Ghara provides bank home loans up to ₹3 Lakh with up to ₹70,000 direct government capital subsidy to build pucca houses. Apply online on moghara.odisha.gov.in.
answer_or: ମୋ ଘର ଯୋଜନା ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ପକ୍କା ଘର ନିର୍ମାଣ ପାଇଁ ₹୩ ଲକ୍ଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଋଣ ଏବଂ ସରକାରଙ୍କ ତରଫରୁ ₹୭୦,୦୦୦ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସବସିଡି ପ୍ରଦାନ କରାଯାଏ।
answer_hi: मो घरा योजना के तहत पक्का घर बनाने के लिए ₹3 लाख तक का बैंक ऋण और ₹70,000 तक की सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Mo Ghara scheme me rural house construction ke liye ₹3 Lakh bank loan ke sath up to ₹70,000 government cash subsidy milti hai.

name: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana (Free Laptop)
benefit: Free high-configuration laptops (or ₹30,000 direct bank transfer in lieu of laptop) awarded to top 15,000 meritorious students passing Class 12 exams.
eligibility: Students passing Class 12 (Arts, Science, Commerce, Vocational) in Odisha securing top merit ranks in CHSE exams.
documents: Class 12 CHSE Marksheet, Admit Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran awards free laptops or ₹30,000 DBT to top meritorious students passing Class 12 in Odisha. Distributed via college nodal centres.
answer_or: ବିଜୁ ଯୁବ ସଶକ୍ତୀକରଣ ଯୋଜନାରେ ଯୁକ୍ତ ଦୁଇ (CHSE) ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ ଉତ୍ତୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହୋଇଥିବା ମେଧାବୀ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ମାଗଣା ଲାପଟପ୍ କିମ୍ବା ₹୩୦,୦୦୦ ଡିବିଟି ପ୍ରଦାନ କରାଯାଏ।
answer_hi: बीजू युवा सशक्तिकरण योजना के तहत 12वीं में अव्वल रहने वाले मेधावी छात्रों को मुफ्त लैपटॉप या ₹30,000 की नकद राशि दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran me Class 12 merit students ko free laptop ya ₹30,000 direct bank transfer milta hai higher studies ke liye.

name: Odisha Mamata Scheme
benefit: Conditional cash transfer of ₹5,000 deposited in 2 installments directly into pregnant and lactating mothers' bank accounts to improve nutrition.
eligibility: Pregnant women aged 19+ delivering up to two live births, resident in Odisha (except government employees).
documents: Mother & Child Tracking MCP Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Mamata Scheme provides ₹5,000 cash assistance to pregnant and nursing mothers in Odisha for maternal and child nutrition. Register at your local Anganwadi center.
answer_or: ମମତା ଯୋଜନା ଅଧୀନରେ ଗର୍ଭବତୀ ଓ ପ୍ରସୂତି ମହିଳାମାନଙ୍କ ପୁଷ୍ଟିକର ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ₹୫,୦୦୦ ର ଆର୍ଥିକ ସହାୟତା ଦୁଇଟି କିସ୍ତିରେ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାରେ ଦିଆଯାଏ।
answer_hi: ममता योजना के तहत गर्भवती और धात्री महिलाओं को बेहतर पोषण के लिए ₹5,000 की वित्तीय सहायता दो किस्तों में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Mamata scheme me pregnant aur lactating mothers ko Anganwadi registration pe ₹5,000 direct bank support milta hai.

name: Odisha Millets Mission
benefit: Incentive of up to ₹12,500 per hectare over 5 years for farmers cultivating finger millet (Mandia) and small millets, plus assured procurement at MSP.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating millets in notified blocks of Odisha registered through local Community Resource Persons (CRPs).
documents: Farmer Registration ID, Land Records, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Odisha Millets Mission rewards millet cultivators with up to ₹12,500/hectare incentives and guaranteed government procurement at MSP.
answer_or: ଓଡ଼ିଶା ମିଲେଟ୍ ମିଶନ ଅଧୀନରେ ମାଣ୍ଡିଆ ଓ କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ଶସ୍ୟ ଚାଷୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ହେକ୍ଟର ପିଛା ₹୧୨,୫୦୦ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରୋତ୍ସାହନ ରାଶି ଏବଂ ସରକାରୀ ମଣ୍ଡିରେ ଏମଏସପିରେ କ୍ରୟ ସୁବିଧା ମିଳେ।
answer_hi: ओडिशा मिलेट मिशन के तहत रागी और मोटे अनाज उगाने वाले किसानों को ₹12,500 प्रति हेक्टेयर तक का प्रोत्साहन और एमएसपी पर खरीद की गारंटी मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Odisha Millets Mission me Mandia (Ragi) cultivate karne par farmers ko ₹12,500 per hectare incentive aur MSP procurement guarantee milti hai.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhabruti Chhatrabruti
benefit: Annual merit scholarship of ₹5,000 (Junior), ₹10,000 (Undergraduate degree), and ₹10,000 (Technical/Professional courses) directly into students' accounts.
eligibility: Meritorious students resident of Odisha pursuing post-matric courses whose parents' annual income is under ₹6 Lakh.
documents: Class 10/12 Marksheets, College Bonafide Certificate, Income Certificate under ₹6L, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Medhabruti provides up to ₹10,000 annual scholarship for undergraduate and professional course students in Odisha. Apply on scholarship.odisha.gov.in.
answer_or: ମୁଖ୍ୟମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ମେଧାବୃତ୍ତି ଯୋଜନା ଅଧୀନରେ ଯୁକ୍ତ ଦୁଇ, ଯୁକ୍ତ ତିନି ଏବଂ ବୈଷୟିକ ଶିକ୍ଷା ପଢ଼ୁଥିବା ମେଧାବୀ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କୁ ବାର୍ଷିକ ₹୧୦,୦୦୦ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବୃତ୍ତି ପ୍ରଦାନ କରାଯାଏ।
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मेधावृत्ति योजना के तहत स्नातक और व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों के मेधावी छात्रों को ₹10,000 वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Medhabruti scheme me college aur professional course students ko ₹10,000 annual scholarship direct bank transfer milti hai State Scholarship Portal pe.

name: Aahar Canteens Scheme
benefit: Hot wholesome meal consisting of cooked rice and nutritious Dalma (lentils cooked with fresh vegetables) served for only ₹5 per plate.
eligibility: Open to all citizens, hospital attendants, bus stand travellers, and daily labourers across 168+ Aahar centres in Odisha.
documents: No documents required. Direct walk-in.
answer_en: Aahar Canteens provide hygienic hot meals of Rice and Dalma for just ₹5 at major bus stands, railway stations, and hospitals across Odisha.
answer_or: ଆହାର ଯୋଜନା ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ହସ୍ପିଟାଲ, ବସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡ ଓ ସହରାଞ୍ଚଳରେ ମାତ୍ର ₹୫ ରେ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ଭାତ ଓ ଡାଲମା ଗରିବ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଯୋଗାଇ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି।
answer_hi: आहार योजना के तहत रेलवे स्टेशनों, बस अड्डों और अस्पतालों के पास मात्र ₹5 में शुद्ध चावल और दालमा का गरम भोजन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Aahar Canteens me hospital attendants aur daily wage earners ko sirf ₹5 me complete hot rice aur dalma meal milti hai.

name: Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar & Welfare
benefit: Housing assistance of ₹1,50,000 for building a pucca house, ₹50,000 for daughter's marriage, ₹4,00,000 death compensation, and ₹8,000 bi-cycle/toolkit grant.
eligibility: Registered building and construction workers in Odisha having completed at least 90 days of work in the preceding year.
documents: Nirman Shramik Registration Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Possession Certificate (for housing).
answer_en: Nirman Shramik Kalyan provides ₹1.5 Lakh housing grant, ₹50,000 marriage support, and ₹4 Lakh death compensation to registered construction workers in Odisha.
answer_or: ନିର୍ମାଣ ଶ୍ରମିକ କଲ୍ୟାଣ ଯୋଜନାରେ ପଞ୍ଜୀକୃତ ଶ୍ରମିକମାନଙ୍କୁ ଘର ତିଆରି ପାଇଁ ₹୧.୫ ଲକ୍ଷ, ଝିଅ ବିବାହ ପାଇଁ ₹୫୦,୦୦୦ ଏବଂ ଦୁର୍ଘଟଣା ମୃତ୍ୟୁରେ ₹୪ ଲକ୍ଷ ସହାୟତା ମିଳେ।
answer_hi: निर्माण श्रमिक कल्याण योजना के तहत पंजीकृत निर्माण मजदूरों को घर बनाने के लिए ₹1.5 लाख और बेटी के विवाह के लिए ₹50,000 की सहायता मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Nirman Shramik scheme me registered construction workers ko pucca house ke liye ₹1.5 Lakh aur beti ki marriage pe ₹50,000 grant milta hai.

name: Ama Odisha Nabin Odisha
benefit: ₹50,00,000 direct village development grant per Gram Panchayat to upgrade Jagannath heritage culture, primary schools, internet connectivity, and women SHG hubs.
eligibility: All Gram Panchayats and rural residents across all 30 districts of Odisha.
documents: Gram Sabha Resolution, Community Project Proposals.
answer_en: Ama Odisha Nabin Odisha grants ₹50 Lakh to every Gram Panchayat to build high-speed internet, community skill centres, and preserve local heritage. Inquire with your Sarpanch.
answer_or: ଆମ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ନବୀନ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ଯୋଜନାରେ ପ୍ରତିଟି ଗ୍ରାମ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତକୁ ଗାଁର ଉନ୍ନତି, ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଭିତ୍ତିଭୂମି ଓ ଐତିହ୍ୟ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ ପାଇଁ ₹୫୦ ଲକ୍ଷ ଅନୁଦାନ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି।
answer_hi: आम ओडिशा नबीन ओडिशा योजना के तहत प्रत्येक ग्राम पंचायत को डिजिटल विकास और बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए ₹50 लाख का सीधा अनुदान दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Ama Odisha Nabin Odisha scheme me har Gram Panchayat ko digital infra aur community center banane ke liye ₹50 Lakh grant milta hai.

name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP)
benefit: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care in government and empaneled private hospitals.
eligibility: BPL families and low-income households in Kerala holding Pink/Yellow ration cards.
documents: Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, KASP Health Card.
answer_en: KASP provides up to ₹5 Lakh free cashless treatment per family annually across Kerala hospitals. Present your KASP/Ration card at empanelled hospital helpdesks.
answer_ml: കാരുണ്യ ആരോഗ്യ സുരക്ഷാ പദ്ധതി (KASP) വഴി ഗുണഭോക്തൃ കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്ക് പ്രതിവർഷം ₹5 ലക്ഷം രൂപയുടെ സൗജന്യ കാഷ്‌ലെസ്സ് ചികിത്സ ലഭിക്കുന്നു. റേഷൻ കാർഡും ആധാറുമായി ആശുപത്രിയെ സമീപിക്കുക.
answer_hi: कारुण्य आरोग्य सुरक्षा पद्धति (KASP) के तहत केरल के पात्र परिवारों को हर साल ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: KASP health scheme me family ko saal me ₹5 Lakh tak ka free cashless hospital treatment milta hai government aur empanelled hospitals me.

name: LIFE Mission (Livelihood Inclusion and Financial Empowerment)
benefit: ₹4,00,000 direct financial grant for homeless people owning land to build a 400 sq.ft pucca house, or free flat in housing complexes for landless homeless.
eligibility: Homeless and landless families residing in Kerala identified through the local self-government survey.
documents: Land Title Deed, Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate.
answer_en: Kerala LIFE Mission provides ₹4 Lakh to construct a pucca house for homeless citizens with land, and free apartment complexes for the landless. Apply at your Grama Panchayat or Municipality.
answer_ml: ലൈഫ് മിഷൻ പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ സ്വന്തമായി സ്ഥലമുള്ള ഭവനരഹിതർക്ക് ₹4 ലക്ഷം രൂപ വീട് വെയ്ക്കാൻ നൽകുന്നു. ഭൂരഹിത ഭവനരഹിതർക്ക് സൗജന്യ ഫ്ലാറ്റുകളും നിർമ്മിച്ചു നൽകുന്നു.
answer_hi: लाइफ मिशन योजना के तहत बेघर परिवारों को पक्का मकान बनाने के लिए ₹4 लाख का अनुदान और भूमिहीनों को मुफ्त फ्लैट दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: LIFE Mission me homeless families ko pucca ghar banane ke liye ₹4 Lakh direct grant ya free residential flat provide kiya jaata hai.

name: Kudumbashree Mission (Microcredit & Livelihood)
benefit: Collateral-free low-interest microcredit loans up to ₹20,00,000 per Neighborhood Group (NHG) for enterprise, organic farming, canteens, and micro-industries with interest subsidies.
eligibility: Women aged 18+ resident in Kerala participating in Kudumbashree Neighborhood Groups (NHGs).
documents: Kudumbashree NHG Membership Card, Aadhaar Card, Group Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Kudumbashree provides subsidized microfinance, livelihood enterprise loans, and marketing platforms to 45 lakh women across Kerala. Contact your local Community Development Society (CDS).
answer_ml: കുടുംബശ്രീ മിഷൻ വഴി സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് സ്വയംതൊഴിൽ ആരംഭിക്കാനും കൃഷി ചെയ്യാനും കുറഞ്ഞ പലിശയിൽ വായ്പകളും വിപണന സഹായങ്ങളും നൽകുന്നു. നിങ്ങളുടെ വാർഡ് സി.ഡി.എസുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെടുക.
answer_hi: कुडुम्बश्री मिशन के तहत महिलाओं के स्वयं सहायता समूहों को कम ब्याज पर सूक्ष्म ऋण और अपना व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए मंच उपलब्ध कराया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Kudumbashree mission me women groups ko micro-business, organic farming aur canteens run karne ke liye low-interest loans milte hain.

name: Kerala Social Security Welfare Pension
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,600 credited directly into the bank accounts or delivered at doorstep via cooperative banks to 50+ lakh beneficiaries.
eligibility: Senior citizens (60+), widows, agricultural labourers, and disabled citizens resident in Kerala with family income under ₹1,00,000/year.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Age/Widowhood/Disability proof, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Kerala Welfare Pension guarantees ₹1,600 per month directly into bank accounts or doorstep cash delivery for elderly, widows, and agricultural workers. Apply on sevaana.rx.kerala.gov.in.
answer_ml: കേരള സർക്കാരിന്റെ സാമൂഹ്യക്ഷേമ പെൻഷൻ വഴി 60 വയസ്സ് കഴിഞ്ഞവർക്കും വിധവകൾക്കും കർഷകത്തൊഴിലാളികൾക്കും പ്രതിമാസം ₹1,600 പെൻഷൻ നേരിട്ട് അക്കൗണ്ടിലോ വീട്ടിലോ ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
answer_hi: केरल सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन के तहत 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के बुजुर्गों, विधवाओं और कृषि मजदूरों को हर महीने ₹1,600 की पेंशन दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kerala Welfare Pension me elderly, widows aur agriculture workers ko ₹1,600 per month guaranteed pension direct bank account me milti hai.

name: Karunya Benevolent Fund (KBF)
benefit: One-time direct financial grant up to ₹2,00,000 (and ₹3,00,000 for kidney/liver transplant) for poor citizens suffering from cancer, haemophilia, or chronic heart/kidney failures.
eligibility: Families in Kerala with annual income less than ₹3,00,000 suffering from critical diseases not fully covered under other insurance.
documents: Medical Certificate from Treating Doctor, Hospital Estimated Expense Voucher, Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Karunya Benevolent Fund provides up to ₹2 to ₹3 Lakh financial assistance for kidney transplants, cancer, and heart surgery expenses. Apply at District Lottery Welfare Officer or civil surgeon.
answer_ml: ക്യാൻസർ, വൃക്കരോഗം, ഹൃദ്രോഗം തുടങ്ങിയ ഗുരുതര രോഗങ്ങളാൽ ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുന്ന നിർധനർക്ക് ₹2 ലക്ഷം മുതൽ ₹3 ലക്ഷം രൂപ വരെ ധനസഹായം കാരുണ്യ ബെനവലന്റ് ഫണ്ട് വഴി നൽകുന്നു.
answer_hi: कारुण्य बेनेवोलेंट फंड के तहत कैंसर, किडनी और हृदय रोगियों को इलाज और अंग प्रत्यारोपण के लिए ₹2 से ₹3 लाख तक की सीधी आर्थिक मदद दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Karunya Benevolent Fund me cancer, dialysis aur organ transplant ke patients ko up to ₹2-3 Lakh emergency financial grant milta hai.

name: Subhiksha Keralam Agriculture Scheme
benefit: Subsidies up to ₹35,000/hectare for converting fallow land into organic paddy, tuber, and vegetable cultivation, plus free seeds, bio-fertilizers, and drip irrigation kits.
eligibility: Individual farmers, self-help groups, youth collectives, and cooperative societies cultivating fallow land in Kerala.
documents: Land Possession Proof / Lease Agreement, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Krishi Bhavan Registration.
answer_en: Subhiksha Keralam offers up to ₹35,000/ha subsidies, free seeds, and bio-fertilizers to convert unused fallow land into productive farms. Register at your local Krishi Bhavan.
