answer_ml: സുഭിക്ഷ കേരളം പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ തരിശുഭൂമി കൃഷിയോഗ്യമാക്കുന്ന കർഷകർക്കും കൂട്ടായ്മകൾക്കും ഹെക്ടറിന് ₹35,000 വരെ സബ്‌സിഡിയും സൗജന്യ വിത്തുകളും നൽകുന്നു. കൃഷിഭവനിൽ രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്യുക.
answer_hi: सुभिक्षा केरलम योजना के तहत बंजर जमीन पर जैविक खेती करने के लिए किसानों को ₹35,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर की सब्सिडी और मुफ्त बीज दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Subhiksha Keralam me fallow land pe vegetable aur paddy farming ke liye Krishi Bhavan dwara up to ₹35,000 per hectare subsidy milti hai.

name: Vidyakiranam Scheme (Free Digital Gadgets)
benefit: Free high-speed laptops and tablets distributed to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds to ensure equal access to digital education.
eligibility: Students enrolled in Class 1 to 12 in government and aided schools in Kerala whose families belong to BPL, SC/ST, or fisherfolk communities.
documents: School Admission Record, BPL Ration Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Vidyakiranam provides free laptops and tablets to underprivileged school children across Kerala to ensure 100% digital learning access. Distributed through school headmasters.
answer_ml: വിദ്യാകിരണം പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ സാമ്പത്തികമായി പിന്നോക്കം നിൽക്കുന്ന സ്കൂൾ കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ഓൺലൈൻ പഠനത്തിനായി സൗജന്യ ലാപ്ടോപ്പുകളും ടാബ്‌ലെറ്റുകളും നൽകുന്നു.
answer_hi: विद्याकिरणम योजना के तहत सरकारी स्कूलों के गरीब और जरूरतमंद बच्चों को डिजिटल पढ़ाई के लिए मुफ्त लैपटॉप और टैबलेट दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Vidyakiranam scheme me BPL aur underprivileged students ko digital education ke liye free laptop aur tablet provide kiye jaate hain.

name: Snehasparsham Financial Aid for Unwed Mothers
benefit: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 deposited directly into the bank accounts of unwed mothers belonging to scheduled tribes, scheduled castes, and BPL communities.
eligibility: Unmarried mothers residing in Kerala belonging to BPL families or tribal communities who have not remarried.
documents: Child Birth Certificate, BPL Certificate / Tribal Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Snehasparsham provides ₹2,000 monthly maintenance to unwed and destitute mothers to raise their children with dignity. Apply at the District Social Justice Office.
answer_ml: സ്നേഹസ്പർശം പദ്ധതി വഴി അവിവാഹിതരായ അമ്മമാർക്ക് കുട്ടികളുടെ സംരക്ഷണത്തിനും മാന്യമായ ജീവിതത്തിനും പ്രതിമാസം ₹2,000 പെൻഷൻ ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
answer_hi: स्नेहस्पर्शम योजना के तहत अविवाहित माताओं को अपने बच्चों के पालन-पोषण के लिए ₹2,000 प्रति माह की सम्मान पेंशन दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Snehasparsham scheme me unwed mothers ko child care aur dignity ke liye monthly ₹2,000 pension direct bank account me milti hai.

name: Aardram Mission (Family Health Centres)
benefit: State-of-the-art transformed Family Health Centres (FHCs) offering free OP consultations, 100+ free generic medicines, free laboratory testing, and evening clinics until 6:00 PM.
eligibility: Open to all residents and visitors in Kerala with zero registration fee.
documents: No identity document needed for general OPD walk-in.
answer_en: Aardram Mission has upgraded primary health centres into people-friendly Family Health Centres with free lab tests, free medicines, and extended evening hours.
answer_ml: ആർദ്രം മിഷൻ വഴി കുടുംബാരോഗ്യ കേന്ദ്രങ്ങൾ അത്യാധുനിക സൗകര്യങ്ങളോടെ വൈകുന്നേരം 6 മണി വരെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുകയും സൗജന്യ ലാബ് പരിശോധനകളും മരുന്നുകളും ലഭ്യമാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
answer_hi: आर्द्रम मिशन के तहत प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्रों को अत्याधुनिक फैमिली हेल्थ सेंटर में बदल कर मुफ्त दवाएं और शाम 6 बजे तक ओपीडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Aardram Mission me primary clinics ko Family Health Centres me upgrade kiya gaya hai jahan free medicines aur lab tests milte hain.

name: Matsya Samrudhi Aquaculture Project
benefit: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹1,50,000) for freshwater and brackish water aquaculture (biofloc, cage culture, ornamental fish breeding, and pond culture).
eligibility: Fishermen, small farmers, and coastal self-help groups in Kerala with access to water bodies or private ponds.
documents: Pond ownership / lease deed, Fisheries Department ID, Aadhaar Card, Project Plan.
answer_en: Matsya Samrudhi grants up to 50% capital subsidy for biofloc fish farming, freshwater carp rearing, and ornamental fisheries. Apply at the Matsya Bhavan.
answer_ml: മത്സ്യ സമൃദ്ധി പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ ബയോഫ്ലോക്ക്, കൂട് കൃഷി, ശുദ്ധജല മത്സ്യകൃഷി എന്നിവ ആരംഭിക്കുന്നതിന് 40% മുതൽ 50% വരെ സർക്കാർ സബ്‌സിഡി ലഭ്യമാണ്. മത്സ്യഭവനുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെടുക.
answer_hi: मत्स्य समृद्धि योजना के तहत बायोफ्लॉक और मीठे पानी में मछली पालन शुरू करने के लिए 40% से 50% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Matsya Samrudhi me biofloc fish farming aur pond aquaculture start karne ke liye 40% to 50% capital subsidy milti hai Matsya Bhavan se.

name: Thalolam Scheme (Free Treatment for Children)
benefit: 100% free specialized medical treatment, chemotherapy, cardiac surgery, and medicines up to ₹50,000 (and extended as needed) for children aged 0 to 18 suffering from critical conditions.
eligibility: All children aged 0-18 years belonging to BPL/poor families in Kerala admitted to government medical college hospitals or SAT hospital.
documents: Ration Card, Child Birth Certificate/Aadhaar, Medical College Case Sheet.
answer_en: Thalolam provides 100% free hospital treatment and surgeries for children aged 0-18 suffering from critical diseases in Kerala government medical colleges.
answer_ml: താലോലം പദ്ധതി വഴി 18 വയസ്സ് വരെയുള്ള കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന ഗുരുതര രോഗങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള ചികിത്സയും ശസ്ത്രക്രിയകളും സർക്കാർ മെഡിക്കൽ കോളേജുകളിൽ പൂർണ്ണമായും സൗജന്യമാണ്.
answer_hi: तालोलम योजना के तहत 18 वर्ष तक के बच्चों को सरकारी मेडिकल कॉलेजों में गंभीर बीमारियों का इलाज और सर्जरी 100% मुफ्त दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Thalolam scheme me 0-18 age ke bachhon ko government medical colleges me complex surgeries aur critical treatment completely free milta hai.

name: Kanyaka Pension (Unmarried Women 50+)
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,600 directly into the bank accounts of unmarried women aged 50 years and above from low-income families.
eligibility: Unmarried women aged 50+ resident of Kerala with annual family income under ₹1,00,000.
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar/School Certificate), Unmarried Certificate from Village Officer, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Kanyaka Pension grants ₹1,600 monthly pension to unmarried women aged 50 and above belonging to low-income households. Apply at your Grama Panchayat or Municipality.
answer_ml: കന്യക പെൻഷൻ പദ്ധതിയിലൂടെ 50 വയസ്സ് കഴിഞ്ഞ അവിവാഹിതരായ നിർധന സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് മാന്യമായ ഉപജീവനത്തിനായി പ്രതിമാസം ₹1,600 പെൻഷൻ നൽകുന്നു.
answer_hi: कन्यका पेंशन योजना के तहत 50 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र की अविवाहित गरीब महिलाओं को ₹1,600 प्रति माह पेंशन दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kanyaka Pension scheme me 50+ unmarried women ko dignified living ke liye monthly ₹1,600 direct bank pension milti hai.

name: Punjab Free 300 Units Domestic Electricity Scheme
benefit: 300 units of completely free domestic electricity per month (600 units on bi-monthly billing cycles), resulting in zero power bills for nearly 90% of households.
eligibility: All domestic residential electricity consumers in Punjab consuming up to 600 units bi-monthly.
documents: PSPCL Electricity Connection Account Number, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Punjab Free Electricity Scheme gives 300 units of free electricity per month (600 units bi-monthly) to all domestic consumers, making power bills zero.
answer_pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਘਰੇਲੂ ਖਪਤਕਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਮਹੀਨਾ 300 ਯੂਨਿਟ (ਦੋ ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਬਿੱਲ ਵਿੱਚ 600 ਯੂਨਿਟ) ਮੁਫਤ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਬਿੱਲ ਜ਼ੀਰੋ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: पंजाब मुफ्त बिजली योजना के तहत सभी घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को हर महीने 300 यूनिट (दो महीने के बिल पर 600 यूनिट) मुफ्त बिजली दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Punjab Free Power scheme me domestic consumers ko 300 units per month free bijli milti hai jisse bill completely zero ho jaata hai.

name: Aam Aadmi Clinics (Mohalla Clinics Punjab)
benefit: 100% free consultation by MBBS doctors, 80+ free essential clinical diagnostic lab tests, and 40+ free medicines at neighbourhood walk-in clinics.
eligibility: Open to all residents and citizens across urban and rural Punjab with zero fees.
documents: No identity document required. Direct digital token registration.
answer_en: Aam Aadmi Clinics provide free doctor checkups, 80+ free laboratory tests, and free branded medicines across 800+ neighbourhood clinics in Punjab.
answer_pa: ਆਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲੀਨਿਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਹਰ ਡਾਕਟਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ, 80 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਲੈਬ ਟੈਸਟ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਦਵਾਈਆਂ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਮੁਫਤ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
answer_hi: आम आदमी क्लिनिक में एमबीबीएस डॉक्टरों द्वारा मुफ्त जांच, 80 से अधिक मुफ्त लैब टेस्ट और मुफ्त दवाएं सभी नागरिकों को दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Aam Aadmi Clinics me neighbourhood clinics me free doctor consultation, 80+ free diagnostic tests aur free medicines milti hain.

name: Ashirwad Scheme (Shagun Scheme Punjab)
benefit: One-time financial grant of ₹51,000 credited directly into the bride's bank account for solemnization of marriage.
eligibility: Girls aged 18+ belonging to SC, BC, Christian, Muslim, and EWS families in Punjab with family annual income under ₹32,790.
documents: Bride & Groom Age Proof, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Wedding Invitation Card, Bride's Bank Passbook.
answer_en: Punjab Ashirwad Scheme provides ₹51,000 direct bank grant for daughter's marriage to SC, BC, and low-income families. Apply on the Dr. Ambedkar portal.
answer_pa: ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ (ਸ਼ਗਨ) ਸਕੀਮ ਅਧੀਨ ਅਨੁਸੂਚਿਤ ਜਾਤੀਆਂ, ਪਛੜੀਆਂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਗਰੀਬ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਧੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਆਹ ਲਈ ₹51,000 ਦੀ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: आशीर्वाद योजना के तहत गरीब परिवारों और दलित समुदाय की बेटियों के विवाह के लिए ₹51,000 की शगुन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Ashirwad scheme me beti ki marriage ke liye government ₹51,000 direct bank transfer shagun provide karti hai.

name: Ayushman Bharat Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana
benefit: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 900+ empanelled government and private hospitals in Punjab and Chandigarh.
eligibility: NFSA blue ration card holders, J-Form farmer holders, small traders, construction workers, and accredited journalists in Punjab.
documents: Sehat Bima E-Card, Ration Card, J-Form / Registration ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Sarbat Sehat Bima offers up to ₹5 Lakh cashless hospital treatment per family annually for 1,500+ procedures across network hospitals in Punjab.
answer_pa: ਸਰਬੱਤ ਸਿਹਤ ਬੀਮਾ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਤਹਿਤ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਲਗਭਗ 40 ਲੱਖ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਸਾਲ ₹5 ਲੱਖ ਤੱਕ ਦਾ ਮੁਫਤ ਕੈਸ਼ਲੈਸ ਇਲਾਜ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਹਸਪਤਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: सरबत सेहत बीमा योजना के तहत पंजाब के पात्र परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Sarbat Sehat Bima scheme me family ko saal me ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless medical treatment milta hai empanelled hospitals me.

name: Punjab Old Age & Social Security Pension
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 directly transferred into the bank accounts of senior citizens, widows, destitutes, and disabled persons.
eligibility: Senior citizens (men 65+, women 58+) resident of Punjab with family annual income less than ₹60,000.
documents: Age proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Income Certificate, Bank Passbook, Passport photo.
answer_en: Punjab Old Age Pension provides ₹1,500 per month directly into bank accounts of elderly citizens aged 65+ (men) or 58+ (women). Apply via Sewa Kendra.
answer_pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਬੁਢਾਪਾ ਪੈਨਸ਼ਨ ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ 65 ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਉਮਰ ਦੇ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਅਤੇ 58 ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਉਮਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਮਹਿਲਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਮਹੀਨਾ ₹1,500 ਪੈਨਸ਼ਨ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਵਿਖੇ ਅਪਲਾਈ ਕਰੋ।
answer_hi: पंजाब वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत बुजुर्गों और विधवाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Punjab Old Age Pension me senior citizens aur widows ko har mahine ₹1,500 direct bank transfer pension milti hai.

name: Khedan Watan Punjab Diyan
benefit: Massive state sports games with cash prizes up to ₹7,00,000 for gold medalists, Olympic preparation grants up to ₹15,00,000, and sports government jobs.
eligibility: Athletes and sportspersons across 8 age groups (under-14 to veteran 70+) resident in Punjab.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Sports Federation/School Record.
answer_en: Khedan Watan Punjab Diyan promotes sports talent with cash awards up to ₹7 Lakh and Olympic athlete grants. Register at khedanwatanpunjabdia.com.
answer_pa: ਖੇਡਾਂ ਵਤਨ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੀਆਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਰੋੜਾਂ ਰੁਪਏ ਦੇ ਨਕਦ ਇਨਾਮ, ਓਲੰਪਿਕ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਲਈ ₹15 ਲੱਖ ਦੀ ਗ੍ਰਾਂਟ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਨੌਕਰੀਆਂ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
answer_hi: खेड़ां वतन पंजाब दियां योजना के तहत खिलाड़ियों को करोड़ों के नकद पुरस्कार, तैयारी अनुदान और सरकारी नौकरियां दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Khedan Watan Punjab Diyan me sportspersons ko cash awards, training subsidies aur government sports quota jobs milti hain.

name: Punjab Smart Ration (Atta-Dal) Scheme
benefit: Free wheat (or packaged clean wheat flour / Atta) delivered directly in hygienic packaged bags to the doorstep of BPL households.
eligibility: Blue Smart Ration Card holders covered under NFSA and state welfare food security schemes in Punjab.
documents: Smart Ration Card, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Punjab Smart Ration (Atta-Dal) distributes free packaged wheat flour and foodgrains directly to beneficiaries' homes without long queues.
answer_pa: ਸਮਾਰਟ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਕਾਰਡ (ਆਟਾ-ਦਾਲ) ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ ਗਰੀਬ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਪੈਕਡ ਆਟਾ ਅਤੇ ਕਣਕ ਘਰ-ਘਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਫਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: स्मार्ट राशन (आटा-दाल) योजना के तहत पंजाब के राशन कार्ड धारकों को उनके घर पर ही मुफ्त साफ गेहूं और आटा पहुंचाया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Atta-Dal scheme me Punjab ke NFSA families ko packaged wheat flour directly doorstep pe deliver kiya jaata hai free of cost.

name: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme (Free Cycles for Girls)
benefit: Free standard lady bi-cycles distributed to girl students of classes 9, 10, 11, and 12 studying in government schools to ensure zero dropouts.
eligibility: Girl students enrolled in classes 9 to 12 in Punjab government high and senior secondary schools.
documents: School Registration ID, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme gifts free bicycles to high school girl students in government schools so they can commute safely and complete their education.
answer_pa: ਮਾਈ ਭਾਗੋ ਵਿੱਦਿਆ ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਸਕੂਲਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ 9ਵੀਂ ਤੋਂ 12ਵੀਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਕੂਲ ਆਉਣ-ਜਾਣ ਲਈ ਮੁਫਤ ਸਾਈਕਲ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
answer_hi: माई भागो विद्या योजना के तहत सरकारी स्कूलों की 9वीं से 12वीं की छात्राओं को मुफ्त साइकिलें वितरित की जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Mai Bhago Vidya scheme me 9th to 12th class government school girls ko commuting ease ke liye free lady bi-cycles provide ki jaati hain.

name: Mukh Mantri Tirath Yatra Scheme
benefit: 100% free pilgrimage travel by AC trains and deluxe buses to Sri Hazur Sahib, Sri Patna Sahib, Varanasi, Vrindavan, and Salasar with free AC hotel stay and food.
eligibility: Senior citizens and citizens of Punjab who are not government employees or income tax payers.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Punjab Domicile Proof, Medical Fitness Certificate.
answer_en: Mukh Mantri Tirath Yatra provides free AC train travel, hotel lodging, and food for citizens visiting holy pilgrimage centres across India. Apply at Sewa Kendra.
answer_pa: ਮੁੱਖ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਤੀਰਥ ਯਾਤਰਾ ਸਕੀਮ ਅਧੀਨ ਸ਼੍ਰੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ, ਵਾਰਾਣਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲਾਸਰ ਵਰਗੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਅਸਥਾਨਾਂ ਲਈ ਏਸੀ ਟਰੇਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁਫਤ ਯਾਤਰਾ, ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਲੰਗਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री तीर्थ यात्रा योजना के तहत राज्य के नागरिकों को पवित्र तीर्थ स्थलों की एसी ट्रेनों में मुफ्त यात्रा, ठहरने और भोजन की सुविधा दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Mukh Mantri Tirath Yatra me senior citizens ko Sri Hazur Sahib, Varanasi aadi pilgrimage places ki AC train travel aur stay 100% free milta hai.

name: Punjab Canal Water Irrigation Expansion
benefit: Restoration of canal water to tail-end farms with 90% government subsidy for laying underground irrigation pipelines to conserve groundwater.
eligibility: Farmers and cultivators in Punjab owning agricultural land along canal command distributaries.
documents: Land Fard/Jamabandi, Aadhaar Card, Water Source Certificate.
answer_en: Punjab Canal Irrigation project provides canal water to tail-end fields and up to 90% subsidy on underground irrigation pipelines. Apply at District Soil Conservation Office.
answer_pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਨਹਿਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਟੇਲਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਜ਼ਮੀਨਦੋਜ਼ ਪਾਈਪਲਾਈਨਾਂ ਪਾਉਣ ਲਈ 90% ਸਬਸਿਡੀ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
answer_hi: पंजाब नहर जल परियोजना के तहत अंतिम छोर तक नहरी पानी पहुंचाया जा रहा है और भूमिगत पाइपलाइन बिछाने पर 90% तक की सब्सिडी दी जा रही है।
answer_hinglish: Punjab Canal Irrigation me tail-end fields tak canal water deliver kiya jaata hai aur underground pipeline pe 90% subsidy milti hai.

name: Doorstep Citizen Services (1076 Delivery)
benefit: Doorstep delivery of 43+ official government services (birth/death certificates, caste/income certificates, driving licence renewal) via helpline 1076 at a scheduled appointment.
eligibility: All citizens resident in Punjab.
documents: Service-specific documents as informed during booking via 1076.
answer_en: Dial 1076 to get 43+ government certificates, licences, and pension papers processed and delivered directly at your home by visiting government assistants.
answer_pa: ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ 1076 ਡਾਇਲ ਕਰਕੇ ਜਾਤੀ, ਆਮਦਨ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ, ਡਰਾਈਵਿੰਗ ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ 43 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਘਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰੋ।
answer_hi: हेल्पलाइन 1076 डायल करके जन्म, जाति, आय प्रमाण पत्र जैसी 43 सरकारी सेवाएं अपने घर पर बैठे-बैठे प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
answer_te: హెల్ప్‌లైన్ 1076 ద్వారా పంజాబ్‌లో 43 రకాల ప్రభుత్వ సర్టిఫికెట్లు మరియు లైసెన్సులను పౌరులు తమ ఇంటి వద్దకే తెప్పించుకోవచ్చు.
answer_hinglish: Toll-free 1076 dial karke 43+ government certificates (caste, income, driving licence) apne ghar pe deliver karwa sakte hain.

name: CM Di Yogshala Scheme
benefit: 100% free certified government yoga instructors provided at parks, community halls, or neighbourhoods when a group of 25+ citizens request via missed call.
eligibility: Groups of 25 or more citizens residing in any village, town, or city in Punjab.
documents: No documents needed. Give a missed call on 7669400500.
answer_en: CM Di Yogshala sends a certified government yoga instructor to teach free daily yoga to any group of 25+ citizens in Punjab. Dial 7669400500 to book.
answer_pa: ਸੀ ਐਮ ਦੀ ਯੋਗਸ਼ਾਲਾ ਤਹਿਤ 25 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਲਈ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਮੁਫਤ ਯੋਗਾ ਟ੍ਰੇਨਰ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ 7669400500 'ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਕਰੋ।
answer_hi: सीएम दी योगशाला के तहत 25 से अधिक लोगों के समूह के लिए सरकार मुफ्त योग प्रशिक्षक भेजती है। 7669400500 पर मिस्ड कॉल दें।
answer_te: సీఎం ది యోగశాల పథకం కింద 25 మందికి పైగా ఉన్న సమూహాలకు ప్రభుత్వం ఉచిత యోగా శిక్షకులను వారి నివాస ప్రాంతాలకే పంపుతుంది.
answer_hinglish: CM Di Yogshala me 25+ citizens ke group ke liye government certified yoga trainer free of cost send karti hai daily practice ke liye.

name: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship (PMS Online)
benefit: Full reimbursement of college tuition fees plus maintenance allowance up to ₹15,000 to ₹1,00,000 per year for intermediate, degree, engineering, and medical students.
eligibility: SC, ST, BC, and EBC students permanent residents of Bihar pursuing post-matric studies with family income under ₹3 Lakh.
documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate under ₹3L, Residential Certificate, Fee Receipt, Bonafide Certificate, Aadhaar Card.
answer_en: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship reimburses college fees and maintenance allowance up to ₹1 Lakh/year for backward class students. Apply on pmsonline.bih.nic.in.
answer_hi: बिहार पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना के तहत एससी, एसटी, बीसी और ईबीसी छात्रों को कॉलेज की पूरी फीस और ₹15,000 से ₹1 लाख तक का रखरखाव भत्ता मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship me backward class students ko college tuition fee reimbursement aur allowance milta hai pmsonline portal pe.

name: Orunodoi 2.0 Scheme
benefit: ₹1,250 per month credited directly into bank account of the woman head of the family on the 10th of every month.
eligibility: Permanent resident women of Assam from families having annual income below ₹2 Lakh. Preference for widows, divorced, unmarried women, and divyangjan.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, Bank passbook linked to Aadhaar, Income certificate, Domicile certificate.
answer_en: Under Assam Orunodoi 2.0, eligible female family heads receive ₹1,250 every month directly in their bank accounts on the 10th. Apply through your Gaon Panchayat, VCDC, or visit orunodoi.assam.gov.in.
answer_hi: असम की ओरुनोदोई 2.0 योजना के तहत पात्र महिला मुखिया को हर महीने ₹1,250 सीधे उनके बैंक खाते में मिलते हैं। इसके लिए अपने गाँव पंचायत या orunodoi.assam.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Assam Orunodoi 2.0 ke tehat eligible women heads ko har mahine ₹1,250 direct bank account me milte hain. Gaon Panchayat ya orunodoi.assam.gov.in se apply karein.
answer_te: అస్సాం ఒరునోదోయ్ 2.0 పథకం కింద అర్హులైన మహిళా కుటుంబ పెద్దలకు నెలకు ₹1,250 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు. గ్రామ్ పంచాయతీ లేదా orunodoi.assam.gov.in ద్వారా దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోండి.
answer_as: অৰুণোদয় ২.০ আঁচনিৰ অধীনত যোগ্য মহিলা মুৰব্বীসকলে প্ৰতি মাহে ১,২৫০ টকা পোনে পোনে বেংক একাউণ্টত লাভ কৰে। আবেদনৰ বাবে গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত বা orunodoi.assam.gov.in চাওক।

name: Pragyan Bharati Scheme
benefit: Free admission in HS and degree colleges, free textbooks, ₹1,000 monthly mess dues waiver, and free scooty/two-wheeler for meritorious girl students.
eligibility: Students studying in Assam government schools and colleges with family income below ₹2 Lakh per annum. Meritorious girls securing 60%+ in HSLC/HS.
documents: Marksheets, School/College ID, Income certificate, Domicile certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Pragyan Bharati provides free college admission, textbook support, ₹1,000 hostel mess waiver, and two-wheelers for meritorious girl students across Assam. Inquire at your college office.
answer_hi: प्रज्ञान भारती योजना के तहत असम के छात्रों को कॉलेज में मुफ्त प्रवेश, किताबें, मेस सब्सिडी और मेधावी छात्राओं को स्कूटी प्रदान की जाती है। अपने कॉलेज कार्यालय से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Pragyan Bharati scheme me Assam ke students ko free college admission, textbook aid, hostel mess waiver aur meritorious girls ko scooty milti hai. Apne college me sampark karein.
answer_te: ప్రజ్ఞాన్ భారతి పథకం ద్వారా అస్సాం విద్యార్థులకు ఉచిత కాలేజీ ప్రవేశం, పాఠ్యపుస్తకాలు, హాస్టల్ మెస్ రాయితీ మరియు మెరిట్ బాలికలకు స్కూటీ లభిస్తాయి. మీ కాలేజీలో సంప్రదించండి.

name: Arundhati Gold Scheme
benefit: ₹40,000 financial grant deposited into bride's bank account to purchase 1 tola (10 grams) of gold upon marriage registration.
eligibility: Assam resident brides aged 18+ and groom aged 21+, annual family income below ₹5 Lakh, marriage formally registered under Special Marriage Act 1954.
documents: Marriage registration certificate, Age proof (Birth cert/Admit card), Income certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Under Arundhati Gold Scheme, newly married brides in Assam receive ₹40,000 financial assistance for 1 tola of gold upon official marriage registration. Apply online at revenueassam.nic.in.
answer_hi: अरुंधति गोल्ड योजना के तहत असम में विवाह पंजीकरण कराने वाली दुल्हनों को 1 तोला सोने के लिए ₹40,000 की सहायता मिलती है। revenueassam.nic.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Arundhati Gold Scheme me legally register shadi karne wali brides ko 1 tola sone ke liye ₹40,000 milte hain. revenueassam.nic.in par register karein.
answer_te: అరుంధతి గోల్డ్ పథకం కింద అస్సాంలో వివాహ నమోదు చేసుకున్న వధువులకు 1 తులం బంగారం కొనుగోలుకు ₹40,000 అందజేస్తారు. revenueassam.nic.in లో దరఖాస్తు చేయండి.

name: Swanirbhar Naari Scheme
benefit: Direct procurement of traditional hand-woven handloom products (Gamosa, Dokhona, Mekhela Sador) directly from indigenous women weavers without middlemen.
eligibility: Indigenous female handloom weavers of Assam registered on the Swanirbhar Naari portal.
documents: Weaver registration card, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card, Domicile certificate.
answer_en: Swanirbhar Naari empowers indigenous women weavers in Assam by procuring their handloom products directly at fair government prices. Register at swanirbharnaari.assam.gov.in.
answer_hi: स्वनिर्भर नारी योजना के तहत असम सरकार महिला बुनकरों से उनके हथकरघा उत्पाद सीधे उचित मूल्य पर खरीदती है। swanirbharnaari.assam.gov.in पर पंजीकरण करें।
answer_hinglish: Swanirbhar Naari me Assam govt mahila weavers ke traditional handloom items direct fair price par khareedti hai. swanirbharnaari.assam.gov.in par register karein.
answer_te: స్వనిర్భర్ నారీ పథకం ద్వారా అస్సాం ప్రభుత్వం మహిళా నేత కార్మికుల నుండి నేరుగా సరసమైన ధరకు చేనేత ఉత్పత్తులను కొనుగోలు చేస్తుంది.

name: Apun Ghar Home Loan Subsidy
benefit: Interest subsidy up to 3.5% on housing loans up to ₹40 Lakh, saving up to ₹2.5 Lakh over loan tenure.
eligibility: Permanent residents and government employees of Assam availing home loans from designated banks for constructing or purchasing their first house.
documents: Salary slip/ITR, House purchase/construction plan, Bank loan sanction letter, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Apun Ghar provides up to 3.5% interest subsidy on housing loans up to ₹40 Lakh for Assam residents building or buying their first home. Inquire at SBI or designated public sector banks.
answer_hi: अपुन घर योजना के तहत अपना पहला घर बनाने या खरीदने के लिए होम लोन पर 3.5% तक ब्याज सब्सिडी मिलती है। एसबीआई या नोडल बैंकों से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Apun Ghar scheme me first home buy ya build karne ke liye home loan par 3.5% interest subsidy milti hai. SBI ya bank branch me apply karein.
answer_te: అపున్ ఘర్ పథకం ద్వారా అస్సాం నివాసితులు తమ మొదటి ఇల్లు కొనుగోలుకు హోమ్ లోన్‌పై 3.5% వరకు వడ్డీ రాయితీ పొందుతారు.

name: Mukhya Mantri Lok Sevak Arogya Yojana
benefit: Cashless and simplified medical reimbursement up to ₹5 Lakh per year for inpatient treatment across empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: All active and retired Assam state government employees and their dependent family members.
documents: Employee ID/Pension ID, Aadhaar card, Treatment estimates/discharge summary.
answer_en: Lok Sevak Arogya Yojana offers cashless and hassle-free medical coverage up to ₹5 Lakh for Assam state employees and pensioners. Manage claims at mmlsay.assam.gov.in.
answer_hi: लोक सेवक आरोग्य योजना के तहत असम सरकार के कर्मचारियों और पेंशनभोगियों को ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य उपचार मिलता है। mmlsay.assam.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Lok Sevak Arogya Yojana me Assam state govt employees aur pensioners ko ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless medical reimbursement milta hai. mmlsay.assam.gov.in par login karein.
answer_te: లోక్ సేవక్ ఆరోగ్య యోజన అస్సాం ప్రభుత్వ ఉద్యోగులకు మరియు పెన్షనర్లకు ₹5 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత వైద్య చికిత్సను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chah Bagicha Dhan Puraskar Scheme
benefit: Direct financial assistance of ₹5,000 in bank accounts of tea garden workers to promote banking literacy and financial inclusion.
eligibility: Workers employed in tea gardens across Assam who have opened active bank accounts post-demonetization.
documents: Tea garden employment card/EPF number, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Chah Bagicha Dhan Puraskar provides ₹5,000 direct bank benefit to tea garden workers in Assam. Verify your tea estate bank linkage with your garden management.
answer_hi: चाह बगीचा धन पुरस्कार योजना के तहत असम के चाय बागान श्रमिकों के बैंक खाते में ₹5,000 की आर्थिक मदद दी जाती है। अपने बागान प्रबंधन से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Chah Bagicha Dhan Puraskar me Assam ke tea garden workers ko ₹5,000 direct bank me milte hain financial inclusion ke liye.
answer_te: చాహ్ బగీచా ధన్ పురస్కార్ పథకం అస్సాం టీ తోట కార్మికులకు ₹5,000 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో అందిస్తుంది.

name: Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
benefit: One-time capital subsidy of ₹50,000 on education loans sanctioned by commercial and rural banks for pursuing higher education.
eligibility: Students who are permanent residents of Assam pursuing recognized higher degree courses with sanctioned education loans of minimum ₹1 Lakh.
documents: Education loan sanction letter, Bank passbook, College admission letter, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Under Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy, students in Assam get ₹50,000 one-time relief on higher education bank loans. Apply on the Assam finance portal.
answer_hi: अभिनंदन शिक्षा ऋण सब्सिडी के तहत उच्च शिक्षा के लिए लोन लेने वाले असम के छात्रों को ₹50,000 की एकमुश्त सब्सिडी मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Abhinandan scheme me education loan lene wale Assam students ko ₹50,000 ki one-time bank subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: అభినందన్ ఎడ్యుకేషన్ లోన్ సబ్సిడీ ద్వారా ఉన్నత విద్య కోసం లోన్ తీసుకున్న అస్సాం విద్యార్థులకు ₹50,000 ఒకేసారి రాయితీగా లభిస్తుంది.

name: Indira Miri Universal Widow Pension Scheme
benefit: One-time lump sum grant of ₹25,000 to newly widowed women plus regular monthly pension of ₹300-₹1,250.
eligibility: Widows aged 18 to 45 residing in Assam with annual family income below ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: Husband's death certificate, Age proof, Income certificate, Bank account passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Indira Miri Universal Widow Pension gives ₹25,000 one-time financial support plus ongoing pension to widows in Assam. Apply at your local Block or Municipal office.
answer_hi: इंदिरा मिरी विधवा पेंशन योजना के तहत विधवा महिलाओं को ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता और मासिक पेंशन मिलती है। ब्लॉक कार्यालय में संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Indira Miri scheme me Assam ki widows ko ₹25,000 one-time grant aur regular pension milti hai. Block office se apply karein.
answer_te: ఇందిరా మిరి యూనివర్సల్ వితంతు పెన్షన్ పథకం ద్వారా అస్సాంలోని వితంతువులకు ₹25,000 ఒకేసారి ఆర్థిక సాయం మరియు నెలవారీ పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Deen Dayal Divyangjan Sahayata Scheme
benefit: Monthly direct financial allowance of ₹1,000 to disabled individuals to support daily living and rehabilitation.
eligibility: Persons residing in Assam with certified physical or mental disability of 40% and above, family income below ₹2 Lakh/year.
documents: Disability certificate / UDID Card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Income certificate.
answer_en: Deen Dayal Divyangjan Sahayata provides ₹1,000 monthly allowance for persons with disabilities in Assam. Apply through the District Social Welfare Office.
answer_hi: दीन दयाल दिव्यांगजन सहायता योजना के तहत 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले असम निवासियों को ₹1,000 मासिक भत्ता मिलता है। जिला समाज कल्याण कार्यालय से आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Deen Dayal Divyangjan scheme me Assam ke disabled citizens ko ₹1,000 har mahine financial aid milti hai. Social Welfare office me visit karein.
answer_te: దీన్ దయాళ్ దివ్యాంగుల సహాయత పథకం అస్సాంలోని వికలాంగులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 భత్యం అందజేస్తుంది.

name: CMSGUY Tractor Distribution Scheme
benefit: 70% capital subsidy (up to ₹5.5 Lakh) on procurement of high-powered farm tractor unit with implements per agricultural village group.
eligibility: Registered Farmer Producer Groups (FPG) / Self-Help Groups having 8-10 active farmers with cultivable land in Assam.
documents: Group registration certificate, Land documents, Bank account details, Aadhaar cards of members.
answer_en: CMSGUY Tractor Distribution provides 70% government subsidy on farm tractor units for farmer groups across Assam villages. Apply via the District Agriculture Officer.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री ग्राम्य उन्नयन योजना (CMSGUY) के तहत असम के किसान समूहों को ट्रैक्टर खरीद पर 70% तक की भारी सब्सिडी मिलती है। कृषि विभाग में संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: CMSGUY Tractor scheme me Assam ke farmer groups ko 70% tractor subsidy milti hai farm mechanization ke liye.
answer_te: అస్సాం CMSGUY ట్రాక్టర్ పంపిణీ పథకం కింద రైతు సమూహాలకు ట్రాక్టర్ కొనుగోలుపై 70% వరకు రాయితీ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyamita Abhiyan (MMUA)
benefit: Seed capital of ₹10,000 in Year 1, followed by ₹25,000 (₹12,500 govt grant + ₹12,500 bank loan) upon successful micro-enterprise launch.
eligibility: Rural women members of registered Self-Help Groups (SHGs) under ASRLM having compliant child criteria.
documents: SHG passbook, Aadhaar card, Micro-business livelihood plan, Bank account details.
answer_en: MMUA provides ₹10,000 direct seed fund followed by ₹25,000 capital support to rural SHG women starting individual enterprises in Assam. Apply via your village SHG.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री महिला उद्यमिता अभियान के तहत असम के ग्रामीण स्वयं सहायता समूह की महिलाओं को ₹10,000 का सीड फंड और बाद में ₹25,000 का व्यवसाय संवर्धन पैकेज मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: MMUA scheme me Assam ki SHG women ko micro business shuru karne ke liye ₹10,000 initial grant aur ₹25,000 tak capital milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మహిళా ఉద్యమిత అభియాన్ ద్వారా అస్సాంలోని గ్రామీణ మహిళా సంఘాల సభ్యులకు వ్యాపారం ప్రారంభించడానికి ₹10,000 ప్రారంభ గ్రాంట్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP / Family ID)
benefit: Unified 8-digit unique family identification card enabling automatic proactive delivery of pensions, ration, health, and scholarships without paperwork.
eligibility: All permanent families and resident households residing in Haryana.
documents: Aadhaar cards of all family members, Bank passbooks, Birth/Voter IDs, Electricity bill.
answer_en: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) is Haryana's 8-digit digital Family ID that auto-links and delivers all welfare schemes like pensions, ration, and healthcare. Create or update at meraparivar.haryana.gov.in.
answer_hi: परिवार पहचान पत्र (PPP) हरियाणा का 8 अंकों का फैमिली आईडी कार्ड है जिससे पेंशन, राशन और इलाज जैसी सभी योजनाएं बिना आवेदन स्वतः मिलती हैं। meraparivar.haryana.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Haryana ki unique Family ID hai jisse pensions, Chirayu card aur sabhi schemes auto-approve hoti hain. meraparivar.haryana.gov.in par update karein.
answer_te: పరివార్ పెహచాన్ పత్ర (PPP) హర్యానా యొక్క డిజిటల్ ఫ్యామిలీ ఐడి. దీని ద్వారా అన్ని సంక్షేమ పథకాలు ఆటోమేటిక్‌గా అందుతాయి. meraparivar.haryana.gov.in లో నమోదు చేసుకోండి.

name: Chirayu Haryana Yojana (Ayushman Expansion)
benefit: Free cashless inpatient medical treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per year for families earning up to ₹1.80 Lakh/year (and nominal ₹1,500 copay for up to ₹3 Lakh).
eligibility: Resident families in Haryana with verified annual income up to ₹1.80 Lakh in their Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
documents: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID), Aadhaar card, Chirayu Golden Card.
answer_en: Chirayu Haryana provides ₹5 Lakh free cashless treatment per year at empanelled hospitals for families earning under ₹1.80 Lakh in PPP. Download Chirayu Card at chirayuayushmanharyana.in.
answer_hi: चिरायु हरियाणा योजना के तहत ₹1.80 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों को ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। chirayuayushmanharyana.in से कार्ड डाउनलोड करें।
answer_hinglish: Chirayu Haryana me PPP verified income ₹1.80 Lakh wale parivaron ko ₹5 Lakh tak ka free hospital treatment milta hai. CSC se apna Chirayu card lein.
answer_te: చిరాయు హర్యానా యోజన కింద అర్హులైన కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత నగదు రహిత ఆసుపత్రి చికిత్స లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Vivah Shagun Yojana
benefit: Financial grant up to ₹71,000 for daughter's wedding in SC/BPL families (and ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 for other backward and general poor categories).
eligibility: Permanent resident girls of Haryana marrying at legal age (18+), family annual income below ₹1.80 Lakh as per PPP.
documents: PPP ID, Bride and groom birth proofs, Wedding invitation card, Marriage registration certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhya Mantri Vivah Shagun Yojana offers up to ₹71,000 grant for daughters' marriages of BPL/SC families in Haryana. Apply online before or within 6 months of wedding at shaadi.edisha.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री विवाह शगुन योजना के तहत बीपीएल और अनुसूचित वर्ग की बेटियों की शादी के लिए ₹71,000 तक की शगुन राशि दी जाती है। shaadi.edisha.gov.in पर शादी से पहले आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Vivah Shagun Yojana me beti ki shadi ke liye Haryana govt ₹71,000 tak ki financial help deti hai. shaadi.edisha.gov.in par register karein.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి వివాహ శగున్ యోజన హర్యానాలోని పేద కుటుంబాల కుమార్తెల వివాహానికి ₹71,000 వరకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Old Age Samman Allowance (Haryana Old Age Pension)
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹3,000 per month credited directly to the senior citizen's bank account with automatic auto-approval.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above residing in Haryana with combined spouse annual income not exceeding ₹3 Lakh.
documents: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), Aadhaar card, Age proof, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Haryana Old Age Samman Allowance gives ₹3,000 monthly pension to residents aged 60+. Approval is automatic once age is verified in Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
answer_hi: हरियाणा वृद्धावस्था सम्मान भत्ते के तहत 60 वर्ष या अधिक उम्र के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹3,000 प्रति माह पेंशन मिलती है। यह PPP आईडी में उम्र 60 होते ही स्वतः शुरू हो जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Haryana Old Age Pension me 60 saal se bade buzurgo ko har mahine ₹3,000 milte hain. PPP me age verify hone par automatic sanction ho jata hai.
answer_te: హర్యానా వృద్ధాప్య సమ్మాన్ భత్యం కింద 60 ఏళ్లు దాటిన వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹3,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది. PPP ద్వారా ఆటోమేటిక్ మంజూరు.

name: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana (BBY)
benefit: Direct compensation of price deficit to farmers if wholesale mandi prices fall below the state guaranteed base price for vegetables and fruits.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating recognized horticulture crops (potato, onion, tomato, cauliflower, etc.) registered on Meri Fasal Mera Byora.
documents: Meri Fasal Mera Byora registration, Land revenue record (Fard/Jamabandi), Mandi J-Form, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana safeguards Haryana vegetable and fruit farmers against price crash by paying the deficit amount directly into bank accounts. Register crops at fasal.haryana.gov.in.
answer_hi: भावांतर भरपाई योजना (BBY) के तहत यदि मंडियों में सब्जियों व फलों के दाम सरकार के बेस प्राइस से कम होते हैं, तो घाटे की भरपाई सीधे किसान के खाते में होती है। fasal.haryana.gov.in पर पंजीकरण करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana me mandi me rate girne par difference price govt direct farmer ke account me bhejti hai. Meri Fasal Mera Byora pe crop register karein.
answer_te: భావాంతర్ భర్పాయీ యోజన ద్వారా కూరగాయలు మరియు పండ్ల ధరలు పడిపోయినప్పుడు ప్రభుత్వం ధర వ్యత్యాసాన్ని రైతు బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో నేరుగా జమ చేస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Antyodaya Parivar Utthan Yojana (MMAPUY)
benefit: Targeted package of subsidized micro-loans, skill development, and employment linkages to elevate lowest-income families' income to at least ₹1.80 Lakh/year.
eligibility: Haryana resident families identified through PPP whose annual verified family income is below ₹1 Lakh.
documents: Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: MMAPUY identifies Haryana's poorest families (earning below ₹1 Lakh) and provides subsidized loans and job training to boost their income to ₹1.80 Lakh+. Attend district Utthan camps.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री अंत्योदय परिवार उत्थान योजना के तहत ₹1 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों को ऋण, सब्सिडी और कौशल प्रशिक्षण देकर आय ₹1.80 लाख से ऊपर ले जाई जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Antyodaya Parivar Utthan me sabse kam income wale parivaron ko business start karne ke liye subsidized loans aur skill training milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి అంత్యోదయ పరివార్ ఉత్థాన్ యోజన పేద కుటుంబాలకు స్వయం ఉపాధి రుణాలు మరియు నైపుణ్య శిక్షణను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB)
benefit: Single-window online registration enabling guaranteed MSP procurement, drought/flood compensation (e-Kshatipurti), and agricultural input subsidies.
eligibility: All landowning and tenant farmers cultivating crops in Haryana.
documents: Aadhaar card, PPP ID, Land Khasra/Murabba details, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Meri Fasal Mera Byora is the mandatory portal for Haryana farmers to sell crops at MSP, claim flood/drought compensation, and receive farm subsidies. Register at fasal.haryana.gov.in.
answer_hi: मेरी फसल मेरा ब्योरा पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण कराकर हरियाणा के किसान एमएसपी पर फसल बिक्री, मुआवजा और कृषि सब्सिडी का सीधा लाभ पा सकते हैं। fasal.haryana.gov.in पर दर्ज करें।
answer_hinglish: Meri Fasal Mera Byora par register karke hi aap MSP par fasal bech sakte hain aur fasal kharab hone par compensation pa sakte hain. fasal.haryana.gov.in par register karein.
answer_te: మేరీ ఫసల్ మేరా బ్యోరా పోర్టల్ ద్వారా రైతులు ఎంఎస్పీ వద్ద పంటల అమ్మకం మరియు పంట నష్టపరిహారం పొందుతారు.

name: Nirogi Haryana Scheme
benefit: Comprehensive free comprehensive medical checkups, 25+ diagnostic tests, and free medicines for Antyodaya citizens at civil hospitals.
eligibility: Members of families with verified annual income up to ₹1.80 Lakh listed in Parivar Pehchan Patra.
documents: PPP Family ID, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Nirogi Haryana provides completely free health checkups, blood tests, and medical prescriptions for low-income families at all government hospitals and PHCs with PPP ID.
answer_hi: निरोगी हरियाणा योजना के तहत ₹1.80 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों को सरकारी अस्पतालों में 25+ प्रकार की मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य जांचें और दवाइयां मिलती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Nirogi Haryana scheme me low-income families ko government hospitals me free body checkup, blood test aur dawa milti hai.
answer_te: నిరోగి హర్యానా పథకం కింద పేద కుటుంబాలకు ప్రభుత్వ ఆసుపత్రులలో ఉచిత సమగ్ర ఆరోగ్య పరీక్షలు మరియు మందులు లభిస్తాయి.

name: Haryana Kaushal Rozgar Nigam (HKRN)
benefit: Merit-based, transparent contractual recruitment in government departments with EPF, ESI, and guaranteed minimum wages without middlemen or contract exploitation.
eligibility: Youth residing in Haryana registered on the HKRN portal with relevant educational/skill qualifications.
documents: PPP ID, Educational certificates, Experience certificates, Skill certificates.
answer_en: Haryana Kaushal Rozgar Nigam (HKRN) provides transparent contract jobs in state departments with EPF and health insurance. Register your profile at hkrnl.itiharyana.gov.in.
answer_hi: हरियाणा कौशल रोजगार निगम (HKRN) के माध्यम से सरकारी विभागों में अनुबंध आधार पर पारदर्शी भर्तियां, ईपीएफ और ईएसआई लाभ के साथ की जाती हैं। hkrnl.itiharyana.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: HKRN portal par qualify hone par govt departments me contractual job milti hai with EPF aur health benefits. hkrnl.itiharyana.gov.in pe profile banayein.
answer_te: హర్యానా కౌశల్ రోజ్‌గార్ నిగమ్ (HKRN) ద్వారా ప్రభుత్వ విభాగాలలో కాంట్రాక్ట్ ఉద్యోగాలు పారదర్శకంగా భర్తీ చేయబడతాయి.

name: Mukhyamantri Parivar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY)
benefit: ₹6,000 per year per eligible family to cover social security premiums (PMJJBY, PMSBY, PMKMY) with the balance credited as direct financial support.
eligibility: Haryana resident families with verified annual income up to ₹1.80 Lakh and landholding up to 5 acres.
documents: PPP ID, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: MMPSY offers ₹6,000 annual financial security to low-income Haryana families to fund accident, life insurance, and pension schemes. Apply at mmpsy.haryana.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री परिवार समृद्धि योजना के तहत ₹1.80 लाख तक आय वाले परिवारों को ₹6,000 सालाना मिलते हैं, जिससे जीवन व दुर्घटना बीमा प्रीमियम भरा जाता है।
answer_hinglish: MMPSY me eligible families ko ₹6,000 per year milte hain life insurance aur pension premium bharne ke liye. mmpsy.haryana.gov.in par apply karein.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి పరివార్ సమృద్ధి యోజన పేద కుటుంబాలకు ₹6,000 వార్షిక సహాయాన్ని అందించి బీమా మరియు పెన్షన్ ప్రీమియంలను భరిస్తుంది.

name: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
benefit: 100% tuition fee waiver, examination fee refund, and monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200 for post-matric higher education.
eligibility: SC, ST, and BC category students of Haryana enrolled in post-matric courses with family income below ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: PPP ID, Caste certificate, Income certificate, Fee receipt, Marksheets, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship provides full fee waiver and monthly maintenance stipends for SC/BC college students. Apply at harscholarship.gov.in.
answer_hi: हरियाणा पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति के माध्यम से अनुसूचित जाति और पिछड़े वर्ग के छात्रों को कॉलेज की पूरी फीस वापसी और मासिक भत्ता मिलता है। harscholarship.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: SC/BC students ko college fee reimbursement aur monthly stipend ke liye Har Chhatravritti portal (harscholarship.gov.in) par apply karna hota hai.
answer_te: హర్యానా పోస్ట్ మెట్రిక్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ ద్వారా ఎస్సీ/బీసీ కళాశాల విద్యార్థులకు పూర్తి ఫీజు రీయింబర్స్‌మెంట్ మరియు నెలవారీ అలవెన్స్ లభిస్తాయి.

name: Ladli Samajik Suraksha Bhatta
benefit: Monthly financial allowance of ₹3,000 per month for families having only daughters upon either parent turning 45 years of age.
eligibility: Parents who are permanent residents of Haryana having only biological daughters (no son living) from the 45th birthday of either parent until age 60.
documents: PPP ID, Daughters' birth certificates, Age proof of parents, Family self-declaration, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Ladli Samajik Suraksha Bhatta gives ₹3,000 per month to Haryana parents having only daughters once either parent reaches 45 years. Apply via Saral Haryana.
answer_hi: लाडली सामाजिक सुरक्षा भत्ते के तहत सिर्फ बेटियों वाले माता-पिता को 45 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने पर ₹3,000 प्रति माह भत्ता मिलता है। saralharyana.gov.in से आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Ladli Suraksha Bhatta me sirf betiyon wale parents ko 45 age cross karne par ₹3,000 monthly allowance milta hai. Saral Haryana se apply karein.
answer_te: లాడ్లీ సామాజిక సురక్షా భత్యం ద్వారా కేవలం కుమార్తెలు మాత్రమే ఉన్న తల్లిదండ్రులకు 45 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు నుండి నెలకు ₹3,000 భత్యం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana (JMMSY)
benefit: Direct benefit transfer of ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 annually) directly into the bank accounts of women aged 18 to 50 years.
eligibility: Resident women of Jharkhand aged 18 to 50 years belonging to poor and marginalized households, not paying income tax.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, Bank passbook linked with Aadhaar, Domicile certificate, Voter ID.
answer_en: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana provides ₹1,000 per month to eligible women aged 18 to 50. Register at special camps or mmmsy.jharkhand.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मंईयां सम्मान योजना (JMMSY) के तहत 18 से 50 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹1,000 (सालाना ₹12,000) मिलते हैं। पंचायत शिविरों या mmmsy.jharkhand.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Maiya Samman Yojana me Jharkhand ki 18-50 saal ki mahilaon ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank account me milte hain. Panchayat camp ya portal se apply karein.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మైయా సమ్మాన్ యోజన కింద జార్ఖండ్‌లోని 18-50 ఏళ్ల మహిళలకు నెలకు ₹1,000 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.

name: Abua Awas Yojana (AAY)
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹2 Lakh in four instalments to construct a permanent 3-room pucca house with a dedicated kitchen.
eligibility: Homeless families or families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in Jharkhand who are not covered under PMAY.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, MGNREGA Job card, Bank passbook, Land possession certificate.
answer_en: Abua Awas Yojana grants ₹2 Lakh in 4 installments to build a 3-room pucca house with kitchen for rural homeless families in Jharkhand. Inquire at your Gram Panchayat.
answer_hi: अबुआ आवास योजना के तहत बेघर व कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले परिवारों को 3 कमरों का पक्का मकान बनाने के लिए ₹2 लाख की आर्थिक सहायता मिलती है। ग्राम पंचायत में संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Abua Awas Yojana me Jharkhand ke homeless parivaron ko 3-room pucca ghar banane ke liye ₹2 Lakh milte hain 4 kishto me.
answer_te: అబువా ఆవాస్ యోజన కింద ఇళ్లు లేని పేద కుటుంబాలకు 3 గదుల పక్కా ఇల్లు నిర్మించుకోవడానికి ₹2 లక్షల ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme
benefit: Collateral-free education loan up to ₹15 Lakh at just 4% simple annual interest with flexible 15-year repayment tenure for higher education.
eligibility: Students who passed 10th and 12th from recognized Jharkhand institutions enrolling in premier higher educational institutes.
documents: 10th/12th Marksheets, Admission offer letter, Fee schedule, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Guruji Student Credit Card offers collateral-free loans up to ₹15 Lakh at 4% simple interest for higher professional degrees. Apply at gscc.jharkhand.gov.in.
answer_hi: गुरुजी स्टूडेंट क्रेडिट कार्ड योजना के तहत उच्च शिक्षा (इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल, लॉ आदि) के लिए बिना किसी गारंटी के 4% ब्याज पर ₹15 लाख तक का लोन मिलता है। gscc.jharkhand.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Guruji Student Credit Card se Jharkhand ke students ko bina collateral 4% interest par ₹15 Lakh tak ka education loan milta hai. gscc.jharkhand.gov.in par register karein.
answer_te: గురూజీ స్టూడెంట్ క్రెడిట్ కార్డ్ పథకం కింద ఉన్నత విద్య కోసం ఎటువంటి హామీ లేకుండా 4% వడ్డీకే ₹15 లక్షల వరకు రుణం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Sarvajan Pension Yojana
benefit: Universal monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month credited directly on the 5th of every month with no BPL quota restriction.
eligibility: Senior citizens (aged 50+ for ST/SC and 60+ for general), widows, deserted women, and persons with disabilities living in Jharkhand.
documents: Aadhaar card, Voter card, Bank passbook, Age certificate, Disability/Death certificate (if applicable).
answer_en: Jharkhand Sarvajan Pension provides ₹1,000 monthly pension universally to all eligible senior citizens (age 50+ for SC/ST, 60+ others), widows, and disabled persons without BPL caps.
answer_hi: सर्वजन पेंशन योजना में बीपीएल की बाध्यता खत्म कर सभी पात्र वरिष्ठ नागरिकों (एससी/एसटी 50+, अन्य 60+), विधवाओं और दिव्यांगों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Sarvajan Pension me bina BPL limit ke sabhi eligible buzurgo, vidhwayon aur divyangon ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank me milte hain.
answer_te: సర్వజన్ పెన్షన్ పథకం ద్వారా అర్హులైన వృద్ధులు, వితంతువులు మరియు వికలాంగులకు ఎటువంటి బీపీఎల్ పరిమితి లేకుండా నెలకు ₹1,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
benefit: Assistance for fruit-bearing tree plantation (mango, guava) on 1 acre of fallow land with guaranteed MGNREGA wages and sapling maintenance support for 5 years.
eligibility: Rural households possessing at least 0.5 to 1 acre of unused or fallow land in Jharkhand.
documents: MGNREGA Job card, Land possession certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana helps farmers convert unused land into fruit orchards with free mango/guava saplings and MGNREGA wages for 5 years. Apply via your Block or Panchayat.
answer_hi: बिरसा हरित ग्राम योजना के तहत 1 एकड़ बंजर भूमि पर फलदार बागवानी (आम, अमरूद) लगाने के लिए पौधे, खाद और 5 साल तक मनरेगा मजदूरी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Birsa Harit Gram me apni zameen par aam aur amrood ke baag lagane ke liye free saplings aur 5 saal tak MGNREGA wages milti hain.
answer_te: బిర్సా హరిత్ గ్రామ్ యోజన రైతుల నిరుపయోగ భూమిలో పండ్ల తోటల పెంపకానికి మొక్కలు మరియు 5 సంవత్సరాల పాటు వేతనాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Pashudhan Vikas Yojana
benefit: 50% to 90% government subsidy on purchase of milch cows, buffaloes, goats, poultry, and piggery units for rural livelihoods.
eligibility: Rural women, small farmers, ST/SC families, and widow/destitute beneficiaries residing in Jharkhand.
documents: Aadhaar card, Caste certificate, Bank passbook, Land/shed declaration.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Pashudhan Vikas Yojana provides 50% to 90% subsidy on dairy cattle, goat farming, and poultry units in Jharkhand. Apply via the District Animal Husbandry Office.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री पशुधन विकास योजना में दुधारू गाय, बकरी पालन और मुर्गी पालन के लिए 50% से 90% तक की भारी सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है। पशुपालन विभाग से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Pashudhan Vikas Yojana me dudharu gai, bakri aur murga palan ke liye 50% se 90% tak subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి పశుధన్ వికాస్ యోజన పాడి ఆవులు, మేకల పెంపకం కోసం 50% నుండి 90% వరకు రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Sona Sobran Dhoti Saree Yojana
benefit: One saree and one dhoti (or lungi) distributed twice a year at an ultra-subsidized rate of just ₹10 per piece through Fair Price Shops.
eligibility: BPL and Antyodaya ration cardholders residing across all districts of Jharkhand.
documents: Ration card (NFSA / Green Ration card), Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Sona Sobran Dhoti Saree Yojana distributes clothing (saree and dhoti/lungi) twice a year for only ₹10 each at PDS ration shops across Jharkhand.
answer_hi: सोना सोबरन धोती साड़ी योजना के तहत राज्य के सभी राशन कार्डधारी परिवारों को साल में दो बार मात्र ₹10 में साड़ी और धोती/लुंगी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Sona Sobran scheme me BPL ration cardholders ko saal me do baar sirf ₹10 me saree aur dhoti/lungi ration dealer se milti hai.
answer_te: సోనా సోబ్రాన్ పథకం కింద రేషన్ కార్డుదారులకు సంవత్సరానికి రెండుసార్లు కేవలం ₹10 కే చీర మరియు ధోతీ పంపిణీ చేయబడతాయి.

name: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship
benefit: 100% fully funded scholarship covering tuition fees, living expenses, airfare, and visa to pursue Master's or M.Phil in premier universities in the UK and Ireland.
eligibility: Youth from ST, SC, Minorities, and OBC categories of Jharkhand under 35 years securing admission in selected UK/Ireland universities.
documents: Foreign University offer letter, Domicile certificate, Caste certificate, Marksheets, Passport.
answer_en: Marang Gomke Overseas Scholarship fully funds postgraduate studies in the UK/Ireland for 25 tribal and backward class students of Jharkhand. Apply at mgjpmoscholarship.jharkhand.gov.in.
answer_hi: मरांग गोमके जयपाल सिंह मुंडा विदेशी छात्रवृत्ति के तहत यूके और आयरलैंड में उच्च शिक्षा के लिए 100% खर्च (ट्यूशन, रहना, वीजा) झारखंड सरकार देती है।
answer_hinglish: Marang Gomke scheme me UK aur Ireland ke top universities me master degree ke liye poora kharcha (fees + travel + stay) govt uthati hai.
answer_te: మారంగ్ గోమ్కే విదేశీ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ ద్వారా ఎంపికైన గిరిజన విద్యార్థులకు యూకేలో మాస్టర్స్ చదువుకోవడానికి 100% పూర్తి ఖర్చులను ప్రభుత్వం భరిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Rojgar Srijan Yojana (MMRSY)
benefit: Subsidized enterprise loans up to ₹25 Lakh with 40% government subsidy (up to ₹5 Lakh) for starting vehicles, shops, and micro enterprises.
eligibility: Resident youth of Jharkhand aged 18 to 45 years belonging to ST, SC, Minority, Backward Classes, or Divyang communities.
documents: Aadhaar card, Caste certificate, Project proposal, Bank passbook, Residential certificate.
answer_en: MMRSY provides business loans up to ₹25 Lakh with 40% capital subsidy (max ₹5 Lakh) for youth starting their own ventures in Jharkhand. Apply at mmrsy.jharkhand.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री रोजगार सृजन योजना (MMRSY) के तहत युवा उद्यमियों को नया व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए ₹25 लाख तक का लोन और 40% (अधिकतम ₹5 लाख) की सरकारी सब्सिडी मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: MMRSY me nayi dukan, transport vehicle ya micro business shuru karne ke liye ₹25 Lakh tak loan 40% subsidy ke saath milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి రోజ్ గార్ సృజన్ యోజన వ్యాపారం ప్రారంభించడానికి 40% రాయితీతో ₹25 లక్షల వరకు రుణం అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana
benefit: Waiver of outstanding standard agricultural crop loans up to ₹50,000 per farmer family.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing in Jharkhand who have taken KCC crop loans from commercial or rural banks before March 2020.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, KCC loan account passbook, Land records.
answer_en: Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana waives outstanding crop loans up to ₹50,000 for small and marginal farmers. Check eligibility with your KCC lending bank or jkrmy.jharkhand.gov.in.
answer_hi: झारखंड कृषि ऋण माफी योजना के तहत छोटे और सीमांत किसानों का ₹50,000 तक का केसीसी फसली ऋण माफ किया जाता है। jkrmy.jharkhand.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana me KCC fasal loan lene wale eligible farmers ka ₹50,000 tak ka baki loan maaf hota hai.
answer_te: జార్ఖండ్ కృషి ఋణ మాఫీ యోజన కింద చిన్న మరియు సన్నకారు రైతుల ₹50,000 వరకు పంట రుణాలు మాఫీ చేయబడతాయి.

name: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana (SPKSY)
benefit: Direct cumulative financial assistance of up to ₹40,000 paid in phases from Class 8 to age 19 to prevent child marriage and promote girl education.
eligibility: Adolescent girls studying in government/recognized schools from Class 8 onwards in Jharkhand.
documents: School enrollment certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook in girl's name, Mother's voter ID.
answer_en: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana provides up to ₹40,000 in stages from Class 8 till age 19 for girl students in Jharkhand. Apply through your school principal.
answer_hi: सावित्रीबाई फुले किशोरी समृद्धि योजना के तहत कक्षा 8 से 12वीं और 18-19 वर्ष की आयु तक बालिकाओं को कुल ₹40,000 तक की सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: SPKSY me 8th class se 12th class tak aur 19 saal hone par ladkiyon ko total ₹40,000 tak ki scholarship milti hai school ke through.
answer_te: సావిత్రిబాయి పూలే కిషోరి సమృద్ధి యోజన ద్వారా బాలికల చదువు కోసం 8వ తరగతి నుండి మొత్తం ₹40,000 వరకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana
benefit: Free bus travel for senior citizens, students, disabled persons, and freedom fighters, connecting remote rural villages to block and district headquarters.
eligibility: Residents of remote villages in Jharkhand belonging to designated vulnerable categories.
documents: Student ID / Senior citizen card / Disability certificate, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana provides free bus travel cards for students, seniors, and disabled citizens traveling from villages to district headquarters in Jharkhand.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री ग्राम गाड़ी योजना के तहत ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों से शहर जाने वाले बुजुर्गों, विद्यार्थियों और दिव्यांगों को बसों में मुफ्त यात्रा की सुविधा मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Gram Gadi Yojana me gaon ke students, senior citizens aur disabled logo ko block/district tak free bus travel pass milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి గ్రామ్ గాడీ యోజన గ్రామీణ ప్రజలకు, విద్యార్థులకు మరియు వృద్ధులకు ఉచిత బస్సు ప్రయాణ సదుపాయాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana
benefit: Direct bank transfer of ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 annually) directly into the Aadhaar-linked accounts of married women.
eligibility: Married women (including widows, abandoned, and divorcees) aged 21 and above who are permanent residents of Chhattisgarh.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook linked with Aadhaar, Marriage certificate/declaration, Domicile certificate, Ration card.
answer_en: Mahtari Vandan Yojana provides ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000/year) to all married women aged 21+ in Chhattisgarh. Check status and apply at mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in.
answer_hi: महतारी वंदन योजना के तहत छत्तीसगढ़ की विवाहित महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹1,000 (सालाना ₹12,000) सीधे उनके बैंक खाते में मिलते हैं। mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Mahtari Vandan Yojana me CG ki 21+ age ki sabhi married women ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank account me milte hain. mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in par check karein.
answer_te: మహతారి వందన్ యోజన కింద ఛత్తీస్‌గఢ్‌లోని వివాహిత మహిళలకు నెలకు ₹1,000 (సంవత్సరానికి ₹12,000) నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.

name: Krishak Unnati Yojana
benefit: Direct transfer of differential paddy purchase price ensuring farmers receive ₹3,100 per quintal (up to 21 quintals per acre) directly into their bank accounts.
eligibility: Farmers of Chhattisgarh registered on the unified farmer portal selling paddy at cooperative societies.
documents: Kisan Rin Pustika (B-1/P-II land records), Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Society procurement receipt.
answer_en: Krishak Unnati Yojana guarantees Chhattisgarh farmers ₹3,100 per quintal for paddy procurement with the bonus differential transferred directly via DBT.
answer_hi: कृषक उन्नति योजना के तहत छत्तीसगढ़ के किसानों को धान की खरीद पर ₹3,100 प्रति क्विंटल का भुगतान किया जाता है और अंतर की राशि सीधे खाते में भेजी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Krishak Unnati Yojana me paddy procurement par total ₹3,100 per quintal rate milta hai bonus differential ke sath direct bank me.
answer_te: కృషక్ ఉన్నతి యోజన ద్వారా వరి ధాన్యం కొనుగోలుకు క్వింటాల్‌కు ₹3,100 చొప్పున ధర వ్యత్యాసాన్ని రైతు ఖాతాలో నేరుగా జమ చేస్తారు.

name: Shri Dhanwantri Generic Medical Store Scheme
benefit: High-quality generic medicines and surgical supplies available to citizens at a heavy flat discount of 50% to 71% off MRP.
eligibility: Open to all citizens and residents of Chhattisgarh with a valid doctor's prescription.
documents: Doctor's prescription (no ration/income card needed).
answer_en: Shri Dhanwantri Generic Stores provide quality branded generic medicines at 50% to 71% discount across urban local bodies in Chhattisgarh. Visit any civic Dhanwantri store.
answer_hi: श्री धन्वंतरी जेनेरिक मेडिकल स्टोर योजना के तहत सभी नागरिकों को एमआरपी से 50% से 71% तक सस्ती दरों पर उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली जेनेरिक दवाइयां मिलती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Dhanwantri Generic Medical Stores par sabhi jaruri medicines aur surgical items 50% se 71% saste daam par milti hain prescription ke sath.
answer_te: శ్రీ ధన్వంతరి జెనరిక్ మెడికల్ స్టోర్ పథకం ద్వారా ప్రజలకు 50% నుండి 71% వరకు తక్కువ ధరకే మందులు లభిస్తాయి.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
benefit: Financial grant of ₹50,000 for daughter's marriage (₹35,000 in bank/demand draft, ₹8,000 for household gift items, ₹7,000 for ceremony arrangement).
eligibility: Daughters of BPL or economically weaker families aged 18+ in Chhattisgarh.
documents: BPL ration card, Age proof of bride (18+) and groom (21+), Bank passbook, Domicile certificate.
answer_en: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana provides ₹50,000 financial support for daughters' marriages in low-income families. Apply at the Child Development Project Office (CDPO).
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या विवाह योजना (छत्तीसगढ़) के तहत गरीब परिवारों की कन्याओं के विवाह के लिए ₹50,000 की कुल सहायता राशि प्रदान की जाती है। महिला एवं बाल विकास विभाग में आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: CG Kanya Vivah Yojana me BPL families ki betiyon ki shaadi ke liye ₹50,000 ki financial assistance milti hai CDPO office ke through.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి కన్యా వివాహ యోజన కింద ఛత్తీస్‌గఢ్‌లోని పేద కుటుంబాల కుమార్తెల వివాహానికి ₹50,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Dr. Khubchand Baghel Swasthya Sahayata Yojana (DKBSSY)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per year for Antyodaya/Priority ration cardholders and up to ₹50,000 for other families.
eligibility: All ration cardholders residing in Chhattisgarh across government and empanelled private hospitals.
documents: Ration card (NFSA / State ration card), Aadhaar card, Ayushman Card.
answer_en: DKBSSY provides up to ₹5 Lakh cashless health cover per family per year for priority cardholders in Chhattisgarh. Show your Ration/Ayushman card at empanelled hospitals.
answer_hi: डॉ. खूबचंद बघेल स्वास्थ्य सहायता योजना के तहत प्राथमिकता राशन कार्डधारकों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। अस्पताल में राशन कार्ड व आधार दिखाएं।
answer_hinglish: Dr. Khubchand Baghel Yojana me eligible cardholders ko ₹5 Lakh tak ka free hospital treatment milta hai empanelled private aur govt hospitals me.
answer_te: డాక్టర్ ఖూబ్‌చంద్ బాఘేల్ ఆరోగ్య సహాయత పథకం కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత చికిత్స అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Mitan Yojana
benefit: Doorstep delivery of 25+ government certificates (caste, domicile, birth, death, marriage, ration card amendments) by dialing toll-free number 14545.
eligibility: All citizens residing across municipal corporations and urban local bodies of Chhattisgarh.
documents: Relevant identification proofs based on the requested certificate service.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Mitan Yojana delivers official certificates (caste, income, birth, domicile) straight to your doorstep. Simply dial toll-free 14545 to book a visit.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मितान योजना के तहत जाति, निवास, जन्म प्रमाण पत्र आदि घर बैठे बनते हैं। बस टोल-फ्री 14545 पर कॉल करें और मितान आपके घर आकर दस्तावेज बनाएगा।
answer_hinglish: Mitan Yojana me 14545 par call karke caste, domicile ya birth certificates apne ghar par banwa sakte hain bina govt office ke chakkar kate.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మితాన్ యోజన ద్వారా 14545 కి కాల్ చేసి కుల, నివాస, జనన ధృవీకరణ పత్రాలను మీ ఇంటి వద్దకే పొందవచ్చు.

name: Kaushalya Matritva Yojana
benefit: One-time lump-sum financial assistance of ₹5,000 deposited into the mother's bank account on the birth of a second girl child.
eligibility: Resident mothers of Chhattisgarh giving birth to a second female child in an institutional hospital.
documents: Institutional birth certificate of daughter, Mother's Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Ration card.
answer_en: Kaushalya Matritva Yojana grants ₹5,000 one-time financial support to mothers on the birth of their second daughter. Apply at the nearest Anganwadi center.
answer_hi: कौशल्या मातृत्व योजना के तहत दूसरी बेटी के जन्म पर माता के बैंक खाते में ₹5,000 की एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है। आंगनवाड़ी केंद्र से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Kaushalya Matritva me second baby girl hone par mata ke bank account me ₹5,000 ki financial help milti hai Anganwadi ke zariye.
answer_te: కౌసల్య మాతృత్వ యోజన కింద రెండవ కుమార్తె జన్మించినప్పుడు తల్లికి ₹5,000 ఒకేసారి ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Vriksh Sampada Yojana
benefit: 100% government subsidy (up to 5 acres) and 50% subsidy (above 5 acres) for commercial timber plantation (clonal eucalyptus, teak, bamboo, sandalwood) with buyback agreements.
eligibility: Landowners, farmers, trusts, and panchayats having private cultivable or fallow land in Chhattisgarh.
documents: Land ownership papers (B-1/P-II), Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Consent form.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Vriksh Sampada provides 100% subsidy up to 5 acres for commercial timber plantation with assured buyback. Apply through the Forest Department.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री वृक्ष संपदा योजना के तहत अपनी निजी जमीन पर 5 एकड़ तक व्यावसायिक पेड़ लगाने पर सरकार 100% सब्सिडी और पक्की खरीद गारंटी देती है।
answer_hinglish: Vriksh Sampada scheme me 5 acre tak timber trees (eucalyptus, teak) lagane par 100% subsidy milti hai Forest department se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి వృక్ష సంపద యోజన వాణిజ్య కలప చెట్ల పెంపకానికి 100% వరకు ప్రభుత్వ రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramik Awas Sahayata
benefit: One-time financial grant of ₹1 Lakh to registered construction workers for constructing a new pucca house.
eligibility: Registered construction workers with Chhattisgarh BOCW Board for at least 1 year possessing valid ownership land.
documents: BOCW Shramik card, Land registry/Patta, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Nirman Shramik Awas Sahayata grants ₹1 Lakh to registered construction workers in Chhattisgarh to build their own house. Apply at cglabour.nic.in.
answer_hi: निर्माण श्रमिक आवास सहायता योजना के तहत पंजीकृत निर्माण मजदूरों को अपना पक्का मकान बनाने के लिए ₹1 लाख की एकमुश्त अनुदान राशि मिलती है। cglabour.nic.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Registered construction workers ko apna ghar banane ke liye CG Labour Board ₹1 Lakh ki direct grant deta hai.
answer_te: నిర్మాణ కార్మికుల గృహ సహాయ పథకం ద్వారా రిజిస్టర్డ్ భవన నిర్మాణ కార్మికులకు ఇల్లు నిర్మించుకోవడానికి ₹1 లక్ష ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Sukhad Sahara Yojana
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹350 to ₹500 directly into bank accounts of destitute widows and abandoned women.
eligibility: Widows or deserted women aged 18 to 59 years living below poverty line in Chhattisgarh.
documents: Death certificate of husband (or deserted certification), BPL ration card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Sukhad Sahara Yojana provides monthly social security pension to destitute widows aged 18-59 in Chhattisgarh. Apply at your local Gram Panchayat or Municipal office.
answer_hi: सुखद सहारा योजना के तहत 18 से 59 वर्ष की निराश्रित विधवा महिलाओं को मासिक पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है। ग्राम पंचायत या नगर निगम में संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Sukhad Sahara me 18-59 age ki destitute widows ko monthly social security pension milti hai panchayat/ward office se.
answer_te: సుఖద్ సహారా యోజన నిరాశ్రయులైన వితంతువులకు నెలవారీ ఆర్థిక పెన్షన్‌ను అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Godhan Nyay Yojana
benefit: Procurement of cow dung at ₹2 per kg and cow urine at ₹4 per liter at village Gauthans to produce vermicompost and generate rural self-employment.
eligibility: Cattle rearers and livestock owners registered with village Gauthans across Chhattisgarh.
documents: Gauthan registration card, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Godhan Nyay Yojana purchases cow dung at ₹2/kg and urine at ₹4/liter at rural Gauthans, depositing payments fortnightly into cattle owners' bank accounts.
answer_hi: गोधन न्याय योजना के तहत गौठानों में पशुपालकों से ₹2/किलो गोबर और ₹4/लीटर गोमूत्र खरीदकर सीधा भुगतान बैंक खाते में किया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Godhan Nyay Yojana me Gauthans par ₹2 per kg ke rate par gobar purchase kiya jata hai jisse cattle farmers ko regular income milti hai.
answer_te: గోధన్ న్యాయ్ యోజన ద్వారా గ్రామీణ గౌథాన్లలో పశువుల పేడను ₹2/కిలో చొప్పున ప్రభుత్వం కొనుగోలు చేసి రైతులకు ఆదాయాన్ని కల్పిస్తుంది.

name: Crop Diversification Input Subsidy (Kisan Nyay)
benefit: Direct input subsidy of ₹9,000 to ₹10,000 per acre for cultivating pulses, oilseeds, millets (Kodo-Kutki), and horticulture instead of surplus paddy.
eligibility: Farmers in Chhattisgarh registered for crop diversification or growing millets/pulses.
documents: Farmer registration receipt, Girdawari verification, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Under Crop Input Subsidy, farmers cultivating pulses, oilseeds, or millets instead of paddy receive ₹9,000 to ₹10,000 per acre directly via DBT. Apply via kisan.cg.nic.in.
answer_hi: धान के बदले दलहन, तिलहन और मिलेट्स उगाने वाले किसानों को ₹9,000 प्रति एकड़ की इनपुट सब्सिडी सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Kisan Input Subsidy me paddy ke badle pulses, oilseeds ya millets lagane par ₹9,000 per acre seedha bank account me milta hai.
answer_te: పంటల వైవిధ్యీకరణ రాయితీ ద్వారా వరికి బదులుగా పప్పుధాన్యాలు మరియు చిరుధాన్యాలు పండించే రైతులకు ఎకరాకు ₹9,000 వరకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Nanda Gaura Yojana
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹11,000 on the birth of a girl child and ₹51,000 upon passing Class 12 for pursuing higher education.
eligibility: Permanent resident girls of Uttarakhand belonging to families with annual income below ₹72,000.
documents: Class 12 marksheet, Birth certificate, Income certificate, Domicile certificate, Bank passbook in girl's name, Unmarried declaration.
answer_en: Nanda Gaura Yojana awards ₹11,000 at the birth of a girl and ₹51,000 upon passing Class 12 for girls in Uttarakhand. Apply online at nandagaura.uk.gov.in.
answer_hi: नंदा गौरा योजना के तहत बालिका के जन्म पर ₹11,000 और 12वीं पास करने पर उच्च शिक्षा के लिए ₹51,000 की धनराशि सीधे खाते में दी जाती है। nandagaura.uk.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Nanda Gaura Yojana me beti ke birth par ₹11,000 aur 12th pass karne par ₹51,000 direct bank account me milte hain. nandagaura.uk.gov.in par apply karein.
answer_te: నందా గౌరా యోజన కింద ఉత్తరాఖండ్‌లో ఆడపిల్ల పుట్టినప్పుడు ₹11,000 మరియు 12వ తరగతి ఉత్తీర్ణత సాధించినప్పుడు ₹51,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana
benefit: Universal free cashless inpatient hospitalization coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for all resident families across empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: All permanent resident families of Uttarakhand holding a state NFSA or Ration Card.
documents: Ration card, Aadhaar card, Golden Ayushman card.
answer_en: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand provides universal ₹5 Lakh cashless hospitalization per year for every family in Uttarakhand. Generate your card at ayushmanuttarakhand.org or any CSC.
answer_hi: अटल आयुष्मान उत्तराखंड योजना के तहत प्रदेश के सभी परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। नजदीकी सीएससी या अस्पताल से अपना आयुष्मान कार्ड बनवाएं।
answer_hinglish: Atal Ayushman me Uttarakhand ke sabhi permanent families ko har saal ₹5 Lakh tak ka free hospital treatment milta hai.
answer_te: అటల్ ఆయుష్మాన్ ఉత్తరాఖండ్ యోజన ప్రతి కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత నగదు రహిత చికిత్సను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana (MSSY)
benefit: Allotment of 25 kilowatt grid-connected solar power plants to unemployed youth and returnee migrants with guaranteed UPCL 25-year power purchase agreements.
eligibility: Permanent residents and reverse migrants of Uttarakhand aged 18+ possessing suitable land.
documents: Land record (Khatauni), Domicile certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana helps youth set up 25 kW solar power plants with guaranteed buyback of electricity by UPCL. Apply via UREDA at msy.uk.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सौर स्वरोजगार योजना के तहत बेरोजगार युवाओं को 25 किलोवाट का सोलर पावर प्लांट लगाने के लिए ऋण व सब्सिडी मिलती है और बिजली यूपीसीएल खरीदता है। msy.uk.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Saur Swarojgar me 25 kW solar plant lagakar electricity board ko bijli bechkar regular monthly income kamayi ja sakti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి సౌర స్వయం ఉపాధి పథకం ద్వారా యువత 25 కిలోవాట్ల సౌర విద్యుత్ ప్లాంట్లను ఏర్పాటు చేసుకుని విద్యుత్‌ను విక్రయించవచ్చు.

name: Mukhyamantri Vatsalya Yojana
benefit: Maintenance allowance of ₹3,000 per month, free education, ration, and 5% horizontal government job reservation for children orphaned during COVID-19 up to age 21.
eligibility: Children residing in Uttarakhand who lost both parents or primary breadwinner to COVID-19.
documents: Parent death certificates mentioning COVID, Child's birth certificate/Aadhaar card, Guardian bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Vatsalya Yojana supports COVID-orphaned children with ₹3,000 per month, free school education, and ration until age 21. Contact the District Child Protection Unit.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री वात्सल्य योजना के तहत कोविड काल में अनाथ हुए बच्चों को 21 वर्ष की आयु तक ₹3,000 प्रति माह भरण-पोषण भत्ता, मुफ्त शिक्षा और राशन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Vatsalya Yojana me COVID orphaned children ko 21 saal ki age tak har mahine ₹3,000 allowance aur free education milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి వాత్సల్య యోజన కోవిడ్ సమయంలో అనాథలైన పిల్లలకు 21 ఏళ్ల వయస్సు వరకు నెలకు ₹3,000 భత్యం మరియు ఉచిత విద్యను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Swarojgar Yojana (MSY)
benefit: Subsidized bank loans up to ₹25 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹10 Lakh for service/trade with 15% to 25% government capital subsidy.
eligibility: Unemployed youth and returned migrants aged 18+ who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand.
documents: Detailed project report (DPR), Aadhaar card, Domicile certificate, Educational marksheet, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Swarojgar Yojana offers loans up to ₹25 Lakh with 15-25% subsidy to start manufacturing or service ventures in Uttarakhand. Apply online at msy.uk.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री स्वरोजगार योजना (MSY) के तहत उद्योग लगाने के लिए ₹25 लाख और सेवा क्षेत्र के लिए ₹10 लाख तक का लोन 15-25% सब्सिडी के साथ मिलता है। msy.uk.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: MSY me naya business shuru karne ke liye ₹25 Lakh tak loan 15% se 25% capital subsidy ke sath milta hai. msy.uk.gov.in par apply karein.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి స్వయం ఉపాధి పథకం ద్వారా పరిశ్రమలు మరియు సేవా రంగానికి 15-25% రాయితీతో ₹25 లక్షల వరకు రుణం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana
benefit: Distribution of nutritious green silage animal feed packs (Total Mixed Ration) at a heavily subsidized price of just ₹2 per kg directly in hill villages.
eligibility: Rural cattle-rearing women and livestock owners residing in the hill and remote terrain districts of Uttarakhand.
documents: Pashudhan card / Animal health card, Aadhaar card, Village cooperative society membership.
answer_en: Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana saves hill women from treacherous mountain forage walks by providing ready cattle fodder packs at just ₹2/kg at village cooperative societies.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री घस्यारी कल्याण योजना के तहत पर्वतीय क्षेत्रों की पशुपालक महिलाओं को मात्र ₹2 प्रति किलो की दर पर पौष्टिक पशु चारा (साइलेज) उनके गांव की समिति में उपलब्ध कराया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Ghasyari Kalyan me pahadi mahilaon ko fodder collection ke risk se bachane ke liye sirf ₹2/kg me ready silage animal feed pack milta hai cooperative society se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఘస్యారీ కళ్యాణ్ యోజన కొండ ప్రాంతాల మహిళలకు పశుగ్రాసాన్ని కేవలం ₹2/కిలో సబ్సిడీ ధరకు అందిస్తుంది.

name: Uttarakhand Old Age Pension Scheme
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,500 credited quarterly directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account of senior citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 and above residing in Uttarakhand with monthly family income not exceeding ₹4,000 (no income ceiling for citizens aged 65+).
documents: Aadhaar card, Age certificate/Voter ID, Income certificate, Bank passbook, Parivar register copy.
answer_en: Uttarakhand Old Age Pension provides ₹1,500 per month to eligible seniors aged 60+. Apply through your Block Development Officer or online at ssp.uk.gov.in.
answer_hi: उत्तराखंड वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष या अधिक उम्र के बुजुर्गों को ₹1,500 प्रति माह पेंशन मिलती है। समाज कल्याण पोर्टल ssp.uk.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Uttarakhand Old Age Pension me 60+ age ke senior citizens ko ₹1,500 har mahine bank account me milte hain. ssp.uk.gov.in se apply karein.
answer_te: ఉత్తరాఖండ్ వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 60 ఏళ్లు దాటిన వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹1,500 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది. ssp.uk.gov.in లో దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోండి.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
benefit: Free comprehensive post-delivery care kits containing clothes, almond oil, soap, sanitary napkins, blanket, and nutrition supplements for both mother and newborn girl.
eligibility: Pregnant mothers delivering girl children in government or recognized health centers in Uttarakhand.
documents: Hospital delivery discharge card, Mother's Aadhaar card, Anganwadi MCP card.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit provides free essential hygiene, warm clothing, and nutrition kits for mothers and newborn daughters upon hospital discharge. Inquire at your hospital or Anganwadi.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री महालक्ष्मी किट योजना के तहत सरकारी अस्पताल में बेटी के जन्म पर माता और नवजात शिशु के लिए कपड़े, पोषण और देखभाल सामग्री से युक्त मुफ्त किट दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Mahalakshmi Kit me hospital me beti ke birth par mother aur baby girl ke liye essential clothing aur nutrition kit bilkul free milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మహాలక్ష్మి కిట్ పథకం కింద ఆసుపత్రిలో ఆడపిల్ల జన్మించినప్పుడు తల్లి మరియు బిడ్డకు ఉచిత సంరక్షణ కిట్ అందించబడుతుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana
benefit: Free vocational skill development training, certification, tool-kit stipend, and placement assistance for minority and marginalized community youth.
eligibility: Youth aged 18 to 35 belonging to minority communities (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain) residing in Uttarakhand.
documents: Aadhaar card, Minority certificate, Educational qualification certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana provides free certified technical skill courses and tool-kit grants for minority youth across Uttarakhand. Apply via the Minorities Welfare Department.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री हुनर योजना के तहत अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय के युवाओं को रोजगारपरक तकनीकी कौशल प्रशिक्षण, प्रमाण पत्र और टूलकिट सहायता मुफ्त दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Hunar Yojana me minority youth ko free professional skill training aur toolkit assistance milti hai job placement ke sath.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి హునర్ యోజన మైనారిటీ యువతకు ఉచిత వృత్తి విద్యా నైపుణ్య శిక్షణ మరియు టూల్‌కిట్ సహాయాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Tourism Self-Employment Scheme
keywords: वीर चंद्र सिंह गढ़वाली पर्यटन योजना
benefit: Government subsidy up to ₹15 Lakh (33% to 50%) for setting up tourist homestays, hotels, fast-food outlets, and purchasing commercial tourist buses/cabs in hill areas.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Uttarakhand wishing to establish tourism ventures in designated hill circuits.
documents: Land revenue records, Project proposal, Domicile certificate, Driving license (for vehicles), Bank passbook.
