answer_en: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Tourism Scheme grants up to ₹15 Lakh subsidy for building homestays or buying tourist transport vehicles in Uttarakhand hills. Apply at vcsg.uk.gov.in.
answer_hi: वीर चंद्र सिंह गढ़वाली पर्यटन स्वरोजगार योजना के तहत होमस्टे बनाने या पर्यटन वाहन खरीदने के लिए ₹15 लाख तक की भारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है। vcsg.uk.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali scheme me pahado me homestay banane ya taxi/bus khareedne ke liye ₹15 Lakh tak subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: వీర్ చంద్ర సింగ్ గర్హ్వాలీ పర్యాటక పథకం హోమ్‌స్టేలు మరియు పర్యాటక రవాణా వాహనాల ఏర్పాటుకు ₹15 లక్షల వరకు రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Udayman Khiladi Unnayan Yojana
benefit: Monthly sports scholarship stipend of ₹1,500 per month (total ₹18,000 annually) for young school athletes aged 8 to 14 years.
eligibility: School students aged 8 to 14 residing in Uttarakhand who clear district sports physical battery fitness trials.
documents: Age proof certificate, School study certificate, Bank passbook in student's name, Domicile certificate.
answer_en: Udayman Khiladi Unnayan Yojana awards ₹1,500 monthly sports scholarship to promising school athletes aged 8-14 in Uttarakhand. Participate in district sports trials.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री उदीयमान खिलाड़ी उन्नयन योजना के तहत 8 से 14 वर्ष के 3,900 बालक-बालिकाओं को खेल प्रतिभा निखारने के लिए ₹1,500 प्रति माह खेल छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Udayman Khiladi scheme me 8-14 age ke school athletes ko physical test pass karne par ₹1,500 monthly sports scholarship milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఉదయమాన్ ఖిలాడీ ఉన్నయన్ యోజన 8 నుండి 14 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల యువ క్రీడాకారులకు నెలకు ₹1,500 స్కాలర్‌షిప్ అందిస్తుంది.

name: Gaura Devi Kanyadhan Scheme
benefit: One-time financial endowment of ₹50,000 for SC/ST and BPL girl students upon successfully passing Intermediate examinations.
eligibility: SC, ST, and BPL girl students who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand passing Class 12 from state-recognized boards.
documents: Class 12 marksheet, Caste certificate, BPL certificate, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Gaura Devi Kanyadhan grants ₹50,000 to SC/ST and BPL girl students upon clearing Class 12 in Uttarakhand to pursue university education. Apply at your district social welfare office.
answer_hi: गौरा देवी कन्याधन योजना के तहत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति व बीपीएल वर्ग की बालिकाओं को 12वीं उत्तीर्ण करने पर ₹50,000 की प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Gaura Devi Kanyadhan me SC/ST aur BPL girls ko 12th pass karne par higher studies ke liye ₹50,000 milte hain Social Welfare department se.
answer_te: గౌరా దేవి కన్యాధన్ పథకం ద్వారా 12వ తరగతి ఉత్తీర్ణులైన ఎస్సీ/ఎస్టీ బాలికలకు ఉన్నత చదువుల కోసం ₹50,000 ప్రోత్సాహకం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi
keywords: इन्दिरा गांधी प्यारी बहना सुख सम्मान
benefit: Direct monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 annually) credited into bank accounts of eligible women aged 18 to 59 years.
eligibility: Permanent resident women of Himachal Pradesh aged 18 to 59 years who are not government employees or pensioners.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bonafide Himachali certificate, Ration card, Bank passbook, Self-declaration.
answer_en: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi provides ₹1,500 every month to eligible women aged 18 to 59 across Himachal Pradesh. Submit forms at your local Tehsil or Welfare office.
answer_hi: इन्दिरा गांधी प्यारी बहना सुख सम्मान निधि योजना के तहत 18 से 59 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाओं को प्रति माह ₹1,500 (सालाना ₹18,000) पेंशन मिलती है। तहसील या कल्याण अधिकारी के पास फॉर्म जमा करें।
answer_hinglish: Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi me HP ki 18-59 age ki mahilaon ko har mahine ₹1,500 direct bank account me milte hain. Tehsil office se form lein.
answer_te: ఇందిరా గాంధీ ప్యారీ బెహనా సుఖ్ సమ్మాన్ నిధి పథకం కింద 18-59 ఏళ్ల మహిళలకు నెలకు ₹1,500 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.

name: HIMCARE Scheme (Himachal Health Care)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per year per family for families not covered under Ayushman Bharat.
eligibility: All bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh who are not covered under Ayushman Bharat or government employee medical reimbursement.
documents: Bonafide Himachali certificate, Ration card, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: HIMCARE provides ₹5 Lakh cashless hospital treatment per family per year for residents not under Ayushman Bharat in Himachal Pradesh. Register or renew card at hpsbys.in.
answer_hi: हिमकेयर (HIMCARE) योजना के तहत आयुष्मान भारत से छूटे परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। hpsbys.in पर अपना हिमकेयर कार्ड बनवाएं।
answer_hinglish: HIMCARE me Ayushman card na hone par bhi har saal ₹5 Lakh tak ka free cashless hospitalization milta hai HP ke empanelled hospitals me.
answer_te: హిమ్‌కేర్ పథకం కింద ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ వర్తించని కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత నగదు రహిత చికిత్స లభిస్తుంది.

name: Himachal Sahara Yojana
benefit: Direct monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month for patients suffering from specified critical and debilitating diseases (cancer, Parkinson's, paralysis, renal failure).
eligibility: Bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh belonging to economically weaker sections (family income up to ₹4 Lakh) suffering from certified chronic illnesses.
documents: Medical board illness certificate, Income certificate, Bonafide certificate, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Himachal Sahara Yojana provides ₹3,000 monthly financial aid to chronically ill patients (cancer, dialysis, paralysis) to meet treatment expenses. Apply via CMO or BMO office.
answer_hi: सहारा योजना के तहत गंभीर बीमारियों (कैंसर, पैरालिसिस, किडनी फेलियर) से पीड़ित मरीजों को देखभाल के लिए ₹3,000 प्रति माह की आर्थिक मदद मिलती है। मुख्य चिकित्सा अधिकारी से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Sahara Yojana me serious diseases jaise cancer, paralysis aur kidney dialysis ke patients ko har mahine ₹3,000 support milti hai CMO office se.
answer_te: హిమాచల్ సహారా యోజన క్యాన్సర్, పక్షవాతం వంటి తీవ్ర వ్యాధులతో బాధపడుతున్న రోగులకు సంరక్షణ కోసం నెలకు ₹3,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Swavalamban Yojana (MMSY)
benefit: Capital investment subsidy of 25% (30% for women, 35% for SC/ST/Divyang) on projects up to ₹1 Crore, plus 5% interest subsidy for 3 years.
eligibility: Bonafide Himachali youth aged 18 to 45 starting new small-scale manufacturing, service, or tourism enterprises.
documents: Project report, Land/lease proof, Educational certificate, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mukhya Mantri Swavalamban Yojana offers 25% to 35% capital subsidy and 5% interest subvention for youth setting up enterprises up to ₹1 Crore in Himachal Pradesh. Apply at mmsy.hp.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री स्वावलंबन योजना (MMSY) में युवाओं को नया व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए 25% से 35% तक कैपिटल सब्सिडी और 3 साल तक 5% ब्याज छूट मिलती है। mmsy.hp.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: MMSY me ₹1 Crore tak ka naya project lagane par 25% to 35% tak capital subsidy aur 5% interest rebate milta hai Himachali youth ko.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి స్వావలంబన్ యోజన కొత్త పరిశ్రమలు ప్రారంభించే యువతకు 25% నుండి 35% వరకు మూలధన రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Himachal Pradesh Old Age Pension
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for age 60-69 (income under ₹50,000) and ₹1,500 per month without any income ceiling for all citizens aged 70 and above.
eligibility: Senior citizens residing in Himachal Pradesh aged 60+ (universal with no income criteria for 70+).
documents: Bonafide Himachali certificate, Age proof/Panchayat certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Himachal Pradesh Old Age Pension provides up to ₹1,500 per month to seniors. For citizens aged 70+, there is zero income limit. Apply at your local Tehsil Welfare Office.
answer_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 60-69 वर्ष के पात्र बुजुर्गों को ₹1,000 और 70 वर्ष से ऊपर के सभी नागरिकों को बिना किसी आय सीमा के ₹1,500 प्रति माह पेंशन मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: HP Old Age Pension me 70+ age ke sabhi buzurgo ko bina kisi income criteria ke ₹1,500 har mahine direct bank account me milte hain.
answer_te: హిమాచల్ ప్రదేశ్ వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 70 ఏళ్లు దాటిన పౌరులకు ఎటువంటి ఆదాయ పరిమితి లేకుండా నెలకు ₹1,500 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanyadan Yojana (HP)
benefit: Financial grant of ₹51,000 for marriage of daughters of destitute, widow, or disabled parents in Himachal Pradesh.
eligibility: Daughters of widows or destitute families residing in Himachal Pradesh with annual family income below ₹50,000.
documents: Marriage card, Age proof of bride (18+) and groom (21+), Income certificate, Death certificate of father (if widow mother), Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhya Mantri Kanyadan Yojana awards ₹51,000 financial support for daughters' weddings of destitute and widow mothers in Himachal Pradesh. Apply via the District Welfare Office.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान योजना के तहत बेसहारा व विधवा माताओं की बेटियों की शादी के लिए ₹51,000 की आर्थिक मदद दी जाती है। तहसील कल्याण अधिकारी के पास आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: HP Kanyadan scheme me destitute aur widow mothers ki betiyon ki shaadi ke liye ₹51,000 financial aid milti hai welfare department se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి కన్యాదాన్ యోజన నిరాశ్రయులైన మరియు వితంతు తల్లుల కుమార్తెల వివాహానికి ₹51,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection with gas stove, regulator, hose pipe, and 2 free cylinder refills for families not having an LPG connection.
eligibility: Bonafide Himachali families who do not possess any domestic LPG connection and were not covered under PM Ujjwala.
documents: Ration card, Bonafide Himachali certificate, Aadhaar card of female head, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Grihini Suvidha Yojana provides a completely free gas connection, double burner stove, and refill cylinders to left-out families, making Himachal 100% smoke-free. Inquire at your Food & Civil Supplies office.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री गृहिणी सुविधा योजना के तहत उज्ज्वला से छूटे परिवारों को मुफ्त गैस कनेक्शन, चूल्हा और दो मुफ्त रिफिल सिलेंडर दिए जाते हैं। खाद्य एवं आपूर्ति विभाग से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Grihini Suvidha Yojana me free gas connection, gas stove aur 2 free refill cylinders milte hain HP ke unchulhed parivaron ko.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి గృహిణి సువిధ యోజన ఉచిత గ్యాస్ కనెక్షన్, స్టవ్ మరియు సిలిండర్లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Prakritik Kheti Khushhal Kisan Yojana (PK3Y)
benefit: Free training in Subhash Palekar Natural Farming (SPNF), 70% subsidy on procurement of indigenous desi cows (up to ₹25,000), and free plastic drum kit.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating agricultural or horticultural land in Himachal Pradesh adopting non-chemical natural farming.
documents: Land jamabandi record, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Farmer registration in PK3Y.
answer_en: PK3Y supports chemical-free natural farming with up to ₹25,000 subsidy on indigenous cows, input drums, and free certified training in Himachal Pradesh. Register via your Block ATMA office.
answer_hi: प्राकृतिक खेती खुशहाल किसान योजना (PK3Y) के तहत देशी गाय की खरीद पर ₹25,000 तक सब्सिडी, इनपुट ड्रम और प्राकृतिक खेती का मुफ्त प्रशिक्षण मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: PK3Y me chemical-free natural farming karne ke liye desi cow par ₹25,000 subsidy aur free preparation kit milti hai ATMA block office se.
answer_te: ప్రాకృతిక్ ఖేతి ఖుష్‌హాల్ కిసాన్ యోజన సహజ వ్యవసాయం చేసే రైతులకు దేశీ ఆవుల కొనుగోలుపై ₹25,000 వరకు రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Medha Protsahan Yojana
benefit: Financial grant of up to ₹1 Lakh for meritorious Class 12 and college students to undergo coaching for competitive examinations (UPSC, NEET, JEE, CLAT, CAT).
eligibility: Meritorious students of Himachal Pradesh scoring 75%+ in 12th/degree examinations with family annual income below ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: Academic marksheets, Income certificate, Bonafide Himachali certificate, Coaching admission receipt.
answer_en: Medha Protsahan Yojana awards ₹1 Lakh financial aid to meritorious students in Himachal Pradesh for coaching for exams like NEET, JEE, and UPSC. Apply via the Higher Education Directorate.
answer_hi: मेधा प्रोत्साहन योजना के तहत नीट, जेईई, यूपीएससी जैसी प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की तैयारी के लिए मेधावी छात्रों को ₹1 लाख तक की कोचिंग फीस सहायता मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Medha Protsahan Yojana me top students ko NEET, JEE aur civil services coaching ke liye govt ₹1 Lakh tak ki financial assistance deti hai.
answer_te: మేధా ప్రోత్సాహన్ యోజన పోటీ పరీక్షల కోచింగ్ కోసం మెరిట్ విద్యార్థులకు ₹1 లక్ష వరకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Beti Hai Anmol Yojana
keywords: hp girl birth post office deposit
benefit: Post office fixed deposit of ₹21,000 opened in the name of girl child at birth, plus annual school scholarship from ₹450 to ₹5,000 from Class 1 to graduation.
eligibility: Up to two girl children born in BPL families of Himachal Pradesh.
documents: BPL ration card, Birth certificate of girl, Bonafide certificate, Bank/Post office passbook.
answer_en: Beti Hai Anmol Yojana deposits ₹21,000 into a post office account for newborn BPL girls in Himachal Pradesh plus annual scholarships up to college. Apply via CDPO or Anganwadi.
answer_hi: बेटी है अनमोल योजना के तहत बीपीएल परिवार में बेटी के जन्म पर ₹21,000 की राशि पोस्ट ऑफिस में जमा की जाती है और पहली से कॉलेज तक वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Beti Hai Anmol me BPL girls ke birth par ₹21,000 FD deposit hoti hai aur school se graduation tak annual scholarship milti hai.
answer_te: బేటీ హై అన్మోల్ యోజన ఆడపిల్ల పుట్టినప్పుడు పోస్టాఫీసులో ₹21,000 ఫిక్స్‌డ్ డిపాజిట్ మరియు వార్షిక స్కాలర్‌షిప్‌లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Swarojgar Start-up Yojana
benefit: 50% government subsidy for purchasing commercial electric e-taxis, e-buses, and setting up 100 kW to 500 kW solar power projects on private land.
eligibility: Unemployed Himachali youth aged 21 to 45 holding valid driving license/commercial registration.
documents: Bonafide Himachali certificate, Commercial driving license, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Rajiv Gandhi Start-up Yojana provides 50% capital subsidy to youth buying electric taxis or setting up solar farms with assured tie-ups in Himachal Pradesh. Apply at transport.hp.gov.in.
answer_hi: राजीव गांधी स्वरोजगार स्टार्टअप योजना के तहत ई-टैक्सी खरीदने और सोलर प्रोजेक्ट लगाने के लिए 50% सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है। transport.hp.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: Rajiv Gandhi Startup scheme me electric commercial taxi khareedne par 50% direct subsidy milti hai youth ko self-employment ke liye.
answer_te: రాజీవ్ గాంధీ స్టార్టప్ పథకం ఎలక్ట్రిక్ టాక్సీల కొనుగోలుపై 50% రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Ahar Yojana
benefit: Weekly egg, seasonal fruit, and nutritious milk supplementation along with hot cooked mid-day meals in government primary and middle schools.
eligibility: All students enrolled in government primary and upper primary schools (Class 1 to 8) across Himachal Pradesh.
documents: School enrollment record.
answer_en: Bal Poshan Ahar Yojana supplements mid-day meals with boiled eggs, milk, and seasonal fruits to boost child nutrition across government schools in Himachal Pradesh.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री बाल पोषण आहार योजना के तहत सरकारी स्कूलों के बच्चों को मिड-डे मील के साथ उबले अंडे, दूध और मौसमी फल दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bal Poshan Ahar Yojana me school ke bacchon ko regular mid-day meal ke sath eggs, milk aur fruits diye jate hain malnutrition dur karne ke liye.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి బాల పోషణ్ ఆహార్ యోజన పాఠశాల విద్యార్థులకు ఉచిత పాలు, గుడ్లు మరియు పండ్లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Griha Aadhar Scheme
benefit: Monthly direct financial assistance of ₹1,500 deposited directly into bank accounts of homemakers to protect family nutritional balance against inflation.
eligibility: Married women/homemakers who are residents of Goa (15-year domicile) whose total gross family annual income is below ₹3 Lakh.
documents: 15-year Goa residence certificate, Marriage certificate, Family income certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Griha Aadhar Scheme provides ₹1,500 per month to Goan homemakers to mitigate the impact of price rise. Apply through the Directorate of Women & Child Development at goaonline.gov.in.
answer_hi: गृह आधार योजना के तहत गोवा की गृहिणियों को घरेलू खर्च और महंगाई से राहत के लिए ₹1,500 प्रति माह सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलते हैं। goaonline.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Griha Aadhar Scheme me Goa ki housewives ko har mahine ₹1,500 direct bank account me milte hain. goaonline.gov.in se apply karein.
answer_te: గృహ ఆధార్ పథకం ద్వారా గోవాలోని గృహిణులకు నెలకు ₹1,500 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.

name: Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS)
benefit: Monthly pension ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹3,500 per month for senior citizens, widows, and disabled citizens directly via bank transfer.
eligibility: Senior citizens (aged 60+), widows, orphans, and persons with disabilities residing in Goa for at least 15 years with family income below ₹1.5 Lakh.
documents: 15-year residence certificate, Age proof/Disability certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: DSSS provides ₹2,000 to ₹3,500 monthly social security pension to elderly, widows, and disabled residents in Goa. Apply via goaonline.gov.in or Social Welfare Directorate.
answer_hi: दयानंद सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजना (DSSS) के तहत गोवा के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों, विधवाओं और दिव्यांगों को ₹2,000 से ₹3,500 प्रति माह पेंशन मिलती है। goaonline.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: DSSS scheme me Goa ke elderly citizens, widows aur disabled persons ko ₹2,000 se ₹3,500 per month direct pension milti hai.
answer_te: దయానంద్ సోషల్ సెక్యూరిటీ పథకం గోవాలోని వృద్ధులు మరియు వితంతువులకు నెలకు ₹2,000 నుండి ₹3,500 వరకు పెన్షన్ అందిస్తుంది.

name: Laadli Laxmi Scheme (Goa)
benefit: Fixed deposit grant of ₹1 Lakh provided to Goan girls upon attaining 18 years of age, redeemable upon formal marriage registration or higher studies.
eligibility: Unmarried girls born and residing in Goa for at least 15 years (or parents 15-year domicile) upon turning 18.
documents: 15-year Goa residence certificate, Birth certificate, 10th/12th passing certificate, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Goa Laadli Laxmi Scheme deposits a ₹1 Lakh grant in the name of Goan girls turning 18 to support wedding expenses or higher career paths. Apply at goaonline.gov.in.
answer_hi: लाडली लक्ष्मी योजना (गोवा) के तहत 18 वर्ष की आयु पूरी करने वाली कन्याओं को ₹1 लाख की सावधि जमा (FD) सहायता दी जाती है। goaonline.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Laadli Laxmi Goa me 18 saal ki Goan girls ko ₹1 Lakh ki FD milti hai jo marriage ya study ke time claim ki ja sakti hai.
answer_te: లాడ్లీ లక్ష్మి పథకం గోవాలోని 18 ఏళ్లు నిండిన బాలికలకు వివాహం లేదా ఉన్నత చదువుల కోసం ₹1 లక్ష ఫిక్స్‌డ్ డిపాజిట్ గ్రాంట్ అందిస్తుంది.

name: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization health cover up to ₹4 Lakh per year for a family of 4 or more (and ₹2.5 Lakh for family up to 3) covering 447+ medical procedures.
eligibility: Any person residing in Goa for 5 years or more, regardless of income category.
documents: 5-year Goa residence certificate, Ration card, Aadhaar cards of all members, DDSSY health smart card.
answer_en: DDSSY is Goa's universal health insurance offering up to ₹4 Lakh cashless hospital cover across top private and government hospitals. Enroll at any GoaOne center or goaonline.gov.in.
answer_hi: दीन दयाल स्वास्थ्य सेवा योजना (DDSSY) के तहत 5 वर्ष से गोवा में रह रहे परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹4 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। GoaOne केंद्र से कार्ड बनवाएं।
answer_hinglish: DDSSY me Goa residents ko ₹4 Lakh tak ka cashless medical insurance milta hai 400+ treatments ke liye. GoaOne center se smart card lein.
answer_te: దీన్ దయాళ్ స్వాస్థ్య సేవా యోజన (DDSSY) కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి ₹4 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత ఆరోగ్య బీమాను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Rojgar Yojana (CMRY)
benefit: Subsidized enterprise loans up to ₹25 Lakh with 8% interest rebate and 25% share capital assistance for setting up industrial and business units.
eligibility: Resident youth of Goa aged 18 to 45 (up to 50 for SC/ST/women) who have resided in Goa for at least 15 years.
documents: 15-year residence certificate, Project report, Educational certificates, Bank account details, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: CMRY provides subsidized business loans up to ₹25 Lakh with interest rebates and capital aid to Goan youth starting new business ventures. Apply via EDC Limited at edc-goa.com.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री रोजगार योजना (CMRY) के तहत गोवा के युवाओं को नया व्यवसाय या उद्योग शुरू करने के लिए 8% ब्याज छूट के साथ ₹25 लाख तक का ऋण मिलता है। edc-goa.com पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: CMRY me Goan youth ko business shuru karne ke liye EDC dwara ₹25 Lakh tak ka subsidized loan interest rebate ke sath milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి రోజ్ గార్ యోజన (CMRY) కొత్త వ్యాపారాల స్థాపనకు వడ్డీ రాయితీతో ₹25 లక్షల వరకు రుణం అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Goa Solar Rooftop Subsidy Scheme
benefit: State top-up subsidy up to 50% combined with central PM Surya Ghar subsidy, offering up to 100% free rooftop solar installation for domestic consumers under 3kW.
eligibility: Domestic electricity consumers having rooftop space in Goa connected to the state electricity grid.
documents: Latest electricity bill, Property ownership document / NOC, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Goa Solar Rooftop Scheme provides up to 50% state subsidy over central grants for residential solar installations, slashing electricity bills to zero. Apply at goaenergy.goa.gov.in.
answer_hi: गोवा सोलर रूफटॉप योजना के तहत घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को छत पर सोलर पैनल लगाने के लिए केंद्र और राज्य सरकार मिलकर 80-100% तक सब्सिडी देती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Goa Solar Rooftop scheme me central + state subsidy combine karke 3kW tak ka solar setup almost free ya heavy discount par lagwaya ja sakta hai.
answer_te: గోవా సోలార్ రూఫ్‌టాప్ పథకం నివాస గృహాలపై సోలార్ ప్యానెల్స్ ఏర్పాటుకు 50% వరకు రాష్ట్ర రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Goa Shetkari Adhar Nidhi
benefit: Direct financial compensation for agricultural crop damage caused by natural calamities, wildlife, or pest attacks up to 100% of assessed loss.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating paddy, cashew, coconut, arecanut, and vegetables in Goa holding a valid Krishi Card.
documents: Krishi Card, Land ownership/Tenancy record, Village ZAO loss survey report, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Shetkari Adhar Nidhi reimburses Goan farmers for crop destruction caused by heavy rains or wildlife. Report losses within 15 days to your Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO).
answer_hi: शेतकरी आधार निधी योजना के तहत प्राकृतिक आपदा या जंगली जानवरों द्वारा फसल नष्ट होने पर गोवा के किसानों को सीधा मुआवजा दिया जाता है। जोनल कृषि कार्यालय (ZAO) से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Shetkari Adhar Nidhi me wild animals ya flood se crop damage hone par Krishi Card holders ko financial compensation milti hai.
answer_te: షెత్కారీ ఆధార్ నిధి పథకం పంట నష్టం వాటిల్లినప్పుడు గోవా రైతులకు పూర్తి నష్టపరిహారాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Kanya Dhan Scheme (Higher Education Goa)
benefit: Scholarship grant of ₹25,000 for girl students belonging to backward classes upon successfully completing their graduation or polytechnic diploma.
eligibility: Goan girl students belonging to OBC, SC, or ST categories completing degree/diploma courses from Goa University or recognized colleges.
documents: Graduation degree certificate, Caste certificate, 15-year domicile certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Kanya Dhan Scheme grants ₹25,000 cash incentive to backward class girl students in Goa upon graduating from college. Apply at the Directorate of Social Welfare.
answer_hi: कन्या धन योजना के तहत कॉलेज से स्नातक या डिप्लोमा पूरा करने वाली पिछड़ा वर्ग की छात्राओं को ₹25,000 की प्रोत्साहन छात्रवृत्ति मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Kanya Dhan scheme me OBC/SC/ST girls ko graduation complete karne par ₹25,000 one-time reward milta hai higher studies encourage karne ke liye.
answer_te: కన్యా ధన్ పథకం గోవాలో డిగ్రీ పూర్తి చేసిన వెనుకబడిన తరగతుల బాలికలకు ₹25,000 నగదు బహుమతిని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Goa Yuva Samvad Yojana
benefit: Free monthly mobile talktime and 3GB high-speed 4G/5G data per month on special SIM cards for college and university students.
eligibility: Youth aged 16 to 35 enrolled in higher secondary schools, colleges, and polytechnics across Goa.
documents: Valid college/student identity card, Aadhaar card, Bonafide study certificate.
answer_en: Yuva Samvad Yojana provides free monthly calling and 3GB high-speed mobile internet to enrolled college students across Goa. Apply via your college administration.
answer_hi: युवा संवाद योजना के तहत गोवा के कॉलेज विद्यार्थियों को हर महीने मुफ्त टॉक-टाइम और 3 जीबी इंटरनेट डेटा दिया जाता है। अपने कॉलेज कार्यालय से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Yuva Samvad Yojana me college students ko digital learning ke liye har mahine free calling aur 3GB data SIM card milta hai.
answer_te: యువ సంవాద్ యోజన కళాశాల విద్యార్థులకు ఉచిత టాక్‌టైమ్ మరియు నెలకు 3GB ఉచిత డేటాను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Devbhoomi Darshan Yojana
benefit: Completely free guided pilgrimage trips (including train travel, AC hotel accommodation, food, and security) to major religious destinations for senior citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 50 years and above who are 15-year bonafide residents of Goa.
documents: 15-year Goa residence certificate, Medical fitness certificate, Aadhaar card, Voter card.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Devbhoomi Darshan offers 100% free pilgrimage tours to religious shrines like Shirdi, Tirupati, and Ayodhya for Goan seniors. Apply at the Directorate of Social Welfare.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री देवभूमि दर्शन योजना के तहत गोवा के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को तिरुपति, शिरडी, अयोध्या आदि तीर्थस्थलों की यात्रा, भोजन और आवास का पूरा खर्च सरकार उठाती है।
answer_hinglish: Devbhoomi Darshan me Goa ke 50+ age ke senior citizens ko Tirupati, Shirdi aur Ayodhya ki 100% free teerth yatra karwayi jaati hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి దేవభూమి దర్శన్ పథకం గోవాలోని వృద్ధులకు ఉచిత తీర్థయాత్ర సౌకర్యాన్ని (ప్రయాణం, బస, ఆహారంతో) అందిస్తుంది.

name: Goa Mamata Scheme
benefit: Financial incentive of ₹10,000 for mothers delivering a female child in a government hospital in Goa.
eligibility: Mothers residing in Goa for at least 3 years giving birth to a girl child in a registered government medical facility.
documents: Hospital institutional delivery card, 3-year residence proof, Mother's Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Goa Mamata Scheme provides ₹10,000 financial support to mothers who deliver a girl child in government hospitals. Apply through your delivering hospital or CDPO.
answer_hi: ममता योजना के तहत सरकारी अस्पताल में बेटी को जन्म देने वाली माताओं को ₹10,000 की प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है। अपने अस्पताल या बाल विकास कार्यालय में आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Mamata Scheme me govt hospital me baby girl deliver karne wali mothers ko ₹10,000 ki financial assistance milti hai.
answer_te: గోవా మమత పథకం కింద ప్రభుత్వ ఆసుపత్రిలో ఆడపిల్లకు జన్మనిచ్చిన తల్లులకు ₹10,000 ప్రోత్సాహకం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Goa Cyberage Student Scheme
benefit: Free high-configuration laptops or digital tablets distributed to students entering Class 11 and professional polytechnics to bridge digital divide.
eligibility: Students studying in Class 11 in recognized Higher Secondary Schools or 1st year of Polytechnic institutes in Goa.
documents: School admission receipt, Student ID card, Aadhaar card, Parent residence certificate.
answer_en: Under Cyberage Scheme, all Class 11 and polytechnic students in Goa receive a free personal laptop/tablet for digital education. Distributed directly via schools.
answer_hi: साइबर एज योजना के तहत गोवा के 11वीं कक्षा और पॉलिटेक्निक के सभी विद्यार्थियों को डिजिटल पढ़ाई के लिए मुफ्त लैपटॉप/टैबलेट दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Cyberage Scheme me 11th class ke students ko school ke through high-spec free laptop distribute kiya jata hai.
answer_te: గోవా సైబరేజ్ పథకం ద్వారా 11వ తరగతి మరియు పాలిటెక్నిక్ విద్యార్థులకు ఉచిత ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌లు పంపిణీ చేయబడతాయి.

name: Mukhyamantri Chaa Sramik Kalyan Prakalpa
benefit: Integrated welfare package providing land ownership rights, pucca housing, piped drinking water, electricity, ration cards, and social security pension to tea garden workers.
eligibility: Registered tea garden workers and their families working across 54+ tea estates in Tripura.
documents: Tea estate employment register / token card, Ration card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Chaa Sramik Kalyan Prakalpa provides free housing, land patta, and social security for tea garden laborers in Tripura. Contact your tea garden welfare officer.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री चा श्रमिक कल्याण प्रकल्प के तहत त्रिपुरा के चाय बागान मजदूरों को पक्का आवास, जमीन का पट्टा, मुफ्त राशन और सामाजिक सुरक्षा मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Chaa Sramik Kalyan Prakalpa me Tripura ke tea garden laborers ko land rights, pucca makaan aur social security benefits milte hain.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి చా శ్రామిక్ కళ్యాణ్ ప్రకల్ప ద్వారా త్రిపురలోని టీ తోటల కార్మికులకు ఉచిత గృహ నిర్మాణం, భూమి హక్కులు మరియు సామాజిక భద్రత లభిస్తాయి.

name: Mukhyamantri Matru Pushti Uphaar
benefit: Free nutrition kit worth ₹500 containing Horlicks, ghee, milk powder, dates, soybean, and jaggery provided at each of the 4 mandatory Antenatal Checkups (total ₹2,000 value).
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating mothers undergoing regular ANC checkups at government PHCs and Anganwadi centers in Tripura.
documents: Mother & Child Protection (MCP) card, Aadhaar card, Anganwadi registration proof.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Matru Pushti Uphaar provides free nutritious food baskets (ghee, milk, dates, Horlicks) to pregnant women during each ANC visit. Inquire at your local Anganwadi.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मातृ पुष्टि उपहार योजना के तहत गर्भवती महिलाओं को हर प्रसव पूर्व जांच पर पौष्टिक आहार किट (घी, दूध, खजूर आदि) बिल्कुल मुफ्त दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Matru Pushti Uphaar me pregnant mothers ko hospital checkup par nutrition kit (ghee, Horlicks, dry fruits) free milti hai Anganwadi se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మాతృ పుష్టి ఉపహార్ పథకం గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలకు ప్రతి చెకప్ సమయంలో ఉచిత పోషకాహార కిట్‌లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Super-30 Scheme
benefit: Financial grant of up to ₹1 Lakh per student to undergo premier coaching in Kota or national coaching institutes for NEET and JEE entrance examinations.
eligibility: Class 10/12 passed students of Tripura securing high merit in state qualifying entrance test with family income below ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: Class 10/12 marksheet, State entrance merit rank card, Income certificate, Domicile certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Tripura Super-30 funds up to ₹1 Lakh for meritorious science students to receive expert coaching for NEET and JEE. Apply through the Directorate of Secondary Education.
answer_hi: त्रिपुरा सुपर-30 योजना के तहत मेडिकल (NEET) और इंजीनियरिंग (JEE) की तैयारी के लिए मेधावी छात्रों को ₹1 लाख तक की कोचिंग फीस सरकार देती है।
answer_hinglish: Tripura Super-30 me NEET aur JEE cracking coaching ke liye top meritorious students ko ₹1 Lakh tak ki scholarship milti hai.
answer_te: త్రిపుర సూపర్-30 పథకం ద్వారా నీట్ మరియు జేఈఈ పోటీ పరీక్షల కోచింగ్ కోసం మెరిట్ విద్యార్థులకు ₹1 లక్ష వరకు స్కాలర్‌షిప్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogayog Yojana
benefit: One-time direct bank transfer grant of ₹5,000 to final year undergraduate college students to purchase a smartphone for internet learning and career searches.
eligibility: Students studying in the final year of undergraduate degree courses in any government college or university in Tripura.
documents: College final year ID/Fee receipt, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Smartphone purchase invoice.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogayog Yojana provides ₹5,000 cash grant to final-year college students to purchase a 4G/5G smartphone. Apply at scholarships.tripura.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री युवा योगायोग योजना के तहत कॉलेज के अंतिम वर्ष के विद्यार्थियों को स्मार्टफोन खरीदने के लिए ₹5,000 की राशि सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Yuba Yogayog Yojana me graduation final year ke students ko smartphone khareedne ke liye ₹5,000 direct bank account me milte hain.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి యువా యోగాయోగ్ యోజన కళాశాల చివరి సంవత్సరం విద్యార్థులకు స్మార్ట్‌ఫోన్ కొనుగోలుకు ₹5,000 నగదును అందిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Grameen Awas Yojana
benefit: State top-up grant of ₹50,000 in addition to PMAY-G assistance, providing a total of ₹1.8 Lakh to construct resilient disaster-safe rural homes.
eligibility: Rural families living in kutcha or makeshift thatch homes who are enlisted in the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) in Tripura.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, Land possession certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Tripura Grameen Awas provides an extra ₹50,000 state grant over central housing funds to ensure complete pucca house construction for rural poor. Contact your Block office.
answer_hi: त्रिपुरा ग्रामीण आवास योजना के तहत प्रधानमंत्री आवास के अलावा ₹50,000 का अतिरिक्त राज्य टॉप-अप अनुदान दिया जाता है ताकि पक्का घर बन सके।
answer_hinglish: Tripura Grameen Awas me PMAY-G ke sath extra ₹50,000 state top-up milta hai permanent pucca ghar complete karne ke liye.
answer_te: త్రిపుర గ్రామీణ ఆవాస్ యోజన గ్రామీణ పేదలకు ఇళ్ల నిర్మాణం కోసం అదనంగా ₹50,000 రాష్ట్ర టాప్-అప్ సహాయాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Suniti Scheme
benefit: Monthly distribution of free sanitary napkins and menstrual health education packs to all adolescent girls in government schools from Class 6 to 12.
eligibility: All adolescent school-going girls studying in Class 6 through 12 across government and government-aided schools in Tripura.
documents: School enrollment register.
answer_en: Suniti Scheme provides free sanitary napkins every month to female students in Classes 6-12 across all Tripura government schools to promote girl child health and attendance.
answer_hi: सुनीति योजना के तहत त्रिपुरा के सरकारी स्कूलों में कक्षा 6 से 12वीं तक की सभी छात्राओं को हर महीने मुफ्त सेनेटरी नैपकिन वितरित किए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Suniti Scheme me school jane wali 6th se 12th class ki girl students ko monthly free sanitary pads distribute kiye jaate hain.
answer_te: సునీతి పథకం ద్వారా 6 నుండి 12వ తరగతి చదివే బాలికలకు ప్రతి నెలా ఉచిత శానిటరీ న్యాప్‌కిన్లు పంపిణీ చేయబడతాయి.

name: Tripura Mukhyamantri Old Age Social Security Pension
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹2,000 per month credited directly into bank accounts of impoverished senior citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above residing in Tripura belonging to BPL households or having annual family income under ₹1 Lakh.
documents: Aadhaar card, Age certificate, BPL ration card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Tripura Mukhyamantri Old Age Pension provides ₹2,000 per month to indigent seniors aged 60+. Apply at your local Gram Panchayat or Municipal ward office.
answer_hi: त्रिपुरा मुख्यमंत्री वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के बीपीएल बुजुर्गों को ₹2,000 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Tripura me BPL senior citizens ko har mahine ₹2,000 old age pension direct bank account me milti hai panchayat office se.
answer_te: త్రిపుర ముఖ్యమంత్రి వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 60 ఏళ్లు దాటిన పేద వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹2,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Rubber Mission Support
benefit: Capital subsidy of ₹50,000 per hectare for rubber plantation, free high-yielding budded rubber saplings, and subsidized smoke-house processing equipment.
eligibility: Small farmers and indigenous tribal jhumia families rehabilitating to settled agro-forestry in Tripura.
documents: Forest Rights Act (FRA) Patta / Land revenue record, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Tripura Rubber Mission provides ₹50,000/ha subsidy and free saplings to tribal and marginal farmers to cultivate high-value natural rubber. Contact TRPC or Forest Department.
answer_hi: त्रिपुरा रबर मिशन के तहत रबर बागान लगाने के लिए ₹50,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर की सब्सिडी, उन्नत पौधे और उपकरण दिए जाते हैं। TRPC से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Tripura Rubber Mission me rubber ke baag lagane ke liye free saplings aur ₹50,000 per hectare subsidy milti hai tribal farmers ko.
answer_te: త్రిపుర రబ్బర్ మిషన్ గిరిజన రైతులకు రబ్బరు తోటల పెంపకం కోసం హెక్టారుకు ₹50,000 రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana (Tripura)
benefit: One-time financial grant of ₹25,000 deposited into the bride's bank account to support marriage ceremony expenses.
eligibility: Daughters of BPL families in Tripura who have completed 18 years of age at the time of legal marriage.
documents: BPL ration card, Age proof of bride and groom, Wedding invitation card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana provides ₹25,000 financial support to poor families for their daughters' marriages. Apply at the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या विवाह योजना (त्रिपुरा) के तहत बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹25,000 की आर्थिक मदद सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Tripura Kanya Vivah me BPL parivaron ko beti ki shaadi ke liye ₹25,000 direct bank grant milti hai SDM office se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి కన్యా వివాహ యోజన త్రిపురలోని పేద కుటుంబాల కుమార్తెల వివాహానికి ₹25,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Bamboo Artisans Welfare Scheme
benefit: Tool-kit grants of ₹15,000, free advanced design training, modern splitting/slicing machines, and guaranteed export marketing linkages through TRIBAC.
eligibility: Traditional bamboo craft artisans, cane workers, and self-help group members residing in Tripura.
documents: Artisan Pehchan Card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Domicile certificate.
answer_en: Tripura Bamboo Artisans Scheme provides ₹15,000 modern tools, design training, and export support to bamboo handicraftsmen. Inquire at your District Industries Centre (DIC).
answer_hi: त्रिपुरा बांस कारीगर कल्याण योजना के तहत हस्तशिल्पियों को ₹15,000 के आधुनिक टूलकिट, उन्नत प्रशिक्षण और उत्पादों की बिक्री हेतु सरकारी मंच मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Tripura Bamboo Mission me bamboo artisans ko ₹15,000 ke advanced tools aur marketing support milti hai income badhane ke liye.
answer_te: త్రిపుర వెదురు కళాకారుల సంక్షేమ పథకం ఆధునిక టూల్‌కిట్ మరియు మార్కెటింగ్ మద్దతును అందిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Mukhyamantri Matsya Samridhi Yojana
benefit: 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Lakh) for establishing biofloc fish tanks, fingerling nursery ponds, and composite freshwater aquaculture units.
eligibility: Fish farmers, rural youth, and cooperative societies possessing owned or leased water bodies in Tripura.
documents: Waterbody/pond land record, Project estimate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhyamantri Matsya Samridhi Yojana grants 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Lakh) to set up biofloc fish farming units in Tripura. Apply via the Directorate of Fisheries.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मत्स्य समृद्धि योजना में मछली पालन और बायोफ्लॉक तालाब बनाने के लिए 50% (अधिकतम ₹2 लाख) की सरकारी सब्सिडी मिलती है। मत्स्य विभाग से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Matsya Samridhi Yojana me fish farming aur biofloc tank banane par 50% subsidy milti hai income generate karne ke liye.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మత్స్య సమృద్ధి యోజన చేపల పెంపకం యూనిట్ల ఏర్పాటుకు 50% రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Tripura Unorganized Workers Welfare Scheme
benefit: Accidental insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh, ₹5,000 annual scholarship for workers' children, and ₹25,000 maternity assistance for female registered workers.
eligibility: Unorganized sector workers (rickshaw pullers, domestic helps, construction laborers) registered with the Tripura Labour Welfare Board.
documents: e-Shram card / Shramik registration card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Tripura Unorganized Workers Welfare Scheme provides ₹2 Lakh accident cover, maternity aid, and educational scholarships for children of unorganized laborers. Register at labour.tripura.gov.in.
answer_hi: त्रिपुरा असंगठित श्रमिक कल्याण योजना के तहत पंजीकृत मजदूरों को ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा, प्रसूति सहायता और बच्चों की पढ़ाई हेतु छात्रवृत्ति मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Unorganized workers ko Tripura me ₹2 Lakh accident insurance aur bacchon ke liye scholarship milti hai Labour Welfare Board se.
answer_te: త్రిపుర అసంఘటిత కార్మికుల సంక్షేమ పథకం ₹2 లక్షల ప్రమాద బీమా మరియు పిల్లలకు స్కాలర్‌షిప్‌లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: FOCUS & FOCUS+ Scheme
benefit: Direct benefit transfer of ₹5,000 per farming household under FOCUS+ and ₹5,000 per member (up to ₹1 Lakh per Producer Group) for value chain development.
eligibility: All farming and rural households in Meghalaya organized into registered Producer Groups (PGs).
documents: Voter ID/EPIC, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Producer Group membership certificate.
answer_en: FOCUS & FOCUS+ is Meghalaya's flagship farmer support scheme providing ₹5,000 direct bank transfer per household to enhance farming operations. Register via focus.mbda.gov.in.
answer_hi: फोकस एवं फोकस+ (FOCUS+) योजना के तहत मेघालय के प्रत्येक किसान परिवार को ₹5,000 सीधे बैंक खाते में और उत्पादक समूहों को वित्तीय अनुदान दिया जाता है। focus.mbda.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: FOCUS+ scheme me Meghalaya ke har farmer family ko ₹5,000 direct DBT milta hai aur Producer Groups ko up to ₹1 Lakh capital support milti hai.
answer_te: ఫోకస్ & ఫోకస్+ పథకం కింద మేఘాలయలోని రైతు కుటుంబాలకు నేరుగా ₹5,000 బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.

name: Megha Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS VI)
benefit: Comprehensive universal cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5.30 Lakh per family per year, converging with PM-JAY and covering critical tertiary care.
eligibility: All resident families of Meghalaya (universal coverage) excluding state and central government employees.
documents: Electoral Photo Identity Card (EPIC), Aadhaar card, MHIS Smart Card.
answer_en: MHIS VI provides universal cashless hospital coverage up to ₹5.30 Lakh per family per year across top hospitals in Meghalaya and northeast India. Enroll at your local kiosk or mhis.org.in.
answer_hi: मेघा हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस स्कीम (MHIS VI) के तहत मेघालय के सभी परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5.30 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। mhis.org.in से अपना स्मार्ट कार्ड बनवाएं।
answer_hinglish: MHIS VI me Meghalaya ke sabhi residents ko ₹5.30 Lakh tak ka cashless health insurance milta hai bina kisi income barrier ke.
answer_te: మేఘా హెల్త్ ఇన్సూరెన్స్ స్కీమ్ (MHIS) ప్రతి కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి ₹5.30 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత ఆరోగ్య బీమాను అందిస్తుంది.

name: PRIME Meghalaya Entrepreneurship
benefit: Incubation, mentorship, and equity-free kickstart grants up to ₹5 Lakh to launch scalable startups and rural micro-enterprises.
eligibility: Entrepreneurs, artisans, and innovators who are permanent residents of Meghalaya with a novel enterprise idea.
documents: Business proposal pitch, Proof of residence in Meghalaya, Bank details, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: PRIME Meghalaya offers end-to-end incubation, mentorship, and seed funding up to ₹5 Lakh for local entrepreneurs. Apply online at primemeghalaya.com.
answer_hi: प्राइम मेघालय (PRIME) योजना के तहत स्थानीय युवाओं को नया स्टार्टअप या व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए मेंटरशिप और ₹5 लाख तक का सीड फंड मिलता है। primemeghalaya.com पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: PRIME Meghalaya me innovative business idea par ₹5 Lakh tak ka seed fund aur incubation support milta hai. primemeghalaya.com par pitch karein.
answer_te: ప్రైమ్ మేఘాలయ వ్యవస్థాపకత పథకం కొత్త స్టార్టప్‌ల స్థాపనకు ₹5 లక్షల వరకు సీడ్ నిధులను మరియు ఇంక్యుబేషన్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: MOTHER Programme (Safe Motherhood Scheme)
benefit: Free transport vouchers, free stay at Transit Homes near hospitals, and direct financial cash incentive of ₹2,000 for mothers undergoing institutional delivery.
eligibility: All pregnant mothers residing in rural and remote hill villages of Meghalaya.
documents: MCP card, Aadhaar card, Anganwadi registration, Bank passbook.
answer_en: The MOTHER Programme prevents maternal mortality by providing free ambulance transport, waiting transit homes near hospitals, and ₹2,000 cash for institutional childbirth.
answer_hi: मदर (MOTHER) कार्यक्रम के तहत ग्रामीण गर्भवती महिलाओं को अस्पताल में सुरक्षित प्रसव के लिए मुफ्त एम्बुलेंस, ट्रांजिट होम और ₹2,000 की प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: MOTHER Programme me hilly gaon ki pregnant women ko hospital tak free ride aur ₹2,000 incentive milta hai safe institutional delivery ke liye.
answer_te: మదర్ ప్రోగ్రామ్ సురక్షితమైన ఆసుపత్రి ప్రసవాల కోసం ఉచిత రవాణా మరియు ₹2,000 నగదు ప్రోత్సాహకాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Meghalaya Piggery Mission
benefit: Interest-free bank loans up to ₹4 Lakh, 50% capital subsidy on fattening/breeding units, and free supply of exotic high-yield piglets and feed.
eligibility: Members of registered Livestock Cooperative Societies and rural farmers residing in Meghalaya.
documents: Cooperative society membership, Land possession certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Meghalaya Piggery Mission provides interest-free loans and 50% subsidy to set up pig breeding and fattening farms. Apply through the Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department.
answer_hi: मेघालय पिग्गरी मिशन के तहत सुअर पालन इकाइयां स्थापित करने के लिए ब्याज-मुक्त ऋण और 50% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है। पशुपालन विभाग से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Meghalaya Piggery Mission me pig farming shuru karne ke liye interest-free loan aur 50% capital subsidy milti hai cooperative societies ke zariye.
answer_te: మేఘాలయ పిగ్గరీ మిషన్ పందుల పెంపకం యూనిట్ల ఏర్పాటుకు వడ్డీ లేని రుణాలు మరియు 50% రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Meghalaya Milk Mission
benefit: Interest-free bank loans, 50% subsidy on purchase of crossbred milch cows, and bulk milk coolers to attain self-sufficiency in dairy.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers who are members of village dairy cooperative societies in Meghalaya.
documents: Dairy society membership card, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Meghalaya Milk Mission supports dairy farmers with subsidized crossbred cows, free veterinary care, and assured milk buyback through chilling networks.
answer_hi: मेघालय मिल्क मिशन के तहत उन्नत नस्ल की दुधारू गायों की खरीद पर ब्याज-मुक्त ऋण और 50% सब्सिडी दी जाती है ताकि दूध उत्पादन में आत्मनिर्भरता आए।
answer_hinglish: Milk Mission me crossbred dairy cows khareedne ke liye zero interest loan aur subsidy milti hai dairy cooperative ke members ko.
answer_te: మేఘాలయ మిల్క్ మిషన్ పాడి రైతులకు ఆవుల కొనుగోలుపై వడ్డీ లేని రుణాలు మరియు 50% రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: CM Solar Mission Meghalaya
benefit: 70% government subsidy on hybrid rooftop solar-plus-battery inverter systems (from 1 kVA to 5 kVA) to eliminate load shedding for homes and small businesses.
eligibility: Domestic households, commercial shops, institutions, and clinics residing in Meghalaya.
documents: Electricity consumer ID, Aadhaar card, Building roof clearance.
answer_en: CM Solar Mission offers 70% state subsidy on hybrid battery-backed solar systems to ensure 24/7 power in homes and institutions. Apply at cmsolarmission.meghalaya.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सौर मिशन मेघालय के तहत घरों और दुकानों में बैटरी बैकअप वाले सोलर सिस्टम लगाने पर 70% की भारी सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है। cmsolarmission.meghalaya.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: CM Solar Mission me battery wale hybrid solar panel lagane par 70% subsidy milti hai power cut se mukti pane ke liye.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి సౌర మిషన్ బ్యాటరీ బ్యాకప్ సౌర వ్యవస్థలపై 70% భారీ రాయితీని అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Green Meghalaya (Payment for Ecosystem Services - PES)
benefit: Annual direct cash payment of up to ₹8,000 per hectare for 5 years to communities, clans, and individuals who conserve and protect natural forests.
eligibility: Villages, clans, or individuals holding legal ownership of native natural forest cover of at least 2 hectares in Meghalaya.
documents: Forest land boundary map/NOC, Clan/Pangkhang declaration, Bank account details, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Green Meghalaya pays up to ₹8,000 per hectare annually directly to communities and landowners who preserve standing natural forests. Apply at pes.megbma.in.
answer_hi: ग्रीन मेघालय (PES) योजना के तहत अपने प्राकृतिक जंगलों का संरक्षण करने वाले ग्रामीणों और समुदायों को प्रति वर्ष ₹8,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर की सीधी प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Green Meghalaya me jungle bachane wale gaon aur landowners ko har saal ₹8,000 per hectare reward cash milta hai environment conservation ke liye.
answer_te: గ్రీన్ మేఘాలయ పథకం సహజ అడవులను సంరక్షించే రైతులకు మరియు సమాజాలకు హెక్టారుకు ఏటా ₹8,000 వరకు నగదు ప్రోత్సాహకాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Meghalaya Aroma Mission
benefit: Free supply of high-yield lemongrass and citronella planting slips, distillation units, and assured buyback linkages to tap non-arable hill lands.
eligibility: Farmers and farming clusters possessing unutilized, rocky, or fallow hillside land in Meghalaya.
documents: Land holding document, Farmer cluster registration, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Aroma Mission provides free slips and processing equipment for commercial cultivation of lemongrass and essential oil plants on fallow hill lands. Contact the Directorate of Agriculture.
answer_hi: मेघालय अरोमा मिशन के तहत बंजर व ढलान वाली जमीन पर लेमनग्रास व सिट्रोनेला की खेती के लिए मुफ्त पौधे और तेल निष्कर्षण इकाइयां दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Aroma Mission me lemongrass aur aromatic plants ki kheti ke liye free plants aur distillation machines milti hain buyback guarantee ke sath.
answer_te: మేఘాలయ అరోమా మిషన్ కొండ ప్రాంతాలలో నిమ్మగడ్డి వంటి సుగంధ ద్రవ్యాల పెంపకానికి ఉచిత మొక్కలు మరియు యంత్రాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Meghalaya Rural Housing Scheme
benefit: Free distribution of durable Corrugated Galvanized Iron (CGI) roofing sheets (3 bundles per family) and financial assistance for shelter improvement.
eligibility: Economically weaker rural families residing in kutcha, thatch, or leaking homes across Meghalaya.
documents: BPL card / Village headman certificate, Land possession proof, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Meghalaya Rural Housing Scheme supplies free CGI roofing sheets to safeguard poor rural families against torrential monsoon rainfall. Apply via your Block Development Office.
answer_hi: मेघालय ग्रामीण आवास योजना के तहत भारी बारिश से सुरक्षा के लिए गरीब परिवारों को छत के लिए लोहे की नालीदार चद्दरें (CGI शीट्स) मुफ्त दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Rural Housing Scheme me barsaat se bachav ke liye kachhe makaan wale garib parivaron ko free CGI tin ki chaadarein milti hain BDO office se.
answer_te: మేఘాలయ గ్రామీణ హౌసింగ్ పథకం కింద పేద కుటుంబాలకు ఉచిత CGI రూఫింగ్ షీట్లు అందించబడతాయి.

name: Chief Minister’s Special Merit Scholarship Scheme
benefit: Cash awards of ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 for top rankers and high-scoring students in SSLC (Class 10) and HSSLC (Class 12) MBOSE examinations.
eligibility: Students appearing in MBOSE Class 10 and 12 examinations securing distinction or rank within top merit lists.
documents: MBOSE Marksheet, Admit card, School certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Chief Minister’s Special Merit Scholarship awards cash prizes to top-performing students in Class 10 and 12 MBOSE examinations across Meghalaya. Awarded directly through schools.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री विशेष मेधावी छात्रवृत्ति के तहत 10वीं और 12वीं बोर्ड परीक्षाओं में उत्कृष्ट अंक प्राप्त करने वाले विद्यार्थियों को नकद पुरस्कार दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: MBOSE 10th aur 12th board exams me top score karne wale students ko CM Merit Scholarship ke tehat cash awards aur citation milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ప్రత్యేక మెరిట్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పథకం 10వ మరియు 12వ తరగతి టాపర్లకు నగదు బహుమతులను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Youth Development Scheme
benefit: Direct grants from ₹50,000 to ₹2 Lakh for registered youth clubs, sports associations, and music societies to organize tournaments, music festivals, and talent camps.
eligibility: Registered village and urban youth clubs, self-help youth groups, and cultural associations in Meghalaya.
documents: Club registration certificate, Activity plan, Bank account details, Recommendation of Rangbah Shnong / Nokma.
answer_en: Chief Minister’s Youth Development Scheme provides financial grants up to ₹2 Lakh for local youth clubs to promote sports, music, and community talent. Apply via the Directorate of Sports.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री युवा विकास योजना के तहत पंजीकृत युवा क्लबों और खेल संघों को खेल व संगीत प्रतियोगिताओं के आयोजन हेतु ₹2 लाख तक का सरकारी अनुदान मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Youth Development Scheme me registered sports clubs aur youth organizations ko tournaments organize karne ke liye ₹2 Lakh tak ka grant milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి యువజన అభివృద్ధి పథకం క్రీడలు మరియు సాంస్కృతిక కార్యక్రమాలను నిర్వహించడానికి యువజన సంఘాలకు ₹2 లక్షల వరకు గ్రాంట్లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per year for critical illnesses and ₹2 Lakh for general procedures per eligible family.
eligibility: Widows, disabled persons, AAY cardholders, and economically vulnerable families in Manipur not covered under PM-JAY.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card / Income certificate, Disability certificate (if applicable), CMHT smart card.
answer_en: CMHT provides up to ₹5 Lakh free cashless treatment per family per year across empanelled hospitals in Manipur and outside. Apply at nearest kiosk or cmhtmanipur.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री-गी हकशेलगी तेंगबांग (CMHT) के तहत मणिपुर के गरीब परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। cmhtmanipur.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: CMHT card se Manipur ke poor families ko critical illness ke liye ₹5 Lakh tak ka free hospital treatment milta hai empanelled hospitals me.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి-గి హక్షెల్గి తెంగ్‌బాంగ్ (CMHT) పథకం పేద కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత ఆరోగ్య చికిత్సను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister-gi Sotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST)
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 per month for persons with disability, free assistive devices, and ₹1,000 monthly caregiver allowance for severely disabled.
eligibility: Persons residing in Manipur with certified disability of 60% or more, belonging to economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
documents: Disability certificate / UDID card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Income certificate.
answer_en: CMST provides ₹1,500 monthly pension, caregiver allowance, and free assistive aids to persons with severe disabilities in Manipur. Apply via Social Welfare Department.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री-गी सोथारबासिंगी तेंगबांग (CMST) के तहत 60% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को ₹1,500 प्रति माह पेंशन और देखभाल भत्ता मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: CMST scheme me Manipur ke disabled citizens ko ₹1,500 per month pension aur free motorized tricycles/aids milti hain Social Welfare department se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి-గి సోథారబాసింగి తెంగ్‌బాంగ్ (CMST) వికలాంగులకు నెలకు ₹1,500 పెన్షన్ మరియు సంరక్షణ భత్యాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Manipur Start-Up Scheme
benefit: Financial grants and subsidized loans: Revenue Stage (up to ₹30 Lakh loan + ₹9 Lakh subsidy), Idea Stage (up to ₹3 Lakh grant), and Entrepreneurship Stage.
eligibility: Unemployed youth and entrepreneurs residing in Manipur possessing viable startup plans.
documents: Detailed business proposal, Educational qualifications, Aadhaar card, Bank account details.
answer_en: Manipur Start-Up Scheme provides financial grants from ₹3 Lakh to ₹30 Lakh to foster innovation and self-employment among youth. Apply at startupmanipur.in.
answer_hi: मणिपुर स्टार्ट-अप योजना के तहत नया बिजनेस शुरू करने के लिए ₹3 लाख से ₹30 लाख तक का अनुदान और रियायती बैंक ऋण मिलता है। startupmanipur.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Manipur Start-Up me naye innovative enterprise ke liye ₹3 Lakh se ₹30 Lakh tak grant aur subsidized loan milta hai. startupmanipur.in par register karein.
answer_te: మణిపూర్ స్టార్ట్-అప్ పథకం వ్యవస్థాపకతను ప్రోత్సహించడానికి ₹3 లక్షల నుండి ₹30 లక్షల వరకు నిధులు మరియు సబ్సిడీ రుణాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: School Fagathansi Mission
benefit: Transformation of 120+ government schools into modern model schools with digital smart classes, free uniforms, science labs, and zero admission fees.
eligibility: School students enrolled in designated government model schools across all 16 districts of Manipur.
documents: School enrollment form.
answer_en: School Fagathansi Mission provides high-standard model government schools with smart classrooms, laboratories, and zero tuition fees across Manipur.
answer_hi: स्कूल फगथंसी मिशन के तहत मणिपुर के सरकारी स्कूलों का कायाकल्प कर उन्हें स्मार्ट क्लास, आधुनिक लैब और मुफ्त किताबों से सुसज्जित मॉडल स्कूल बनाया गया है।
answer_hinglish: School Fagathansi Mission me government schools ko private-standard model schools me upgrade kiya gaya hai free quality education ke liye.
answer_te: స్కూల్ ఫగథన్సి మిషన్ ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలలను స్మార్ట్ తరగతి గదులతో మోడల్ పాఠశాలలుగా తీర్చిదిద్ది ఉచిత విద్యను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Go to Village Mission (Khungang Chatse)
benefit: All government departments visit remote rural villages to issue Aadhaar, CMHT health cards, old age pensions, Kisan Credit Cards, and certificates in one single day.
eligibility: Rural and hill residents across all villages in Manipur.
documents: Aadhaar card, Birth certificate, Land revenue slip.
answer_en: Go to Village (Khungang Chatse) brings all government welfare services directly to the village doorstep. Attend the scheduled outreach camp in your village.
answer_hi: गो टू विलेज (खुंगंग चट्से) मिशन के तहत सरकारी तंत्र खुद दूरदराज के गांवों में पहुंचकर पेंशन, राशन कार्ड, स्वास्थ्य कार्ड और प्रमाण पत्र मौके पर ही जारी करता है।
answer_hinglish: Go to Village mission me administrative officers aapke gaon me camp lagakar ek hi din me CMHT, pensions aur certificates issue karte hain.
answer_te: గో టు విలేజ్ (ఖుంగంగ్ చట్సే) మిషన్ అన్ని ప్రభుత్వ సంక్షేమ సేవలను గ్రామాల్లో ప్రత్యేక క్యాంపుల ద్వారా నేరుగా ప్రజల ముంగిటకే అందిస్తుంది.

name: Manipur Handloom & Handicrafts Delivery Scheme
benefit: 20% yarn subsidy, ₹1.2 Lakh grant for construction of individual weaver work-sheds, solar lighting, and assured buyback through pan-India Panthoibi Emporiums.
eligibility: Traditional weavers and handicraft artisans residing in Manipur holding weaver identity cards.
documents: Weaver Pehchan Card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Land possession certificate (for workshed).
answer_en: Manipur Handloom & Handicrafts Scheme provides 20% yarn subsidy, ₹1.2 Lakh for weaving work-sheds, and buyback support for female weavers. Contact District Handloom Office.
answer_hi: मणिपुर हथकरघा व हस्तशिल्प योजना के तहत बुनकरों को 20% धागा सब्सिडी, ₹1.2 लाख का वर्कशेड अनुदान और पक्की खरीद व्यवस्था दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Handloom scheme me female weavers ko saste daam par yarn, ₹1.2 Lakh workshed grant aur Panthoibi emporium me product sale ki guarantee milti hai.
answer_te: మణిపూర్ చేనేత మరియు హస్తకళల పథకం నేత కార్మికులకు నూలుపై 20% రాయితీ మరియు వర్క్‌షెడ్ల నిర్మాణానికి ₹1.2 లక్షల గ్రాంట్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Alternative Livelihood for Poppy Cultivators
benefit: Comprehensive alternative livelihood packages including free high-yield ginger, cardamom, turmeric, and apple saplings, plus ₹50,000 cash grant to stop poppy farming.
eligibility: Farmers and hill village communities abandoning illicit poppy cultivation in Manipur.
documents: Village Authority recommendation, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: The Alternative Livelihood Scheme provides free fruit/spice saplings and financial grants to hill farmers transitioning from poppy to profitable horticulture. Contact Horticulture Directorate.
answer_hi: अफीम की खेती छोड़कर बागवानी अपनाने वाले पहाड़ी किसानों को मुफ्त सेब, अदरक व इलायची के पौधे तथा ₹50,000 की वित्तीय मदद दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: War on Drugs ke tehat poppy farming chhodne wale farmers ko high-value cash crops (ginger, cardamom) ke free plants aur ₹50,000 cash grant milti hai.
answer_te: గంజాయి సాగును విడనాడిన రైతులకు ఉచిత అల్లం, ఏలకుల మొక్కలు మరియు ₹50,000 ప్రత్యామ్నాయ జీవనోపాధి గ్రాంట్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Manipur Old Age Pension Scheme (MOAPS)
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month credited directly into bank accounts of senior citizens aged 60 and above.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above residing in Manipur belonging to BPL households.
documents: Age proof certificate / Electoral card, BPL certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Manipur Old Age Pension provides ₹1,000 per month to eligible BPL senior citizens aged 60+. Apply through your District Social Welfare Office or online portal.
answer_hi: मणिपुर वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना (MOAPS) के तहत 60 वर्ष या अधिक उम्र के बीपीएल बुजुर्गों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन मिलती है। जिला समाज कल्याण अधिकारी के पास आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: MOAPS me Manipur ke 60+ age wale BPL seniors ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank account me milte hain.
answer_te: మణిపూర్ వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 60 ఏళ్లు దాటిన పేద వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Rani Gaidinliu Nupi Scheme
benefit: Nutritional financial grant of ₹5,000 and institutional delivery kits distributed to pregnant tribal and rural mothers across hill districts.
eligibility: Pregnant mothers belonging to ST communities residing in hill areas of Manipur.
documents: MCP card, ST certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Rani Gaidinliu Nupi Scheme provides ₹5,000 cash assistance and nutrition support for tribal mothers in Manipur hill districts to promote safe child delivery.
answer_hi: रानी गाइदिनल्यू नूपी योजना के तहत मणिपुर के पहाड़ी जिलों की जनजातीय गर्भवती महिलाओं को ₹5,000 की वित्तीय व पोषण सहायता मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Rani Gaidinliu scheme me hill districts ki tribal pregnant mothers ko ₹5,000 financial support aur nutrition supplements milte hain.
answer_te: రాణి గైదిన్లియు నూపీ పథకం కొండ ప్రాంతాల గిరిజన తల్లులకు ₹5,000 ఆర్థిక మరియు పోషకాహార సహాయాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Manipur Blue Revolution Aquaculture Scheme
benefit: 40% to 60% government subsidy for construction of freshwater fish ponds, biofloc tanks, and circular cage culture in water bodies like Loktak Lake.
eligibility: Local fish farmers, unemployed youths, and registered fishery cooperatives in Manipur.
documents: Pond land ownership/lease papers, Project proposal, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Manipur Blue Revolution provides up to 60% subsidy for setting up commercial fish farms and cage aquaculture to boost local fish self-sufficiency. Apply at the Fisheries Directorate.
answer_hi: मणिपुर नीली क्रांति योजना के तहत मछली पालन तालाब और केज कल्चर स्थापित करने के लिए 60% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी दी जाती है। मत्स्य विभाग से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Fishery scheme me machli palan aur biofloc tank banane ke liye 60% subsidy milti hai youth aur fish farmers ko.
answer_te: మణిపూర్ బ్లూ రివల్యూషన్ ఆక్వాకల్చర్ పథకం చేపల చెరువులు మరియు కేజ్ కల్చర్ ఏర్పాటుకు 60% వరకు రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Manipur Green Mission
benefit: Free supply of indigenous fruit, timber, and medicinal saplings, fencing materials, and maintenance honorarium for afforestation of barren hill slopes.
eligibility: Village authorities, youth organizations, schools, and private landowners in Manipur.
documents: Land allotment/village authority permission, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Green Manipur Mission distributes free fruit and forest saplings and protective fencing to revegetate deforested hill slopes. Register with the Forest Department.
answer_hi: ग्रीन मणिपुर मिशन के तहत बंजर पहाड़ियों को हरा-भरा करने के लिए किसानों और ग्राम परिषदों को मुफ्त फलदार पौधे और बाड़ लगाने की सामग्री दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Green Manipur Mission me tree plantation ke liye forest department se free saplings aur protective material milta hai.
answer_te: గ్రీన్ మణిపూర్ మిషన్ అటవీ నిర్మూలనను అరికట్టడానికి ఉచిత పండ్ల మరియు కలప మొక్కలను పంపిణీ చేస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Livelihood Support Scheme
benefit: One-time direct financial assistance of ₹5,000 deposited into bank accounts of street vendors, daily wage earners, and transport drivers to revive micro-businesses.
eligibility: Street vendors, hawkers, auto/taxi drivers, and daily wage earners residing in Manipur whose livelihoods were disrupted.
documents: Vending license / Driver license / Worker identity card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Chief Minister’s Livelihood Support Scheme provides ₹5,000 direct bank aid to street vendors, transport operators, and daily wage earners. Inquire at your local Urban Local Body.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री आजीविका सहायता योजना के तहत रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों, ऑटो चालकों और दिहाड़ी मजदूरों को ₹5,000 की सीधी आर्थिक मदद दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Livelihood Support Scheme me street vendors aur daily wage workers ko apna dhandha firse chalu karne ke liye ₹5,000 cash grant milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి జీవనోపాధి సహాయక పథకం వీధి వ్యాపారులు మరియు రోజువారీ కూలీలకు ₹5,000 నేరుగా ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS)
benefit: Universal cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for all indigenous residents and state employees across empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: All indigenous inhabitants of Nagaland, permanent residents, and state government employees/pensioners.
documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate (IIC) / Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC), Aadhaar card, Ration card.
answer_en: CMHIS provides universal cashless hospital coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year across top hospitals in Nagaland and India. Register or download card at cmhis.nagaland.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना (CMHIS) के तहत नागालैंड के सभी मूल निवासियों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है। cmhis.nagaland.gov.in पर कार्ड बनाएं।
answer_hinglish: CMHIS me Nagaland ke indigenous residents ko har saal ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless hospital treatment milta hai. cmhis.nagaland.gov.in se register karein.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఆరోగ్య బీమా పథకం (CMHIS) నాగార్లాండ్ నివాసితులకు సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత నగదు రహిత చికిత్సను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Micro Finance Initiative (CMMFI)
benefit: Subsidized bank credit up to ₹15 Lakh for farmers, SHGs, and youth entrepreneurs with 30% capital subsidy and 4% interest subvention for 7 years.
eligibility: Farmers, Self-Help Groups, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and youth entrepreneurs residing in Nagaland.
documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Project proposal, Land document/NOC, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: CMMFI provides up to ₹15 Lakh bank loans with 30% capital subsidy and 4% interest rebate for agri and allied enterprises in Nagaland. Apply at cmmfi.nagaland.gov.in.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सूक्ष्म वित्त पहल (CMMFI) के तहत कृषि व व्यावसायिक उद्यमों के लिए 30% सब्सिडी और 4% ब्याज छूट के साथ ₹15 लाख तक का लोन मिलता है। cmmfi.nagaland.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: CMMFI me farming, bakery, transport ya small enterprise ke liye ₹15 Lakh tak loan 30% subsidy ke sath milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మైక్రో ఫైనాన్స్ ఇనిషియేటివ్ (CMMFI) 30% రాయితీతో ₹15 లక్షల వరకు సబ్సిడీ బ్యాంకు రుణాలను అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Honey & Beekeeping Mission (NBHM)
benefit: Free training in modern beekeeping, supply of scientific bee boxes and honey extractors at 80% subsidy, and guaranteed buyback of organic mountain honey.
eligibility: Rural youth, farmers, and community beekeepers residing across villages in Nagaland.
documents: Village Council recommendation, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Nagaland Honey Mission empowers villagers with 80% subsidized scientific bee boxes, gear, and guaranteed purchase of organic honey. Inquire at your District Horticulture/NBHM office.
answer_hi: नागालैंड हनी मिशन के तहत मधुमक्खी पालन के लिए 80% सब्सिडी पर वैज्ञानिक बॉक्स, प्रशिक्षण और शहद की पक्की खरीद गारंटी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Honey Mission me scientific bee boxes 80% subsidy par milte hain aur organic honey ki direct buyback guarantee hoti hai.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ తేనెటీగల పెంపకం మిషన్ 80% రాయితీతో పెట్టెలను మరియు సేంద్రీయ తేనె కొనుగోలుకు హామీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Bamboo Development Agency Support
benefit: Capital subsidy of up to ₹2 Lakh for bamboo processing units, supply of motorized splitting machines, and training in bamboo charcoal and furniture manufacturing.
eligibility: Indigenous youth, artisans, and bamboo growers residing in Nagaland.
documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Project proposal, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Nagaland Bamboo Development Agency provides up to ₹2 Lakh subsidy, machines, and skills to establish bamboo handicrafts and processing units. Inquire at NBDA Dimapur.
answer_hi: नागालैंड बांस विकास एजेंसी (NBDA) के माध्यम से बांस के उत्पाद, फर्नीचर और अगरबत्ती उद्योग लगाने के लिए ₹2 लाख तक की सब्सिडी और मशीनें मिलती हैं।
answer_hinglish: NBDA scheme me bamboo crafts, furniture aur charcoal factory lagane ke liye machinery aur ₹2 Lakh tak subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ వెదురు అభివృద్ధి సంస్థ వెదురు పరిశ్రమల ఏర్పాటుకు ₹2 లక్షల వరకు రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
benefit: Full reimbursement of non-refundable college fees plus monthly maintenance allowance of up to ₹1,200 per month for day scholars and ₹2,500 for hostellers.
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students of Nagaland enrolled in recognized post-matriculation diploma, degree, or postgraduate courses.
documents: ST Certificate, Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Marksheets, Fee receipt, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Nagaland Post-Matric ST Scholarship covers full tuition fees and pays monthly maintenance allowances for tribal college students. Apply online at scholarship.nagaland.gov.in.
answer_hi: नागालैंड पोस्ट-मैट्रिक एसटी छात्रवृत्ति के तहत जनजातीय छात्रों को कॉलेज की पूरी फीस वापसी और मासिक भरण-पोषण भत्ता मिलता है। scholarship.nagaland.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: ST students ko college fees refund aur monthly stipend ke liye scholarship.nagaland.gov.in portal par har academic year apply karna hota hai.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ పోస్ట్ మెట్రిక్ ఎస్టీ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ కళాశాల ఫీజు రీయింబర్స్‌మెంట్ మరియు నెలవారీ అలవెన్స్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Disability Pension Scheme
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month credited directly into bank accounts of persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Indigenous residents of Nagaland certified with 40% or more physical or mental disability belonging to low-income households.
documents: Disability Certificate / UDID card, Indigenous Certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Nagaland Disability Pension provides ₹1,000 monthly financial aid to persons with certified disability. Apply through your District Welfare Office.
answer_hi: नागालैंड दिव्यांगता पेंशन योजना के तहत 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Nagaland Disability Pension me 40%+ handicap citizens ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank account me milte hain Social Welfare office se.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ దివ్యాంగుల పెన్షన్ పథకం అర్హులైన వికలాంగులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 పెన్షన్ అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Corpus Fund (CMCF)
benefit: Direct margin money grant of up to ₹2 Lakh to cover borrower equity requirement for setting up transport vehicles, agro-processing, and tourism units.
eligibility: Unemployed indigenous Naga educated youth aged 18 to 35 possessing trade or vocational skills.
documents: Educational / Trade skill certificate, Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Project proposal, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Chief Minister’s Corpus Fund provides up to ₹2 Lakh margin money grant to help educated Naga youth qualify for bank enterprise loans. Apply via Planning & Coordination Department.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कॉर्पस फंड (CMCF) के तहत शिक्षित नागा युवाओं को व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए बैंक ऋण हेतु ₹2 लाख तक का मार्जिन मनी अनुदान दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: CMCF me educated youth ko apna transport ya retail business start karne ke liye ₹2 Lakh tak ka seed grant milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి కార్పస్ ఫండ్ యువతకు స్వయం ఉపాధి పరిశ్రమల స్థాపనకు ₹2 లక్షల వరకు గ్రాంట్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Organic Farming & Bio-Fertilizer Subsidy
benefit: Free bio-fertilizers, organic pest control inputs, 100% free organic certification for Naga King Chilli (Bhut Jolokia) and large cardamom, and export linkages.
eligibility: Farmers and farmer clusters in Nagaland practicing chemical-free farming on traditional ancestral lands.
documents: Land verification by Village Council, Farmer ID, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Nagaland Organic Mission provides free organic certification, inputs, and cold-chain marketing for traditional crops like Naga King Chilli. Inquire at your District Agriculture Office.
answer_hi: नागालैंड जैविक कृषि योजना के तहत नागा किंग मिर्च और इलायची की जैविक खेती के लिए मुफ्त खाद, कीट नियंत्रक और जैविक प्रमाणन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Organic Mission me Naga Chilli aur Cardamom ke farmers ko free bio-fertilizers aur official organic export certificate milta hai.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ సేంద్రీయ వ్యవసాయ పథకం నాగా మిరప మరియు ఏలకుల సాగు కోసం ఉచిత సేంద్రీయ ఎరువులు మరియు ధృవీకరణను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland State Old Age Pension
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month credited directly into bank accounts of senior citizens aged 60 and above.
eligibility: Indigenous senior citizens of Nagaland aged 60 years and above who are living below the poverty threshold.
documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Age certificate from Village Council/Voter ID, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Nagaland State Old Age Pension provides ₹1,000 monthly allowance to BPL senior citizens aged 60+. Apply through your local Village Council and District Welfare Office.
answer_hi: नागालैंड वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष या अधिक उम्र के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Nagaland Old Age Pension me 60+ age ke senior citizens ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank account me milte hain Village Council verification ke sath.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 60 ఏళ్లు దాటిన వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Handloom Cluster Scheme
benefit: Free modern frame looms, fly-shuttle attachments, subsidized acrylic/wool yarn, and exhibition selling stalls for traditional Naga shawl and fabric weavers.
eligibility: Indigenous female weavers and Self-Help Groups weaving traditional tribal shawls and textiles in Nagaland.
documents: Weaver registration card, Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Nagaland Handloom Cluster Scheme provides free improved looms and subsidized yarn to preserve and commercialize traditional Naga tribal weaving. Contact Department of Industries.
answer_hi: नागालैंड हथकरघा क्लस्टर योजना के तहत पारंपरिक नागा शॉल बुनने वाली महिलाओं को आधुनिक करघे, रियायती धागा और प्रदर्शनियों में मुफ्त स्टॉल दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Handloom Cluster scheme me traditional Naga shawls banane wali female weavers ko modern looms aur subsidized raw yarn milta hai.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ చేనేత క్లస్టర్ పథకం సంప్రదాయ నాగా శాలువాల నేత కార్మికులకు ఆధునిక మగ్గాలు మరియు రాయితీ నూలును అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Skill Development Mission (NSDM)
benefit: 100% free certified professional vocational training in aviation, hospitality, IT, automotive, and nursing with guaranteed placement linkages across metro cities.
eligibility: Indigenous youth of Nagaland aged 18 to 35 who have cleared Class 10 or 12.
documents: Class 10/12 Marksheet, Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: NSDM provides free industry-certified skill training in hospitality, healthcare, and IT with assured jobs outside the state for Naga youth. Apply at skill.nagaland.gov.in.
answer_hi: नागालैंड कौशल विकास मिशन (NSDM) के तहत युवाओं को होटल मैनेजमेंट, नर्सिंग और आईटी में मुफ्त आवासीय प्रशिक्षण और देश-विदेश में नौकरी के अवसर मिलते हैं।
answer_hinglish: NSDM me hospitality, IT aur nursing sectors me 100% free training milti hai national placement guarantee ke sath.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ నైపుణ్యాభివృద్ధి మిషన్ (NSDM) యువతకు ఉచిత వృత్తి శిక్షణ మరియు ఉపాధి అవకాశాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Nagaland Fishery Enterprise Scheme
benefit: Up to ₹1.5 Lakh capital grant for constructing fish ponds, integrated paddy-cum-fish culture in terraced hills, and free supply of quality fish fingerlings.
eligibility: Farmers owning suitable water retention terraces or ponds across hill districts of Nagaland.
documents: Land ownership document, Village Council NOC, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Nagaland Fishery Enterprise Scheme provides up to ₹1.5 Lakh grant and fingerlings for farmers practicing paddy-cum-fish culture on hill terraces. Apply at District Fisheries Office.
answer_hi: नागालैंड मत्स्य उद्यम योजना के तहत सीढ़ीदार खेतों में धान के साथ मछली पालन (Paddy-cum-fish) और नए तालाब बनाने हेतु ₹1.5 लाख तक की सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Fishery scheme me terrace kheti me fish pond banane ke liye ₹1.5 Lakh tak grant aur free fingerlings milti hain Fisheries department se.
answer_te: నాగార్లాండ్ మత్స్య పరిశ్రమల పథకం మెట్ల వ్యవసాయంలో వరితో పాటు చేపల పెంపకం కోసం ₹1.5 లక్షల వరకు గ్రాంట్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana (CMAAY)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year across top empanelled hospitals in Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, and metro cities.
eligibility: All APST (Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe) members, permanent resident certificate holders, and state government employees.
documents: APST Certificate / PRC, Aadhaar card, Ration card, CMAAY Health Card.
answer_en: CMAAY provides ₹5 Lakh cashless health cover per family per year across premier hospitals in the Northeast. Register or check status at cmaay.com.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री आरोग्य अरुणाचल योजना (CMAAY) के तहत अरुणाचल प्रदेश के सभी जनजातीय परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस अस्पताल इलाज मिलता है। cmaay.com पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: CMAAY me Arunachal ke indigenous APST families ko har saal ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless medical cover milta hai empanelled hospitals me.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఆరోగ్య అరుణాచల్ యోజన (CMAAY) కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత నగదు రహిత చికిత్సను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swavalamban Yojana (DDUSY)
benefit: 30% front-ended capital subsidy on bank loans ranging from ₹10 Lakh to ₹50 Lakh for setting up small enterprises in agriculture, tourism, and services.
eligibility: Unemployed APST youth aged 18 to 40 years possessing land and bank loan sanction.
documents: APST Certificate, Detailed project report, Land possession certificate, Bank loan sanction letter.
answer_en: DDUSY provides 30% front-ended capital subsidy on bank loans up to ₹50 Lakh for youth launching ventures in tourism, farming, and manufacturing. Apply at ddusy.arunachal.gov.in.
answer_hi: दीनदयाल उपाध्याय स्वावलंबन योजना (DDUSY) के तहत पर्यटन, कृषि और विनिर्माण में नया उद्यम लगाने के लिए ₹50 लाख तक के ऋण पर 30% सीधी सब्सिडी मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: DDUSY me tourism, resort, agriculture ya food processing business ke liye bank loan par 30% direct capital subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: దీన్ దయాళ్ ఉపాధ్యాయ స్వావలంబన్ యోజన కొత్త పరిశ్రమల స్థాపనకు ₹50 లక్షల వరకు బ్యాంకు రుణాలపై 30% రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Dulari Kanya Scheme
benefit: Fixed deposit of ₹20,000 opened in the name of the female newborn in a government bank upon institutional delivery, maturing when she turns 18 and passes Class 10.
eligibility: Girl children born to APST mothers in government or recognized health centers in Arunachal Pradesh.
documents: Institutional birth certificate, Mother's APST certificate, Mother's MCP card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Dulari Kanya Scheme deposits ₹20,000 in a fixed deposit for newborn APST girl children to promote institutional delivery and female literacy. Apply via your delivering hospital.
answer_hi: दुलारी कन्या योजना के तहत सरकारी अस्पताल में बेटी के जन्म पर ₹20,000 की सावधि जमा (FD) की जाती है, जो 18 वर्ष और 10वीं पास करने पर ब्याज सहित मिलती है।
