answer_hinglish: Dulari Kanya me hospital me girl child birth par govt ₹20,000 ki FD banati hai jo 18 years ki hone par mature hoti hai.
answer_te: దులారీ కన్యా పథకం ఆడపిల్ల పుట్టినప్పుడు బ్యాంకులో ₹20,000 ఫిక్స్‌డ్ డిపాజిట్ చేస్తుంది.

name: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana (ANKY)
keywords: arunachal tractor farm machinery 45 percent subsidy
benefit: Comprehensive 45% government subsidy + 45% bank credit + 10% farmer contribution for farm machinery (power tillers, tractors, threshers) and seeds.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) residing in Arunachal Pradesh.
documents: Land possession certificate (LPC), APST certificate, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana provides 45% government subsidy on tractors, tillers, and modern implements to eliminate manual hill farming. Apply online at anky.arunachal.gov.in.
answer_hi: आत्मनिर्भर कृषि योजना (ANKY) के तहत पावर टिलर, ट्रैक्टर और कृषि उपकरणों की खरीद पर 45% सरकारी सब्सिडी और 45% बैंक लोन मिलता है। anky.arunachal.gov.in पर देखें।
answer_hinglish: ANKY scheme me tractor aur modern farming machinery lene par 45% direct govt subsidy milti hai sirf 10% farmer share par.
answer_te: ఆత్మనిర్భర్ కృషి యోజన వ్యవసాయ యంత్రాలు మరియు ట్రాక్టర్ల కొనుగోలుపై 45% ప్రభుత్వ రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana (ANBY)
benefit: 45% government subsidy + 45% bank loan + 10% beneficiary share for setting up high-density apple, kiwi, walnut, and orange orchards with micro-irrigation.
eligibility: Farmers and farming clusters in Arunachal Pradesh possessing suitable temperate or subtropical land.
documents: Land possession certificate, Soil suitability certificate, APST certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: ANBY provides 45% capital subsidy to establish high-density apple, kiwi, and walnut orchards in temperate regions of Arunachal. Apply at anby.arunachal.gov.in.
answer_hi: आत्मनिर्भर बागवानी योजना (ANBY) के तहत सेब, कीवी और संतरा बागान लगाने के लिए 45% सरकारी सब्सिडी और 45% बैंक ऋण मिलता है। anby.arunachal.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: ANBY me high-density apple aur kiwi farming ke liye 45% direct grant milti hai state government se horticulture boom ke liye.
answer_te: ఆత్మనిర్భర్ బాగ్వానీ యోజన ఆపిల్ మరియు కివీ తోటల పెంపకానికి 45% ప్రభుత్వ రాయితీని అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana (ANMPY)
keywords: arunachal trout carp fish pond subsidy
benefit: 45% capital grant on construction of trout raceways in hill regions and carp ponds in foothills, fish feed, and fingerling inputs.
eligibility: Individual fish farmers, youth entrepreneurs, and cooperatives registered in Arunachal Pradesh.
documents: Land document, Water source testing report, APST certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: ANMPY offers 45% capital subsidy for establishing cold-water trout raceways and warm-water carp ponds across Arunachal Pradesh. Inquire at your District Fisheries Office.
answer_hi: आत्मनिर्भर मत्स्य पालन योजना (ANMPY) के तहत ठंडे पानी में ट्राउट और तलहटी में कार्प मछली तालाब बनाने के लिए 45% अनुदान मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: ANMPY scheme me commercial fish farming aur cold-water trout setup lagane ke liye 45% state subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: ఆత్మనిర్భర్ మత్స్య పాలన్ యోజన చేపల చెరువుల నిర్మాణానికి 45% మూలధన రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Arunachal Pradesh Post-Matric ST Stipend
benefit: Direct monthly stipend of ₹1,400 to ₹2,000 per month (plus annual book grant of up to ₹5,000) for APST students pursuing college and university courses.
eligibility: Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) bonafide students studying in recognized colleges, polytechnics, and universities.
documents: APST Certificate, Previous year marksheet, College admission receipt, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Arunachal Pradesh ST Stipend provides ₹1,400 to ₹2,000 monthly living support plus book grants for tribal college students. Apply online via the state stipend portal.
answer_hi: अरुणाचल प्रदेश एसटी स्टाइपेंड योजना के तहत कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ने वाले जनजातीय छात्रों को ₹1,400 से ₹2,000 प्रति माह और पुस्तक अनुदान मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: APST college students ko higher studies ke doran monthly ₹1,400 se ₹2,000 stipend aur book allowance direct bank me milta hai.
answer_te: అరుణాచల్ ప్రదేశ్ ఎస్టీ స్టైపెండ్ కళాశాల విద్యార్థులకు నెలకు ₹1,400 నుండి ₹2,000 వరకు స్టైపెండ్ మరియు పుస్తక గ్రాంట్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister Social Security Scheme (CMSSS)
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,500 per month credited directly into bank accounts of senior citizens (aged 60+), widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Arunachal Pradesh aged 60+ (or destitute widows / certified disabled citizens) not drawing any government pension.
documents: APST/PRC certificate, Age proof/Disability certificate, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: CMSSS provides ₹1,500 monthly social security pension to elderly citizens, widows, and disabled persons in Arunachal Pradesh. Apply through your District Social Welfare Officer.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजना (CMSSS) के तहत वरिष्ठ नागरिकों, निराश्रित विधवाओं और दिव्यांगों को ₹1,500 प्रति माह की पेंशन सीधे खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: CMSSS scheme me 60+ age ke seniors, widows aur disabled persons ko har mahine ₹1,500 direct bank pension milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి సామాజిక భద్రతా పథకం (CMSSS) వృద్ధులు మరియు వితంతువులకు నెలకు ₹1,500 పెన్షన్ అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Shramik Kalyan Yojana
benefit: Maternity assistance increased to ₹50,000 for female workers, natural death compensation of ₹2 Lakh, accidental death cover of ₹4 Lakh, and funeral grant of ₹20,000.
eligibility: Registered building and other construction workers (BOCW) in Arunachal Pradesh having an active registration card.
documents: BOCW registration smart card, Aadhaar card, Hospital delivery slip / Death certificate (as applicable), Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhya Mantri Shramik Kalyan Yojana offers ₹50,000 maternity benefits and up to ₹4 Lakh death compensation for registered construction workers in Arunachal Pradesh.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री श्रमिक कल्याण योजना के तहत पंजीकृत मजदूरों को ₹50,000 की प्रसूति सहायता और कार्यस्थल पर दुर्घटना मृत्यु पर ₹4 लाख का मुआवजा मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: BOCW registered workers ko Arunachal me ₹50,000 maternity help aur ₹4 Lakh accident insurance milta hai labour department se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి శ్రామిక్ కళ్యాణ్ యోజన రిజిస్టర్డ్ కార్మికులకు ₹50,000 ప్రసూతి సహాయం మరియు ₹4 లక్షల వరకు ప్రమాద బీమాను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Arunachal Pradesh Tourism Homestay Scheme
benefit: Capital grant of up to ₹5 Lakh (50% project cost) to build, renovate, and furnish authentic traditional tribal tourist homestays with eco-friendly amenities.
eligibility: Indigenous inhabitants of Arunachal Pradesh owning suitable house property in designated tourist destinations (Tawang, Ziro, Mechuka, Pasighat).
documents: Land possession certificate, Homestay layout plan, APST certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Arunachal Homestay Scheme provides up to ₹5 Lakh capital grant for setting up eco-friendly tourist homestays in scenic valleys. Apply via the Department of Tourism.
answer_hi: अरुणाचल प्रदेश होमस्टे योजना के तहत पर्यटकों के ठहरने हेतु पारंपरिक होमस्टे बनाने या नवीनीकरण के लिए ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी अनुदान मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Tourism Homestay scheme me tourist spots (Tawang, Ziro) par homestay shuru karne ke liye ₹5 Lakh tak ka direct capital grant milta hai.
answer_te: అరుణాచల్ ప్రదేశ్ పర్యాటక హోమ్‌స్టే పథకం పర్యాటక హోమ్‌స్టేల ఏర్పాటుకు ₹5 లక్షల వరకు గ్రాంట్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Atma Nirbhar Pashu Palan Yojana (ANPPY)
benefit: 45% government subsidy on dairy cattle, piggery, goat, broiler poultry farming, and specialized yak husbandry in alpine regions.
eligibility: Livestock rearers, SHGs, and APST youths residing across Arunachal Pradesh.
documents: Land possession certificate, Animal shed plan, APST certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: ANPPY provides 45% government capital subsidy on setting up commercial dairy, piggery, and yak farming units. Inquire at your District Animal Husbandry Office.
answer_hi: आत्मनिर्भर पशुपालन योजना (ANPPY) के तहत डेयरी, सुअर पालन और याक पालन इकाइयां लगाने के लिए 45% सरकारी अनुदान मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: ANPPY me dairy cows, piggery aur alpine yak farming ke liye 45% direct capital subsidy milti hai state government se.
answer_te: ఆత్మనిర్భర్ పశు పాలన్ యోజన పాడి పరిశ్రమ, పందులు మరియు యాక్ పెంపకానికి 45% ప్రభుత్వ రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Arunachal Yuva Samanway Scheme
benefit: Fully sponsored national exchange tours, mountaineering/adventure sports certifications (NIMAS Dirang), and leadership training for local youth.
eligibility: Youth aged 15 to 29 years residing in Arunachal Pradesh who are active in community service or sports.
documents: APST/PRC certificate, Age proof, Educational certificate, Medical fitness certificate.
answer_en: Arunachal Yuva Samanway sponsors youth for national exposure visits, mountaineering courses at NIMAS, and community leadership bootcamps. Contact the Directorate of Youth Affairs.
answer_hi: अरुणाचल युवा समन्वय योजना के तहत राज्य के युवाओं को राष्ट्रीय भ्रमण, NIMAS से पर्वतारोहण प्रशिक्षण और नेतृत्व विकास हेतु 100% प्रायोजित अवसर दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Yuva Samanway me adventure sports, mountaineering aur national exposure visits ke liye poora kharcha state govt uthati hai.
answer_te: అరుణాచల్ యువ సమన్వయ పథకం పర్వతారోహణ మరియు సాహస క్రీడల శిక్షణ కోసం యువతకు 100% ఉచిత అవకాశాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Bana Kawng (Handholding) Scheme
benefit: Comprehensive multi-sectoral handholding providing collateral-free soft loans, progress-linked milestone grants, technical coaching, and guaranteed minimum support pricing.
eligibility: Farmers, food processors, artisans, and youth entrepreneurs who are permanent residents of Mizoram.
documents: Voter ID, Aadhaar card, Project/Farming activity plan, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Bana Kawng (Handholding) is Mizoram's flagship economic policy offering soft loans, market support, and production subsidies to uplift farmers and entrepreneurs. Inquire at your District Planning Office.
answer_hi: बाना कौंग (हैंडहोल्डिंग) योजना मिजोरम सरकार की प्रमुख आर्थिक योजना है, जिसके तहत किसानों व उद्यमियों को आसान ऋण, न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य और प्रशिक्षण मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Bana Kawng scheme me farmers aur local entrepreneurs ko soft loans, minimum support price aur direct handholding support milti hai.
answer_te: బానా కౌంగ్ (హ్యాండ్‌హోల్డింగ్) పథకం రైతులు మరియు వ్యవస్థాపకులకు సులభ రుణాలు, మద్దతు ధర మరియు మార్కెట్ సహాయాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram State Health Care Scheme (MSHCS)
benefit: Cashless hospitalization cover up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and critical tertiary treatments at empanelled hospitals within and outside Mizoram.
eligibility: All permanent resident families of Mizoram not covered under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS).
documents: Voter ID, Aadhaar card, Ration card, MSHCS Health Card.
answer_en: MSHCS provides up to ₹5 Lakh cashless health cover per family per year across top hospitals in Aizawl, Shillong, Guwahati, and Kolkata. Enroll at mshcs.mizoram.gov.in.
answer_hi: मिजोरम स्टेट हेल्थ केयर स्कीम (MSHCS) के तहत राज्य के परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस अस्पताल इलाज मिलता है। mshcs.mizoram.gov.in पर नामांकन करें।
answer_hinglish: MSHCS me Mizoram ke residents ko ₹5 Lakh tak ka cashless medical insurance milta hai top state aur regional hospitals me.
answer_te: మిజోరాం స్టేట్ హెల్త్ కేర్ స్కీమ్ (MSHCS) కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి ₹5 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత ఆరోగ్య బీమాను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Socio-Economic Development Policy (SEDP)
benefit: Direct financial grants and livelihood assistance of ₹50,000 for rural and urban poor families across identified high-priority livelihood trades.
eligibility: Needy and low-income families residing in Mizoram endorsed by Local Councils or Village Councils.
documents: Village Council / Local Council recommendation, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: SEDP provides direct livelihood capital assistance of ₹50,000 to empower families in agriculture, piggery, weaving, and petty trade across Mizoram. Apply via your Village Council.
answer_hi: सामाजिक-आर्थिक विकास नीति (SEDP) के तहत गरीब परिवारों को अपनी आजीविका (खेती, सुअर पालन, बुनाई) शुरू करने हेतु ₹50,000 की सीधी वित्तीय मदद दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: SEDP me eligible families ko business ya farming expand karne ke liye ₹50,000 direct grant milti hai Village Council ke through.
answer_te: సామాజిక-ఆర్థిక అభివృద్ధి విధానం (SEDP) పేద కుటుంబాలకు వ్యవసాయం మరియు చిన్న వ్యాపారాల కోసం ₹50,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Rural Housing (CGI Roofing) Scheme
benefit: Free allocation of heavy-gauge Corrugated Galvanized Iron (CGI) roofing sheets (up to 3 bundles) and construction cash subsidy for kutcha homeowners.
eligibility: Economically weak rural families in Mizoram possessing an unroofed or leaking thatched house.
documents: Village Council certificate, Ration card, Land pass, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mizoram Rural Housing Scheme provides free bundles of CGI roofing sheets to protect rural homes from heavy monsoon downpours. Inquire at your Block Development Office.
answer_hi: मिजोरम ग्रामीण आवास योजना के तहत भारी मानसूनी वर्षा से बचाव हेतु कच्चे व टपकने वाले घरों के लिए लोहे की नालीदार चद्दरें (CGI शीट्स) मुफ्त दी जाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Rural Housing me kachhe makaano ke liye tin ki chaadarein (CGI sheets) bilkul free provide ki jaati hain BDO office ke zariye.
answer_te: మిజోరాం గ్రామీణ గృహ నిర్మాణ పథకం కింద పేద కుటుంబాలకు ఉచిత CGI రూఫింగ్ షీట్లను అందజేస్తారు.

name: Mizoram Handloom Weaver Assistance
benefit: 20% yarn price subsidy, distribution of modern fly-shuttle frame looms, and exhibition sale stalls through ZOHANDCO for weaving traditional Mizo Puan.
eligibility: Traditional female loin-loom and frame-loom weavers residing across Mizoram.
documents: Weaver identity card, Voter card, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mizoram Handloom Assistance provides yarn subsidies, modern looms, and market linkages through ZOHANDCO to preserve traditional Mizo Puan weaving. Contact District Commerce Office.
answer_hi: पारंपरिक मिज़ो पुआन बुनने वाली महिला बुनकरों को 20% धागा सब्सिडी, आधुनिक करघे और जोहैंडको (ZOHANDCO) के माध्यम से बाजार सुविधा दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Mizo Puan weavers ko 20% subsidized yarn aur modern frame looms provide kiye jaate hain income increase karne ke liye.
answer_te: మిజోరాం చేనేత సహాయక పథకం సాంప్రదాయ మిజో పువాన్ నేత కార్మికులకు నూలు రాయితీ మరియు ఆధునిక మగ్గాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Bamboo Development Policy
benefit: Subsidies for commercial bamboo plantation, support for bamboo shoot canned processing, and mechanized agarbatti stick-making units.
eligibility: Bamboo growers, rural self-help groups, and micro-processors residing in Mizoram.
documents: Land holding pass, Village Council certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mizoram Bamboo Development Policy provides plantation subsidies and processing machinery to monetize state bamboo resources. Contact the Environment & Forests Department.
answer_hi: मिजोरम बांस विकास नीति के तहत बांस के बागान लगाने, बांस के सिरके और अगरबत्ती की तीलियां बनाने के लिए सरकारी सब्सिडी और मशीनरी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bamboo Policy me commercial bamboo cultivation aur bamboo shoot processing plant lagane ke liye financial subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: మిజోరాం వెదురు అభివృద్ధి విధానం వాణిజ్య వెదురు తోటల పెంపకానికి మరియు ప్రాసెసింగ్ యూనిట్లకు రాయితీలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Old Age Pension Scheme
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into bank accounts of senior citizens aged 65 and above.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 65 years and above who are permanent residents of Mizoram living below the poverty line.
documents: Voter ID / Age certificate, Village Council recommendation, BPL certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mizoram Old Age Pension provides ₹1,000 monthly allowance to senior citizens aged 65+. Apply through your local Village Council and District Social Welfare Office.
answer_hi: मिजोरम वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 65 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के बीपीएल बुजुर्गों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Mizoram Old Age Pension me 65+ age ke seniors ko har mahine ₹1,000 direct bank account me milte hain Social Welfare department se.
answer_te: మిజోరాం వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 65 ఏళ్లు దాటిన వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹1,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Differently Abled Welfare Scheme
benefit: Direct monthly maintenance grant of ₹1,200 per month, free assistive mobility devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids), and free vocational training.
eligibility: Persons residing in Mizoram certified with 40% or more physical or mental disability belonging to low-income families.
documents: Disability Certificate / UDID card, Voter ID, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mizoram Differently Abled Welfare Scheme grants ₹1,200 monthly allowance and free assistive devices to persons with disabilities. Apply at District Social Welfare Office.
answer_hi: मिजोरम दिव्यांगजन कल्याण योजना के तहत 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को ₹1,200 प्रति माह भरण-पोषण अनुदान और मुफ्त सहायक उपकरण मिलते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Differently Abled scheme me disabled citizens ko har mahine ₹1,200 financial aid aur free wheelchairs/hearing aids milti hain.
answer_te: మిజోరాం వికలాంగుల సంక్షేమ పథకం నెలకు ₹1,200 భత్యం మరియు ఉచిత సహాయక పరికరాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Oil Palm Cultivation Assistance
benefit: Free high-yielding oil palm seedlings, 90% subsidy on drip irrigation, intercropping maintenance subsidy of ₹5,000/ha for 4 years, and assured mill purchase.
eligibility: Farmers possessing suitable plain or rolling agricultural land with water availability in Mizoram.
documents: Land pass / Village Council NOC, Farmer registration, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mizoram Oil Palm Scheme provides free saplings, drip irrigation subsidies, and 4-year maintenance stipends with assured processing buyback. Contact District Agriculture Office.
answer_hi: ऑयल पाम की खेती के लिए किसानों को मुफ्त पौधे, ड्रिप सिंचाई पर 90% सब्सिडी और 4 साल तक रखरखाव अनुदान दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Oil Palm cultivation me free seedlings, 90% drip irrigation subsidy aur private processing mills dwara assured purchase milti hai.
answer_te: మిజోరాం ఆయిల్ పామ్ సాగు సహాయ పథకం ఉచిత మొక్కలు, బిందు సేద్యంపై 90% రాయితీ మరియు హామీ కొనుగోలును అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
benefit: Full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable university/college fees plus monthly maintenance stipends up to ₹1,200 (day scholars) and ₹2,600 (hostellers).
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students of Mizoram enrolled in recognized post-matric courses with annual family income below ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: ST Certificate, Previous year marksheets, Fee receipt, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mizoram Post-Matric ST Scholarship covers full tuition fees and pays maintenance stipends for tribal students in higher education. Apply at scholarships.mizoram.gov.in.
answer_hi: मिजोरम पोस्ट-मैट्रिक एसटी छात्रवृत्ति के तहत जनजातीय कॉलेज विद्यार्थियों को पूरी ट्यूशन फीस वापसी और मासिक छात्रावास भत्ता मिलता है। scholarships.mizoram.gov.in पर आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Tribal students ko college fees refund aur monthly hostel allowance ke liye scholarships.mizoram.gov.in par register karna hota hai.
answer_te: మిజోరాం పోస్ట్ మెట్రిక్ ఎస్టీ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ కళాశాల విద్యార్థులకు పూర్తి ఫీజు రీయింబర్స్‌మెంట్ మరియు నెలవారీ అలవెన్స్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Entrepreneurship Award Scheme
benefit: Direct cash grant awards of up to ₹5 Lakh, free professional business incubation, and collateral-free bank linkages for top promising Mizo startups.
eligibility: Mizo youth and micro-entrepreneurs running an innovative enterprise in Mizoram.
documents: Business pitch deck, Proof of incorporation/registration, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Chief Minister’s Entrepreneurship Award grants cash prizes up to ₹5 Lakh and incubation to scale up high-potential startups in Mizoram. Inquire at Planning & Programme Implementation.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री उद्यमिता पुरस्कार योजना के तहत सफल और नवोन्मेषी मिज़ो स्टार्टअप्स को ₹5 लाख तक का नकद पुरस्कार और इनक्यूबेशन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: CM Entrepreneurship scheme me top startups ko business grow karne ke liye ₹5 Lakh tak ka cash prize aur incubation milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి వ్యవస్థాపకత అవార్డు పథకం అద్భుతమైన స్టార్టప్‌లకు ₹5 లక్షల వరకు నగదు బహుమతులు మరియు ఇంక్యుబేషన్‌ను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mizoram Piggery Development Scheme
benefit: Free supply of high-yielding Yorkshire/Landrace breeding piglets, subsidized concentrated livestock feed bags, and free African Swine Fever vaccinations.
eligibility: Rural households and smallholder livestock rearers across villages in Mizoram.
documents: Village Council recommendation, Pigsty photo/inspection, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card.
answer_en: Mizoram Piggery Development Scheme provides free superior piglets, feed supplements, and free veterinary care to rural households. Apply at District AH & Vety Office.
answer_hi: मिजोरम सुअर पालन विकास योजना के तहत ग्रामीण परिवारों को उन्नत नस्ल के सुअर के बच्चे (पिगलेट), पौष्टिक चारा और मुफ्त टीकाकरण दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Piggery Development me superior breed piglets aur subsidized feed bags milte hain rural families ko income augment karne ke liye.
answer_te: మిజోరాం పిగ్గరీ అభివృద్ధి పథకం గ్రామీణ రైతులకు ఉచిత పందిపిల్లలు మరియు దాణా సరఫరాను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Aama Yojana (Sikkim)
benefit: Direct annual financial grant of ₹40,000 deposited in two installments of ₹20,000 directly into the bank accounts of non-working rural mothers.
eligibility: Unemployed/non-working mothers aged 18 and above who are bonafide residents of Sikkim (holding Sikkim Subject Certificate or Certificate of Identification).
documents: Sikkim Subject Certificate / COI, Voter ID, Bank passbook in mother's name, Unemployed self-declaration.
answer_en: Under Sikkim Aama Yojana, non-working mothers receive ₹40,000 every year directly in their bank accounts in two installments. Apply through your Gram Panchayat Unit (GPU).
answer_hi: आमा योजना के तहत सिक्किम की गैर-कामकाजी माताओं को प्रतिवर्ष ₹40,000 की वित्तीय सहायता (दो किस्तों में) सीधे उनके बैंक खाते में मिलती है। ग्राम पंचायत से आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: Aama Yojana me Sikkim ki non-working mothers ko har saal ₹40,000 direct bank account me milte hain. Gram Panchayat Unit se form bharein.
answer_te: ఆమా యోజన కింద సిక్కింలోని ఉద్యోగం చేయని తల్లులకు సంవత్సరానికి ₹40,000 నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.

name: Vatsalya Scheme (Sikkim IVF Assistance)
benefit: Financial grant of up to ₹3 Lakh in two installments to childless couples undergoing In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) treatment to tackle fertility challenges.
eligibility: Childless couples who are bonafide Certificate of Identification (COI) holders of Sikkim.
documents: Certificate of Identification (COI), Marriage certificate, Doctor's IVF treatment recommendation, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Sikkim Vatsalya Scheme provides up to ₹3 Lakh financial assistance for childless couples undergoing IVF medical procedures. Apply through the Health & Family Welfare Department.
answer_hi: वात्सल्य योजना के तहत निःसंतान दंपतियों को आईवीएफ (IVF) इलाज के लिए ₹3 लाख तक की आर्थिक मदद दी जाती है। स्वास्थ्य विभाग से संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Vatsalya Scheme me childless couples ko IVF treatment karwane ke liye Sikkim govt ₹3 Lakh tak ki financial support deti hai.
answer_te: వాత్సల్య పథకం ద్వారా పిల్లలు లేని దంపతులకు ఐవిఎఫ్ (IVF) చికిత్స కోసం ₹3 లక్షల వరకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం లభిస్తుంది.

name: Sikkim Garib Awas Yojana (SGAY)
benefit: 100% government-funded single-storey pucca RCC house (worth ₹17 Lakh) featuring living room, two bedrooms, kitchen, toilet, and modern furnished fittings for poor families.
eligibility: Poor homeless or kutcha dwelling families possessing Certificate of Identification (COI) in Sikkim.
documents: Sikkim Subject / COI, Land record, BPL certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Sikkim Garib Awas Yojana constructs completely free furnished pucca RCC homes (worth ₹17 Lakh) for poor homeless families. Apply via your Block Development Officer (BDO).
answer_hi: सिक्किम गरीब आवास योजना (SGAY) के तहत गरीब परिवारों को पूरी तरह से सुसज्जित ₹17 लाख का पक्का मकान बनाकर सरकार मुफ्त में देती है। बीडीओ कार्यालय में आवेदन करें।
answer_hinglish: SGAY me Sikkim ke garib parivaron ko 100% free furnished pucca makaan (living room, 2 bedrooms, kitchen) govt banakar deti hai.
answer_te: సిక్కిం గరీబ్ ఆవాస్ యోజన పేద కుటుంబాలకు ₹17 లక్షల విలువైన పూర్తి ఫర్నీచర్‌తో కూడిన పక్కా గృహాన్ని ఉచితంగా నిర్మించి ఇస్తుంది.

name: Skilled Youth Startup Scheme (SYSS)
benefit: 50% government subsidy on bank loans for manufacturing/agriculture projects and 35% subsidy on service sector ventures up to ₹20 Lakh.
eligibility: Unemployed local youth possessing Sikkim Subject / COI aged 18 to 40 years with professional or vocational qualification.
documents: Certificate of Identification (COI), Detailed project report, Educational/Skill marksheet, Bank loan sanction.
answer_en: SYSS provides up to 50% subsidy on bank loans up to ₹20 Lakh to help skilled Sikkim youth start manufacturing and service enterprises. Apply at Commerce & Industries Department.
answer_hi: कुशल युवा स्टार्टअप योजना (SYSS) के तहत युवाओं को नया उद्योग लगाने के लिए ₹20 लाख तक के ऋण पर 50% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: SYSS me skilled Sikkimese youth ko apna manufacturing ya service business shuru karne ke liye 50% capital subsidy milti hai bank loan par.
answer_te: స్కిల్డ్ యూత్ స్టార్టప్ పథకం (SYSS) నైపుణ్యం కలిగిన యువతకు కొత్త వ్యాపారాల ఏర్పాటుకు 50% వరకు సబ్సిడీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Medical Assistance Scheme (CMMAS)
benefit: Direct financial medical aid of up to ₹5 Lakh for patients needing critical surgeries, organ transplants, or oncology treatments referred to super-specialty hospitals outside Sikkim.
eligibility: Bonafide Sikkim Subject / COI holders requiring specialized medical care unavailable at STNM Hospital Gangtok.
documents: COI / Sikkim Subject, STNM referral board certificate, Hospital admission estimate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: CMMAS provides up to ₹5 Lakh financial grant for critical treatments (cardiac, cancer, neuro) referred to hospitals outside Sikkim. Apply at Chief Minister's Office Gangtok.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री चिकित्सा सहायता योजना (CMMAS) के तहत राज्य के बाहर गंभीर बीमारी (कैंसर, हृदय रोग, प्रत्यारोपण) के इलाज हेतु ₹5 लाख तक की सीधी सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: CMMAS me Sikkim ke bahar super-specialty treatment ke liye referred patients ko ₹5 Lakh tak ka medical grant milta hai CMO office se.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి వైద్య సహాయక పథకం సిక్కిం వెలుపల తీవ్రమైన వ్యాధుల చికిత్స పొందే రోగులకు ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Atmanirbhar Yojana
benefit: Direct price incentives credited into farmers' bank accounts on production of commercial organic crops: large cardamom, ginger, turmeric, buck-wheat, and dal.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating certified organic crops in Sikkim registered with their local Agriculture Development Center.
documents: Sikkim Subject / COI, Organic farmer registration, Production certificate, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Atmanirbhar Yojana rewards farmers with direct production cash incentives for harvesting organic large cardamom, ginger, and turmeric. Inquire at your local ADC.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री कृषि आत्मनिर्भर योजना के तहत बड़ी इलायची, अदरक और हल्दी की जैविक पैदावार पर किसानों को सीधे बैंक खाते में नकद उत्पादन प्रोत्साहन दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Krishi Atmanirbhar Yojana me organic cardamom, ginger aur turmeric harvest karne par farmers ko per-kg direct cash bonus milta hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి కృషి ఆత్మనిర్భర్ యోజన సేంద్రీయ ఏలకులు, అల్లం మరియు పసుపు పండించే రైతులకు ప్రత్యక్ష నగదు ప్రోత్సాహకాలను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Shrawan Kumar Award & Pension Scheme
benefit: Prestigious state cash awards (₹1 Lakh, ₹75,000, ₹50,000) and citations for sons and daughters who demonstrate exemplary selfless care and devotion to their elderly parents.
eligibility: Bonafide citizens of Sikkim caring for their aged and infirm parents.
documents: Sikkim Subject / COI, Recommendation from Ward Panchayat, Proof of co-living and care.
answer_en: Shrawan Kumar Scheme awards cash prizes up to ₹1 Lakh to sons and daughters who take exemplary care of their elderly parents, promoting family values. Nominate via Social Welfare Dept.
answer_hi: श्रवण कुमार पुरस्कार योजना के तहत अपने वृद्ध माता-पिता की उत्कृष्ट सेवा व देखभाल करने वाले पुत्र-पुत्रियों को ₹1 लाख तक का नकद पुरस्कार और सम्मान दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Shrawan Kumar Award me apne buzurg parents ki selfless care karne wale dedicated beta/beti ko state govt ₹1 Lakh tak ka cash prize deti hai.
answer_te: శ్రవణ్ కుమార్ అవార్డు పథకం వృద్ధ తల్లిదండ్రులను ఆదర్శప్రాయంగా చూసుకునే పిల్లలకు ₹1 లక్ష వరకు నగదు బహుమతులను అందజేస్తుంది.

name: Sikkim Bahini Scheme
benefit: Installation of automated sanitary napkin vending machines and 100% free distribution of sanitary pads to all secondary and senior secondary schoolgirls across Sikkim.
eligibility: All adolescent female students studying in Class 9 through 12 across all government schools in Sikkim.
documents: School enrollment record.
answer_en: Bahini Scheme installs vending machines in every government secondary school in Sikkim, ensuring 100% free access to sanitary napkins for all teenage schoolgirls.
answer_hi: बहिनी योजना के तहत सिक्किम के सभी सरकारी माध्यमिक और उच्चतर माध्यमिक स्कूलों में सेनेटरी नैपकिन वेंडिंग मशीनें लगाकर छात्राओं को मुफ्त पैड दिए जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bahini Scheme me sabhi govt schools me vending machines lagakar 9th se 12th class ki girls ko free sanitary pads milte hain.
answer_te: బహిని పథకం సిక్కింలోని అన్ని ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలల్లో విద్యార్థినులకు ఉచిత శానిటరీ న్యాప్‌కిన్లను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Sikkim 100% Organic Farming Support
benefit: Free bio-fertilizers, neem cake, bio-pesticides, on-farm compost pit grants of ₹10,000, and free international organic certification as India's first 100% organic state.
eligibility: All agricultural landowners and organic farmers cultivating land in Sikkim.
documents: Sikkim Subject / COI, Land record (Parcha), Organic grower card.
answer_en: Sikkim 100% Organic Farming Support provides free bio-inputs, composting grants, and free organic certification for all agricultural produce. Inquire at your local Agriculture Office.
answer_hi: सिक्किम शत-प्रतिशत जैविक राज्य में किसानों को रासायनिक खाद मुक्त खेती के लिए मुफ्त जैविक खाद, नीम केक और ₹10,000 का वर्मीकम्पोस्ट अनुदान मिलता है।
answer_hinglish: Organic Farming Support me 100% chemical-free kheti ke liye bio-pesticides, organic manure aur compost pit grant milti hai.
answer_te: సిక్కిం సేంద్రీయ వ్యవసాయ మద్దతు పథకం ఉచిత సేంద్రీయ ఎరువులు మరియు ధృవీకరణను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Mukhya Mantri Matsya Utpadan Yojana
benefit: 60% government capital subsidy on construction of high-altitude Himalayan rainbow trout raceways, fish feed, and oxygen aeration equipment.
eligibility: Farmers and youth residing in alpine and sub-alpine belts of Sikkim with access to fresh running spring streams.
documents: COI / Sikkim Subject, Land document, Stream water rights NOC, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Mukhya Mantri Matsya Utpadan Yojana offers 60% subsidy to construct commercial rainbow trout fish raceways in cold mountain streams. Apply via the Directorate of Fisheries.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मत्स्य उत्पादन योजना के तहत ठंडे पहाड़ी पानी में रेनबो ट्राउट मछली पालन के लिए 60% सरकारी सब्सिडी और तकनीकी सहायता दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Matsya Utpadan me cold mountain water me high-value rainbow trout fish farm banane ke liye 60% subsidy milti hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మత్స్య ఉత్పాదన యోజన పర్వత ప్రాంతాల్లో రెయిన్‌బో ట్రౌట్ చేపల పెంపకానికి 60% రాయితీని అందిస్తుంది.

name: Chief Minister’s Merit Scholarship Scheme
benefit: 100% fully funded education from Class 6 to Class 12 in premier public residential and boarding schools across India (including Scindia, Tashi Namgyal, Mayo, etc.).
eligibility: Meritorious Class 5 students studying in Sikkim government schools who clear the state competitive entrance examination.
documents: Class 5 marksheet, Sikkim Subject / COI, State merit entrance result card.
answer_en: Chief Minister’s Merit Scholarship fully finances education from Class 6 through 12 in India's top boarding schools for brightest Class 5 rural students. Inquire at your school.
answer_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मेधा छात्रवृत्ति योजना के तहत 5वीं कक्षा के मेधावी ग्रामीण छात्रों को देश के प्रतिष्ठित बोर्डिंग स्कूलों (कक्षा 6 से 12वीं तक) में 100% मुफ्त शिक्षा दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Merit Scholarship me competitive test clear karne par India ke top boarding schools me Class 6 se 12 tak ka 100% kharcha Sikkim govt uthati hai.
answer_te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి మెరిట్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పథకం 5వ తరగతి మెరిట్ విద్యార్థులకు దేశంలోని ప్రముఖ బోర్డింగ్ పాఠశాలల్లో 100% ఉచిత విద్యను అందిస్తుంది.

name: Sikkim Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS / State Pension)
benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹2,000 per month credited directly into bank accounts of senior citizens aged 60 and above.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 and above who are bonafide Sikkim Subject / COI holders belonging to BPL households.
documents: Sikkim Subject / COI, Age proof / Voter ID, BPL card, Bank passbook.
answer_en: Sikkim Old Age Pension provides ₹2,000 monthly financial pension to BPL seniors aged 60+. Apply via your Block Development Office or Social Welfare Department.
answer_hi: सिक्किम वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना के तहत 60 वर्ष या अधिक उम्र के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹2,000 प्रति माह पेंशन सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलती है।
answer_hinglish: Sikkim Old Age Pension me 60+ age ke seniors ko har mahine ₹2,000 direct bank account me milte hain Social Welfare department se.
answer_te: సిక్కిం వృద్ధాప్య పెన్షన్ పథకం కింద 60 ఏళ్లు దాటిన వృద్ధులకు నెలకు ₹2,000 పెన్షన్ లభిస్తుంది.
